tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rgyud bzhi'i 'grel pa gzhan la phan gter bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ shin tu mngon par sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// dug gsum nad rnams drungs 'byin sman gyi bla// dge legs bai ḍūr+ya yi 'od 'phro ba// drang srong rnams kyi rgyal po de la 'dud// tshig don rlabs 'khrugs sman rgyud chu gter du// don mthun re skong bshad pa'i rdzing bcas nas// mi shes 'jigs pa 'phrog pa 'tsho mdzad kyi// ded dpon chen po thams cad phyag bya'i 'os// sems kyi rtsig ngos sngon sbyangs zhal zhal la// tshig 'bru'i rdul rer legs bshad rdul snyed kyi// rnam bkra'i ri mo 'bri mkhan pad dkar gyis// pir gyi 'du byed rgyud bzhi'i glegs bur bsgyur// 'dir gang bshad par bya na/ 'jig rten na grags shing grub pa'i rig pa'i gnas/ rol mo/ 'khrig thabs/ 'tsho tshis/ grangs can/ sgra/ gso ba'i dpyad/ chos lugs/ bzo/ 'phong*/ dpyad/ gtan tshigs/ rnal 'byor/ thos pa/ dran pa/ skar ma'i dpyad/ rtsis/ mig 'phrul/ sngon gyi rabs/ sngon byung ba bco brgyad las gso ba'i dpyad/ bram ze la grags pa nges brjod kyi rig byed/ snyan tshig gi rig byed// mchod sbyin gyi rig byed/ srid bsrung gi rig byed dam/ tshe'i rig byed las tshe'i rig byed/ chos lugs la grags pa/ gzhan tshar gcod pa la gtan tshigs rig pa dang*/ sgra rig pa gnyis/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la gso ba rig pa dang*/ bzo rig pa gnyis/ bdag nyid kun shes par byed pa nang rig pa ste rig pa'i gnas lnga las gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i gso ba rig pa/ de yang legs par sbyar ba'i skad du/ ā yurbed/ bod kyi skad du tshe'i rig byed/ tshe dang*/ srog dang*/ 'tsho ba rnams don gcig la/ ming rnam grangs pa/ 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi khams na drod dang rnam par shes pa'i rten gnyis ka byed pa/ gzugs med na rnam par shes pa kho na'i rten byed pa/ de rig par byed pas na tshe'i rig byed/

pi tsi ki nis tam/ zhes pa gso ba'i dpyad/ de yang khams mi snyoms pa bsal nas mnyam par bya ba'i rnam dpyad yin pas gso dpyad ces bya'o// tsi ki tas bid+yā/ zhes pa gso ba'i rig pa ste/ gso ba de shes par byed pas na gso ba'i rig pa'o// de la yang rnam par dbye ba du ma yod pa las// da res rgya gar skad du/ a mṛ ta hri da ya aṅga aṣ+ṭa gu h+ya u pa de sha tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ bdud rtsi'i snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces bya ba/ de yang sngon lha ma yin stobs ldan gyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i bdud rtsi bzhin du 'di yang 'chi ba med par byed pa'i phyir bdud rtsi dang*/ de lta bur nus pa'i thabs thams cad kyi snying lta bu yin pas snying po dang*/ de yang lus sogs rnam par dbye ba brgyad kyis bshad pas yan lag brgyad pa dang*/ skal ba dang ldan pa las gzhan la ma grags pas gsang ba dang*/ tshig nyung ngus sman dpyad kyi don ma lus pa ston pas man ngag dang*/ rgyun chags par bshad pas rgyud/ de yang ta dang hri'i bar dang sha dang ta'i bar na rnam par dbye ba byin yod kyang phyis pas da lta mi mngon la/ bsgyur ba'i tshe bdud rtsi dang man ngag gi zhes thon pa yin no// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa zhes nas/ rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar/ lo tsā ba dad pa'i phyag dang*/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ces pa'i sh+lau ka ni/ sdud pa pos bcug pa yin no// zhes shes par byas nas bshad pa dang*/ dngos la 'jug pa la/ gleng gzhi gleng bslang gi sgo nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po 'di skad ces bya ba ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzhung thams cad bsdus pa yin no// bdag gis sman pa'i rgyal pos so// bshad pa'i dus gcig na zhes pa lan cig kho nar gsungs pa ste dkon par ston pa'o// drang srong gi gnas sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba nas/

nor bu bai ḍūr+ya'i gdan la zhes pa'i bar ni gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ bzhugs so zhes bya ba ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul/ kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gsum gyis bzhugs pa zhes bya ba'i don no// ston pa de la 'khor ni zhes pa nas/ thabs cig tu bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar ni 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ste/ don byang sems/ rnam pa lha dang drang srong dang*/ phyi pa dang nang pa'i 'khor bzhi'o// de'i tshe de'i dus na zhes pa dus phun sum tshogs pa/ ston pas gsungs pa'i tshig gcig la zhes pa nas/ drang srong gi lugs zhes bya'o// zhes pa'i bar ni chos phun sum tshogs pa/ de yang blo rab kyi don du gso dpyad thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus te rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan/ blo 'bring gis de'i dgongs pa ma khrol ba las rtsa ba rgyas par bkrol ba'i bshad rgyud bstan/ blo tha ma la des kyang ma chog ste lag len smar khrid du bstan dgos bar byung bas shin tu rgyas pa'i man ngag gi rgyud bstan/ de yang mang nas blos ma lcogs pa'i shin tu zhan pa'i don du mdo bzhir bsdus pa phyi ma'i rgyud bstan pa dag go /gzhan dag na re/ 'di ni g.yu thog pas mdzad pa ste gleng gzhi la sogs pa rab btags so zhes zer la/ lugs 'dzin phal cher rgyud yang dag par 'dod cing grwa ba mngon shes kyis gter nas phyung zhes grags shing*/ rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum las kyang byung bas/ de'i dbang du byas nas bshad la/ sman gyi grong khyer 'di yang baiḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rnam par snang byed ces pa sman gyi bla'i zhing de na dang*/ 'di 'chad pa yang gzhung nyid las sman rgyal du gsungs shing*/ 'o skol gyi ston pas 'tsho byed gzhon nu bos/ ri bo spos ngad ldan du khrid nas de'i khengs pa bcom nas slar zlos bur gsungs pa ste/

dper na byams pa'i smon lam lta bu'o// 'o na 'jug don las rgya gar la sogs pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos thams cad 'dir 'dus par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de ni ma 'ongs lung ston pa ste/ dper na dus kyi 'khor lor bod du bod kyi skad kyis zhes gsungs kyang*/ dus 'khor gsungs pa'i dus su bod chags par mi 'dod pa bzhin no// de ltar gleng gzhi bstan nas gleng bslang pa ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad ces bya ba nas/ le'u la bslab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang*/ zhes pa'i bar te/ ston pa sman gyi rgyud 'chad par bzhed nas ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs shing 'od zer gyis las byas te/ thugs las drang srong rig pa'i ye shes sprul nas des gleng bslang ba dang*/ slar gsung las drang srong yid las skyes sprul te/ des gleng bslang ba'i don ji lta bu zhes zhu bar byas pa'o// gnyis pa tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud bshad pa la/ rjod byed brda'i gso rig /brjod bya don gyi gso rig bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po'i yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis gsol ba/ zhes pa nas/ ro tsa la gnyis rgyud gsum spyi khyab yin// zhes gsungs so zhes pa'i bar te/ gso ba rig pa man ngag gi rgyud ces bya pa yang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud dang*/ man ngag gi rgyud dang*/ phyi ma'i rgyud bzhir phye la/ de thams cad kyang*/ lus dang byis pa mo nad gdon// mtshon dug rgas dang ro tsa ba// yan lag brgyad du shes par bya// zhes pas de yang dang po na bas 'du ba ma snyoms na tshe'i bar chad du 'gyur ba bsrung ba'i phyir/ gso bar bya ba'i gtso bo lus yin pas dang por bstan/ lus de yang byis pa nas gso dgos pas de nas byis pa bstan/ byis pa'i rjes la mo nad 'byung nye bas bstan no// gnyis pa rkyen glo bur bas tshe'i bar chad du gyur pa bsrung ba'i phyir nad mang nyung gi rim pas/

gdon mtshon dug gsum mtha' ma rgas pas mdangs nyams nas tshe'i bar chad du 'gyur pa bsrung pa'i phyir rgas pa dang ro tsa bstan pa'o// ro tsa bas bar chad bsrung bar cir 'gyur zhe na/ tshe'i 'thung bu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bu ma byung ba'i rkyen bsrung ba'o// bstan bcos pa la/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod// mtshon dang 'chi ba rgas ro tsa// gso dpyad gang la gnas pa yi// yan lag brgyad pa de bshad do// zhes grags so// rgyud bzhi po de dag kyang*/ gnas dang*/ skabs dang*/ mdo gsum du bsdus te/ gnas ni rtsa ba mdo'i gnas dang grub pa lus/ 'phel 'grib ni// bya ba spyod lam/ 'tsho ba zas/ sbyor ba sman/ cha byad dpyad/ tha mal nad med/ ngos gzung rtags/ gso byed thabs/ bya byed sman pa'i gnas gso dpyad thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir thog mar rtsa ba mdo nas bstan/ de'i don rgyas par bshad pa la/ dang po gang gi don du gso ba la lus kyi mtshan nyid shes dgos pas grub pa lus gnas bstan/ lus la nad 'byung bas de 'og 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas bstan/ nad la gnyen po spyod lam zas dpyad bzhi dgos pas/ bya ba spyod lam kyi gnas/ 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas/ sbyor ba sman gyi gnas/ cha byad dpyad kyi gnas dang bzhi bstan/ gnyen pos nad med par byas pas nad med tha mal gyi gnas bstan/ na ba gso ba la nad ngos 'dzin dgos pas/ ngos 'dzin rtags kyi gnas bstan rtogs nas gso ba la gso byed thabs kyi gnas bstan/ de thams cad sman pa la rag las pa'i phyir bya byed sman pa'i gnas bstan pa'o// de yang mdo gnas ni rtsa ba'i rgyud yin la/ lhag pa bcu ni bshad pa'i rgyud do// dang po yang le'us bshad na drug ste/ gleng gzhi/ gleng bslang*/ gnas lugs/ nad gzhi/ ngos 'dzin rtags/ gso thabs dpe don gyi rnam grangs sam brtsis kyi le'u ste drug /gnyis pa grub pa lus kyi gnas bshad pa'i rgyud kyi sdom tshig

/lus kyi chags tshul/ 'dra dpe/ gnas lugs/ mtshan nyid/ las dbye/ lus 'jig ltas te le'u bdun/ gsum pa 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas la/ nad kyi rgyu/ rkyen/ zhugs tshul/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba bstan pa ste lnga/ bzhi pa bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas la/ rgyun spyod/ dus su spyod pa/ gnas skabs spyod pa bstan pa ste gsum/ 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la/ zas kyi tshul shes par byed pa/ kha zas bsdam pa/ tshod ran par za ba ste gsum/ sbyor ba sman gyi gnas la/ sman gyi nus pa bstan pa/ sman gyi sde tshan dang sbyor thabs bstan pa ste gsum/ cha byad dpyad kyi gnas la/ gnyen po cha byad bstan pa gcig /tha ma'i nad med gnas la/ mi na ba gnas par bya ba gcig ngos gzung rtags kyi gnas la/ nyes pa dngos su ston pa'i brtag pa/ ngan g.yo skyon gyi brtag pa/ spang blang mu bzhir brtag pa gsum/ gso byed thabs kyi gnas la/ spyi'i gso tshul/ khyad par gyi gso tshul/ gso thabs gnyis bstan pa/ gso thabs dngos bstan pa ste bzhi/ bya byed sman pa'i gnas la/ gso ba po sman pa'i le'u gcig ste so gcig go /gnyis pa skabs ni/ nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs/ khong nad/ tshad pa/ lus stod/ don snod/ gsang nad/ 'thor nad/ lhan skyes kyi rma/ byis pa/ mo nad/ gdon nad/ mtshon rma/ dug nad/ rgas pa/ ro tsa ba gso ba'i skabs te bco lnga/ yan lag brgyad la grangs go rim nges pa yod pa las/ dang po lus gso ba'i yan lag la/ lus kyi ngo bo la nyes pa dang gnod bya gnyis yod pa las/ dang po lus gso ba'i yan lag la/ de 'og gnod bya khams gso ba ston/ dang po la nad kyi rgyu 'bras gnyis las/ nad kyi rgyu'am ngo bo'i sgo nas gso ba la/ nyes pa gso ba'i skabs bstan/ nad 'bras bu'i rang bzhin gyi tsha grang gnyis yod la/ bad rlung grang ba las gyur ba'i nad gtso bor byas pa khong nad gso ba/ khrag mkhris tsha ba las gyur pa'i nad gtso bor byas pa tsha ba'i nad gso ba bstan/ gnyis pa lus stod mgo la gnas pa'i dbang po'i nad/

lus kyi don snod kyi nang*/ lus kyi smad la gsang ba'i nad gtso bor byas pa gsum/ der ma 'dus pa'i nad sha lpags rtsa rus chu ser la sogs pa'i nad phran bus 'thor nad gso ba bstan pa dang*/ der yang ma 'dus pa phyi'i rkyen med kyang 'du ba las gyur pa'i rma gso ba'i skabs bstan no// de ltar skabs brgyad po de rnams lus gso ba'i yan lag go /de nas byis pa gso ba'i skabs kyis byis pa gso ba'i yan lag bstan/ mo nad gso ba'i skabs kyis de ga'i yan lag bstan/ de bzhin du gdon mtshon rgas pa ro tsa ba'i skabs re re bstan no// de dag kyang le'us bshad na/ zhus pa'i le'u/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus nad smug po bcas pa'i le'u ste skabs dang po la lnga/ gnyis pa la/ khong nad thams cad kyi rgyu ma zhu ba/ skran nad/ skya rbab/ 'or /dmu chu/ zad byed bcos pa ste drug /gsum pa la/ tsha ba spyi bcos/ 'khrul gzhi gsal ba tsha grang gal mdo/ tsha ba ri thang mtshams/ tsha ba ma smin pa/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba/ stongs pa'i tsha ba/ gab pa'i tsha ba/ rnyings pa'i tsha ba/ tsha ba snyogs pa/ 'grams kyi tsha ba/ 'khrugs kyi tsha ba/ rims kyi tsha ba/ 'brum pa/ rgyu gzer/ gag lhog /cham rims bcos pa ste bcu drug bzhi pa la/ mgo nad/ mig nad/ rna ba'i nad/ sna nad/ kha nad/ mgul nad/ lba ba bcos pa drug lnga pa la/ snying nad/ glo nad/ mchin nad/ mtsher nad/ mkhal nad/ pho nad/ rgyu ma'i nad/ long nad bcos pa ste brgyad/ drug pa la/ pho mtshan gyi nad/ mo mtshan gyi nad bcos pa ste gnyis/ bdun pa la/ skad 'gags/ yi ga 'chus pa/ skom pa'i nad/ skyigs bu'i nad/ dbugs mi bde ba/ glang thabs/ srin nad/ skyugs pa'i nad/ 'khru ba'i nad/ dri ma 'gags pa'i nad/ chu 'gags pa/ gcin snyi ba/ tshad pas 'khru ba/ dreg nad/ grum bu'i nad/ chu ser gyi nad/ rtsa dkar/ pags nad/ phran bu'i nad bcos pa ste bcu dgu /brgyad pa la/ 'bras/ gzhang 'brum/ me dbal/ sur+ya/ rmin bu/ rlig blugs/

rkang 'bam/ mtshan par rdol pa bcos pa ste brgyad/ dgu pa la/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi nad gso ba/ byis pa'i nad gso ba/ byis pa'i gdon gso ba ste gsum/ bcu pa la/ mo nad gtso bo spyi bcos/ mo nad bye brag tu bcos pa/ mo nad phal pa gso ba ste gsum/ bcu gcig pa la/ 'byung po'i gdon/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ gza' gdon/ klu'i gdon gso ba ste lnga/ bcu gnyis pa la rma spyi'i gso thabs/ mgo'i rma gso ba/ byang khog stod smad gso ba/ yan lag gi rma gso ba/ ske'i rma gso ba ste lnga/ bcu gsum pa la/ sbyar dug gyur pa'i dug rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dug nad bcos pa ste gsum/ bcu bzhi pa la/ bcud len te gcig bco lnga pa la ro tsa bar bya ba bud med bu btsa' ba ste dgu bcu rtsa gnyis so// gsum pa mdo la bslab pa la/ brtag pa rtsa chu'i mdo/ zhi byed sman gyi/ sbyong byed las kyi/ 'jam rtsub dpyad kyi mdo de bzhi/ de yang nad ngos 'dzin pa la/ brtag thabs thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa chur 'dus pa dang*/ bcos thabs zhi sbyang dpyad gsum las/ zhi byed thams cad kyi mdo de lngar 'dus pa dang*/ sbyong byed thams cad kyi mdo las lngar 'dus pa dang*/ zhi sbyang gis ma 'chun pa la dpyad thams cad kyi mdo don drug tu 'dus pa/ de yang le'us bshad na mdo dang po la reg pa rtsa la nad ngos gzung ba dang*/ mthong ba me long chu la nad ngos bzung ba'i le'u gnyis/ gnyis pa la thang gi sde tshan bstan pa/ phye ma'i/ ril bu'i lde gu'i/ sman mar gyi/ thal sman gyi /khan+da'i/ sman chang gi rin po che'i sbyor ba/ sdo sbyor gyi sde tshan te bcu/ gsum pa la/ las lnga'i sngon 'gro snum 'chos/ bshal gyi skyugs kyi/ 'jam rtsi'i/ ni ru ha'i/ sna sman gyi/ rtsa sbyongs kyi bdun/ bzhi pa la/ gtar ga'i/ me btsa'i/ dugs kyi/ lums kyi/ byug pa'i/ thur ma'i le'u ste drug de ltar rgyud bzhi la le'u brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/

mjug don dang*/ yongs su gtad pa gnyis bsnan nas lnga bcu rtsa drug go /gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi gso dpyad bstan pa la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi mdor bstan/ bshad rgyud/ man ngag rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud gsum gyis rgyas bar bshad/ mjug don gyis don bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po yang*/ le'u gsum pa'i/ de nas drang srong yid las skyes kyis/ drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la 'di skad ces gsol to// zhes nas/ 'di dag rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi sdoms su bshad/ ces pa'i bar gyis mdor bstan/ de nyid rgyas par spros na 'di lta ste// zhes pa nas/ le'u lnga pa rdzogs pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bshad/ mtha' mas don bsdu ba ste/ de dag gi don yang*/ gnas lugs gzhi'i rtsa ba/ ngos 'dzin rtags kyi rtsa ba/ gso byed thabs kyi rtsa ba gsum/ dang po yang*/ rnam par ma gyur pa lus gnas pa'i sdong po dang*/ rnam par gyur pa nad kyi sdong po gnyis/ dang po la/ nad kyi yal ga lus zungs kyi yal ga dri ma'i yal ga gsum/ dang po la/ srog 'dzin/ gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ me mnyam/ thur sel te rlung lnga/ 'ju byed/ mdangs sgyur/ sgrub byed/ mthong byed/ mdog gsal te mkhris pa lnga/ rten byed/ myags byed/ myong byed/ tshim phyed/ 'byor byed de bad kan lnga ste lo 'dab bco lnga'o// gnyis pa la/ dwangs ma/ khrag sha/ tshil/ rus/ rkang*/ khu ba ste lo 'dab bdun no// gsum pa la/ bshang ba/ gci ba/ rngul te lo 'dab gsum/ de ltar sdong po dang po las yal ga gsum/ lo 'dab nyi shu rtsa lngar gyes so// gnyis pa rnam par gyur pa nad kyi sdong po la nad skyed par byed pa rgyu'i yal ga lhan cig byed pa rkyen gyi yal ga 'jug pa sgo'i yal ga gnas kyi yal ga lam gyi yal ga ldang dus kyi yal ga 'bras bu'i yal ga zlog pa rgyu'i yal ga mdo don gyi yal ga ste dgu /dang po la rlung gi rgyu 'dod chags/ mkhris pa'i rgyu zhe sdang*/ bad kan gyi rgyu gti mug ste lo 'dab gsum/

gnyis pa la dus kyi rkyen/ gdon gyi/ zas kyi/ spyod lam gyi rkyen te lo 'dab bzhi/ gsum pa la pags la gram pa/ sha la rgyas pa/ rtsa ru rgyu ba/ lus la zhen pa/ don la babs pa/ snod du lhung ba ste lo 'dab drug bzhi pa la bad kan klad pa la brten pas stod na gnas pa/ mkhris pa mchin khri la brten pas bar na gnas pa/ rlung ni dpyi dang rked pa la bsten pas smad na gnas pa ste lo 'dab gsum mo// lnga pa la rlung rnams lus zungs bdun gyi rus pa la rgyu/ dbang po lnga'i rna ba la rgyu/ dri ma'i reg bya la rgyu/ don lnga'i snying srog la rgyu/ snod drug gi long la rgyu/ mkhris pa rnams lus zungs bdun gyi khrag la rgyu/ dbang po lnga'i mig la rgyu/ dri ma'i rngul la rgyu/ don lnga'i mchin pa la rgyu/ snod drug gi mkhris pa dang rgyu ma la rgyu/ bad kan rnams lus zungs bdun gyi dwangs ma sha tshil rkang khu ba la rgyu/ dbang po lnga'i sna dang lce la rgyu/ dri ma'i bshang gci la rgyu/ don lnga'i glo ba dang mchin pa la rgyu/ snod drug gi pho ba mkhal ma lgang pa mngal la rgyu ba ste lo 'dab rnam pa bco lnga'o// drug pa la rgas pa rlung gi mi/ dar ma mkhris pa'i mi/ byis pa bad kan gyi mi ste na tshod kyis phye ba gsum/ ngad can grang ba rlung gi yul/ skam sa tsha gdung che ba mkhris pa'i yul/ brlan can snum pa bad kan gyi yul te yul gyis phye ba gsum/ rlung nad dbyar dus dgong dang tho rangs ldang ba/ mkhris pa ston dus nyin gung mtshan gung ldang ba/ bad kan dpyid dus srod dang snga dro ldang ba ste/ ldang dus kyi dbye ba gsum ste lo 'dab dgu'o// bdun pa la 'tsho ba gsum zad pa/ 'du ba gshed du babs pa/ sbyor ba mtshungs pa/ gnad du shes pa/ dus 'das rlung nad srog rten chad pa/ tsha ba la 'das pa/ grang ba gting 'khar ba/ zungs kyis mi thub/ rnam par 'tshe ba gdon gyis bla khyer ba ste/ 'bras bu srog gcod pa'i nad kyi lo 'dab dgu'o// brgyad pa la rlung bcos zhi nas mkhris par ldog pa/

rlung bcos zhi nas bad kan du ldog pa gnyis// rlung bcos ma zhi bar mkhris par ldog pa dang*/ rlung bcos ma zhi bar bad kan du ldog pa gnyis/ mkhris pa bcos zhi nas rlung du ldog dang*/ mkhris pa bcos zhi nas bad kan du ldog pa gnyis/ mkhris pa bcos ma zhi bar rlung du ldog pa dang*/ mkhris pa bcos ma zhi bar bad kan du ldog pa gnyis/ bad kan bcos zhi nas rlung du ldog pa dang*/ bad kan bcos zhi nas mkhris par ldog pa gnyis/ bad kan bcos ma zhi bar rlung du ldog pa dang*/ bad kan bcos ma zhi bar mkhris par ldog pa gnyis te lo 'dab bcu gnyis so// dgu pa la rlung dang bad kan grang ba chu/ khrag dang mkhris pa tsha ba me ste lo 'dab gnyis/ srin dang chu ser tsha grang thun mong du 'jug pas lo 'dab tu ma bgrangs so// de ltar sdong po gnyis po la yal ga dgu /lo 'dab drug cu rtsa gsum/ snga ma dang dril bas lo 'dab brgyad cu rtsa brgyad do// de ltar sdong po dang po ni chu lta bu/ gnyis pa ni rkyen gyis 'khyag rom du song ba lta bu'o// ngos 'dzin rtags kyi rtsa ba la/ lta ba yul rig pa'i sdong po/ reg pa'i dpyad pa don rig pa'i sdong po/ dri ba thos pa sgra rig pa'i sdong po gsum/ dang po la lce la brtag pa'i yal ga dang*/ chu la brtag pa'i yal ga gnyis/ dang po la rlung gi lce dmar zhing skam la rtsub pa/ mkhris pa'i lce bad kan skya ser 'thug pos g.yogs pa/ bad kan gyi lce skya gleg mdangs med 'jam la rlon pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ gnyis pa la rlung gi chu chu 'dra lbu ba che ba/ mkhris pa'i chu dmar ser rlangs che dri ma dugs pa/ bad kan gyi chu dkar la dri rlangs chung ste lo 'dab gsum mo// sdong po gnyis pa la/ rlung gi rtsa la reg pa'i yal ga /mkhris pa'i rtsa la reg pa'i yal ga /bad kan gyi rtsa la reg pa'i yal ga ste gsum// dang po rkyal stong skabs su stod pa/ gnyis pa la mgyogs rgyas grims par 'phar ba/

gsum pa la bying rgud dal ba ste lo 'dab gsum/ gsum pa la rlung rkyen na lugs gom pa dri ba'i yal ga /mkhris rkyen na lugs goms pa dri ba'i yal ga /bad kan rkyen na lugs goms pa dri ba'i yal ga ste gsum/ dang po la yang rtsub pa'i zas dang spyod lam gyi rkyen gyis skyed pa/ des bskyed pa'i na lugs g.yal ba/ bya rmyang byed pa/ grang shum byed pa/ dpyi dang rked pa rus tshigs ma lus pa na ba/ gzer ba nges pa med pa/ 'pho zhing stong skyugs byed pa/ dbang po mi gsal ba/ shes pa 'tshub pa/ bkres dus na ba/ goms pa la snum bcos phan par nges pa ste lo 'dab bcu gcig /gnyis pa la rno zhing tsha ba'i zas dang spyod lam rkyen gyis skyed pa/ des bskyed pa'i na lugs kha kha ba// mgo na ba/ sha drod che ba/ stod gzer ba/ zhu rjes na ba/ goms pa la bsil ba phan pa ste lo 'dab bdun/ gsum pa la lci la snum pa'i zas dang spyod lam rkyen gyis skyed pa/ des bskyed pa'i na lugs dang ga mi bde ba/ kha zas 'ju bar dka' ba/ skyugs pa/ kha dngal ba/ pho ba 'tshing pa/ sgregs pa/ lus sems gnyis ka lci ba/ phyi nang gnyis ka grang ba/ zos rjes mi bde ba/ goms pa na dro ba 'phrod pa ste lo 'dab bcu gcig de ltar brtag thabs kyi sdong po gsum/ yal ga brgyad/ lo 'dab sum cu so brgyad do// gsum pa gso dpyad thabs kyi rtsa ba la/ zas kyi sdong po/ spyod lam gyi sdong po/ sman gyi sdong po/ dpyad kyi sdong po bzhi/ dang po la rlung sel ba'i zas kyi yal ga dang*/ rlung sel pa'i skom gyi yal ga gnyis// mkhris pa sel ba'i zas kyi yal ga dang*/ mkhris pa sel ba'i skom gyi yal ga gnyis/ bad kan sel ba'i zas kyi yal ga dang*/ bad kan sel ba'i skom gyi yal ga gnyis te drug /dang po la rta'i sha/ bong bu'i sha/ phyi ba'i sha/ lo lon pa'i sha/ sha chen/ 'bru mar/ lo mar/ bu ram/ sgog skya/ gtsong ste lo 'dab bcu/ gnyis pa la 'o ma/

lca ba ra mnye dang bcas pa'i zan chang*/ bur chang*/ rus chang ste lo 'dab bzhi/ yongs dril rlung zas bcu bzhi/ gsum pa la ba'i zho dar/ ra'i zho dar/ mar gsar/ ri dwags sha/ ra sha/ kom sha ste ba lang gi sha/ chag tshe/ skyabs/ khur tshod do// bzhi pa la/ chab tsha/ chu bsil/ chu bskol grang gsum ste mkhris zas bcu gnyis/ lnga pa la/ lug gi sha/ g.yag gi sha/ gcan gzan gyi sha/ nya'i sha/ sbrang rtsi/ skam sa'i 'bru rnying gi zan dron/ zho dar te bdun/ drug pa la gar chang*/ chu bskol gyi gnyis te bad kan gyi zas dgu /yongs dril zas la lo 'dab sum cu so lnga/ sdong po gnyis pa la rlung gi spyod lam/ mkhris pa'i spyod lam/ bad kan gyi spyod lam ste yal ga gsum/ dang po la gnas dro sa/ grogs yid 'ong ste gnyis/ gnyis pa la gnas bsil sa/ spyod lam dal bar sdod pa ste gnyis/ gsum pa la gnas dro sa/ spyod lam rtsol bas 'chag pa ste lo 'dab gnyis te spyod lam gyi drug sdong po gsum pa la rlung sel ba ro'i yal ga rlung sel ba nus pa'i/ mkhris pa sel pa ro'i/ mkhris pa sel ba nus pa'i/ bad kan sel ba ro'i/ bad kan sel ba nus pa'i/ rlung zhi byed khu ba'i/ rlung zhi byed sman mar gyi/ mkhris pa zhi byed thang gi mkhris pa zhi byed phye ma'i/ bad kan zhi byed ril bu'i/ bad kan zhi byed tres sam gyi/ rlung sbyong byed 'jam rtsi'i/ mkhris pa sbyong byed bshal gyi/ bad kan sbyong byed skyugs kyi yal ga dang bco lnga'o// dang po la mngar ba/ skyur ba/ lan tshwa ba gsum/ gnyis pa la snum pa/ lci ba/ 'jam pa gsum/ gsum pa la mngar ba/ kha ba/ bska ba gsum/ bzhi pa la bsil ba/ sla ba/ rtul ba gsum/ lnga pa la tsha ba/ skyur ba/ bska ba gsum/ drug pa la/ rno ba/ rtsub pa/ yang pa gsum/ bdun pa la rus khu bcu bzhi/ mgo khrol gsum/ brgyad pa la dzā ti'i sman mar/ sgog skya'i sman mar/ 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar/ btsan dug gi sman mar dang lnga/

dgu pa la ma nu'i thang*/ sle tres kyi thang*/ tig ta'i thang*/ 'bras bu gsum gyi thang dang bzhi/ bcu pa la ga bur phye ma/ tsan dan phye ma/ gur kum phye ma/ cu gang gi phye ma dang bzhi/ bcu gcig pa la btsan dug gi ril bu// tshwa sna'i ril bu dang gnyis/ bcu gnyis pa la se 'bru/ dwa lis/ rgod ma kha/ tshwa bsregs/ cong zhi bsregs pa'i thal sman te lnga/ bcu gsum pa la sle 'jam/ bkru 'jam/ bkru ma slen dang gsum/ bcu bzhi pa la spyi bshal/ sgos bshal/ drag bshal/ 'jam bshal dang bzhi/ bco lnga pa la 'jam skyugs/ drag skyugs kyi lo 'dab gnyis te sman la lnga bcu/ sdong po bzhi la rlung gi dpyad/ mkhris pa'i dpyad/ bad kan gyi dpyad kyi yal ga gsum/ dang po la/ bsku mnye dang*/ hor gyi me btsa'/ gnyis pa la rngul 'don dang*/ gtar ga chu'i 'phrul 'khor/ gsum pa la dugs dang*/ me btsa'i lo 'dab gnyis te sdong po bzhi/ yal ga rtsa bdun lo 'dab dgu bcu rtsa brgyad dril bas/ lo 'dab nyis brgya rtsa bzhir bshad la/ de dag kyang nyi ma shar na ba mo la sdod pa'i skabs med pa lta bu'o// me tog tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ gsal ba gsum/ 'bras bu chos nor bde ba gsum du smin pa yin no// 'dis dgos sogs kyang khong gis bstan no// gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi'i bshad pa gzhan la phan pa'i gter las rtsa rgyud rnam par dbye ba'i skabs te dang po'o// //gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyas par bshad pa la/ de nas ston pa zhes nas/ 'di skad ces gsungs so// zhes pa'i bar gyis gleng bslang*/ kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes zhes pa nas/ 'di dag bshad pa'i rgyud kyi sdom tshig yin/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mdor bstan/ de don tshan bcu gcig gnas bcu/ le'u sum cu'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa las/ dang po mdor bstan pa'i don la gso bar byed pa'i yul zhing lta bu/ gso bar byed pa'i gnyen bo chu lta bu/ ji ltar gso bar byed pa'i thabs zhing la chu 'grems pa lta bu/

gso ba po sman pa las mi lta bu ste rtsa ba bzhi/ dang po la gang gi don du gso ba grub pa lus kyi gnas/ gang gso ba de las byung ba'i 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas gnyis/ rtsa ba gnyis pa la bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas/ 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas/ sbyor ba sman gyi gnas/ cha byad dpyad kyi gnas te bzhi/ rtsa ba gsum pa la rnam par ma gyur pa'i lus nad med tha mal gyi gnas/ rnam par gyur pa lus na ba gso ba gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ nad ngos 'dzin pa brtags kyi gnas/ rtogs nas ji ltar gso tshul/ gang gis gso ba'i thabs te gsum/ tha ma gnyis bsdoms ba'i gso byed thabs kyi gnas/ rtsa ba bzhi pa nyid/ de ltar gso ba'i bya byed sman pa'i gnas zhes bstan pas/ rtsa ba bzhi sdong po bcu gcig tu gyes pa yin no// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bcu gcig las/ dang po gang gi don du gso ba grub pa lus kyi sdong po la/ lus chags tshul/ 'dra dpe/ gnas lugs/ mtshan nyid/ las dbye/ 'jigs ltas bstan pa ste yal ga drug dang po la chags pa'i rgyu/ 'phel ba'i rkyen/ btsa' ba'i rtags te lo 'dab gsum/ spungs ba'am bsags pa las lus zhes bya ba 'di/ ji ltar grub pa'i tshul ni rags pa mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas nas bshad na/ pha'i khu ba dang ma'i zla mtshan gnyis skyon med pa dang*/ de la las mthun ba'i dri za nye bar 'khor ba gsum ni rgyu/ de gsum tshogs pa'i mngal gyi 'byung ba lnga/ rkyen de dag 'dzom pa las ji ltar chags pa'i tshul ni/ bud med lo bcu gnyis nas lnga bcu lon pa'i bar du zla ba re la mngal nas khrag zhag gsum du 'dzag cing*/ de nas kyang zhag bcu gnyis su mngal kha bye nas sdod do// de'i 'dzag pa'i zhag gsum la srid mi len chad pa'i las dang nyon mongs kyis bskul ba'i rnam par shes pa zhag dang po/ gsum pa/ lnga pa/ bdun pa/ dgu pa la bu/ gnyis dang*/ bzhi dang*/ drug dang*/ brgyad/ bcu pa la bu mo/ bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa la srid mi len no// de yang khu ba mang na bu/

zla mtshan mang na bu mo/ cha mnyam pa ma ning*/ khu ba gnyis 'dres pa cha gnyis su phye ba las mtshe ma/ dwangs ma las yid du 'ong ba dang*/ dri ma shas che ba yid du mi 'ong skye'o// pha'i khu ba'i rus pa/ klad pa/ gzhungs pa/ ma'i zla mtshan las sha khrag don snod/ rang sems las dbang po'i rnam shes/ sa las sha rus sna dri/ chu las khrag lce ro rlan/ me las drod mdangs mig gzugs/ rlung las dbugs/ pags pa reg bya/ nam mkha' las bu ga rna ba sgra skye bar bshad do// gnyis pa mngal chags nas 'phel ba'i rgyu yang ma'i bu sdod g.yas sam g.yon gyi rtsa dang srid pho'am mo'i lte ba 'brel pa/ yang rtsa de gnyis ma'i bsam se'u bcud kyi rtsa dang 'brel bas na/ mas zas zos pa'i dwangs mas mngal rim gyis 'phel bar byed do// de yang bdun phrag sum cu rtsa brgyad du rlung gis bsgyur zhing zla ba dgur gnas la/ bu 'dod pas lte bsgyur la sogs pa'i man ngag zla ba dang po la bya zhing*/ ma'i spyod lam nyal po dang rtsol ba drag po la sogs pa byas pa dang*/ snying la 'dod pa'i zas spyod bkag pa las mngal 'jigs par 'gyur ba yin no// bdun phrag lnga pa nas lte bar srog rtsa'i rtsa ba chags shing*/ drug par srog rtsa nag po/ bdun par mig gi dbang po dod cing*/ brgyad pa la de la brten nas mgo dbyibs/ dgu par lus kyi khog pa stod smad/ bcu par dpung dpyi bzhi 'bur du dod/ bcu gcig par dbang po dgu bcu gnyis par don lnga/ bcu gsum par snod drug bcu bzhi par dpung rkang brla rkang*/ bco lnga par rkang lag gi rje ngar/ bcu drug par sor mo nyi shu/ bcu bdun par phyi nang 'brel ba'i rtsa/ bco brgyad par sha tshil/ bcu dgu par chu ba rgyus pa/ nyi shu bar rus pa rkang mar grub pa/ rtsa gcig par phyi'i pags pas g.yogs pa/ rtsa gnyis par dbang po dgu'i bu ga bye ba/ rtsa gsum par skra dang ba spu sen mo chags pa/ rtsa bzhi par bde sdug shes pa/

rtsa lnga par rlung nang du rgyu ba/ rtsa drug par sems kyi dran pa/ rtsa bdun pa nas sum cu'i bar gyis de dag gsal par dod pa/ so gcig nas so lnga'i bar gyis ches cher 'phel zhing ma bu gnyis gzi mdangs res mos su 'pho'o// so drug nas mngal la skyo ba'i 'du shes/ so brgyad nas mgo mjug bsgyur te mngal nas 'byin la/ dus su mi btsa' bar 'gying ba yang khrag zags pa la sogs pa dang*/ rlung gis dku bkag pa'i skyon no// gsum pa ni ring ba'i rtags/ thung ba'i rtags gnyis/ dang po bur skye na ma'i lus kyi g.yas logs la brten pa dang*/ dku g.yas pa mtho/ lus yang*/ rmi lam la skyes pa mthong*/ 'phrad 'dod glu gar la dga'/ nu zho g.yas pa sngar 'byung la bzlog pa bu mo'o// 'dres pa las ma ning*/ lto ba g.yas g.yon gyi dbus dma' na mtshe ma'o// gnyis pa lus skyid snyoms pa sogs so// gnyis pa 'dra dpe la mtshon bya lus/ mtshon byed dpe so gsum lo 'dab gcig tu byas pa/ gsum pa gnas lugs bstan pa la/ ldang tshad lus zungs kyi gnas lugs/ 'brel pa rtsa'i gnas lugs/ gnyan pa gnad kyi gnas lugs/ rgyu lam bu ga'i gnas lugs te yal ga phre'u'i tshul du gyes pa bzhi las/ dang po la lus kyi bye brag gi ldang tshad dang*/ lus spyi'i tshad kyi lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po de la gnod byed nyes pa'i ldang tshad/ gnod byed lus zungs dri ma'i/ chu rgyus spu'i// don snod bu ga'i ldang tshad bzhi/ gnyis pa la chags pa'i rtsa/ srid pa'i rtsa// 'brel ba'i rtsa/ tshe'i rtsa'i lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po srog rtsa lte ba nas gyen/ mchin khri phug nas sgal pa'i nang thad du thang shing gi sdong pau langs pa lta bu yod pa las/ rtsa thams cad yal ga lta bur gyes pa yin no// de'i rtse mo klad pa'i thad du zug cing*/ de nas thur du 'phros pa gti mug bad kan gyi khams skyed pa chu rtsa'am rtsa dkar/ bar gyi rgyun zhe sdang mkhris pa spro ba khrag rtsa'am rtsa nag

/lte ba nas 'og gsang ba'i gnas su zug pa 'dod chags rlung spro ba/ 'di ni lte ba nas sdong po gsum du song ba ma yin la/ shing sdong gcig gi rtsa rtse bar ma byed las kyis gsum du bzhag pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa spyi bor dbang po yul la 'char bar byed pa dang*/ snying gar dran pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed pa dang*/ lte bar lus kyi dbang po chags par byed pa dang*/ gsang bar bu tsha rigs brgyud skyed par byed pa'i rtsa ste/ srog rtsa'i sdong po de gnas de dag tu dngos dang brgyud pa'i rtsa phran lnga brgya lnga brgyas bskor bas lus kyi gnas thams cad chags shing 'phel bar byed pas na lus rjes su 'dzin pa zhes so/// /gsum pa rtsa nag rtsa dkar gnyis te chags rtsa gsum du phye ba'i bar ma la srog gi rlung khrag dang bsdongs nas gnas pa'i phyir rtsa nag ces bya'o// de las gyes pa don snod nang du 'brel ba sbas pa'i rtsa brgyad/ yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa bcu drug ste/ bsdoms pas sha khrag 'phel bar byed pa'i rtsa chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o// sbas pa'i rtsa brgyad ni/ rgyud las gsungs pa/ 'grel pa mkhan rnams gyis tshigs pa bzhi pa'i thad nas yal ga gsum du gyes pa'i dbus kyi sbom pa snying la zug ces 'byung la/ don de gnyis kyi 'dzom sa nas yin pas 'gal ba med do/ snying nang du dwangs ma'i rtsa lnga gyes pa'i rlung rtsa dbus/ rlung khrag 'dres pa'i rtsa bzhi phyogs bzhir gnas so// g.yas g.yon gnyis po glo ba ma bu gnyis la zug /glo ba'i nang du rtsa sog ma'i phon po lta bur gyes pa la glo ba pags pas g.yogs pa lta bur song bas sob cing nad 'jug sla thon par dka' 'o// tshigs pa brgyad pa'i thad nas yal ga gnyis su gyes pa'i gcig mchin pa dang*/ gcig mchin pa'i lung chen mchin khri nag po dang 'brel lo/ tshigs pa bcu gnyis pa nas gcig mtsher pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa nas gcig bsam ser/

bcu bzhi pa nas gcig mkhal mar 'brel lo/ de ltar brgyad po de phyir mi mngon pa'i phyir sbas pa'i rtsa zhes bya la/ de dag yal ga dang don snying brgyad 'bras bu lta bu'o// yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa bcu drug ni/ rtsa nag ces bzhag pa'i srog pa rtsa'i rtse mo las khrag rtsa gnyis/ 'phar rtsa bzhi drug tu gyes te ske la song ste mgo la gnas/ de'i 'og nas 'phar rtsa gnyis khrag rtsa gnyis te bzhir gyes nas lag pa g.yas g.yon la/ rtsa nag gi smad na 'phar rtsa gnyis/ khrag rtsa gnyis te bzhir gyes nas rkang par/ yang 'phar rtsa gnyis pho mo'i mtshan ma dang 'brel te/ snying dang 'brel ba rnams 'phar la/ mchin pa dang 'brel ba rnams mi 'phar zhes grag go /de ltar rtsa chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi po de las btar du rung ba'i rtsa bdun cu don bdun/ 'bug tu mi rung ba'i rtsa gnad brgya dang bcu gnyis te bsdoms pas brgya dang gya dgu'o// gtar rtsa bdun cu don bdun ni/ 'tshog gsang gcig /gser mdung*/ dngul mdung*/ mur gong gi ltag ral gnyis/ dpral rtsa kha che/ mig rtsa gnyis/ sna rtse gcig lce rtsa gnyis/ so rtsa gnyis/ rtse'u chung gnyis/ thong rtsa gcig ltag rtsa nag po gnyis/ sna rtsa'am ljon shing gnyis te/ mgo la nyi shu/ dpung rtsa gnyis/ gru mgo gnyis/ sgang rtsa gnyis/ snod kha gnyis/ ru thung gnyis/ glo snying 'doms rtsa gnyis/ bad kan shal ring gnyis/ mkhris rtsa shal ring gnyis/ mkhris rtsa phran bu gnyis/ glo mchin 'doms rtsa gnyis/ mchin mkhris 'doms rtsa gnyis/ rgyab rtsa drug 'dus gnyis/ sor mo'i bar rtsa bcu ste/ lag pa la sum cu so bzhi/ rtsa bo che gnyis/ 'gab rtsa gnyis/ rta mthur gnyis/ byin gzhug gnyis/ gdong rtsa gnyis/ long rtsa gnyis/ byin skyogs gnyis/ yob gong gnyis/ rgyu ma'i rtsa gnyis te rkang pa la bco brgyad/ sbubs la pho ba'i rwa rtsa gnyis/ pho mtshan gyi 'gram rtsa gnyis/ bud med la 'di'i dod nu ma la/

gzhug thung rtse mo gcig ste lnga'o// rtsa gnad brgya dang bcu gnyis ni/ mgo la gnyan gyi re thag bzhi/ phyi nang rgyug pa gcig tshangs pa'i skud pa gcig 'phred nyal gnyis/ gzer rtsa dgu/ mtshul rtsa gnyis/ 'jug byed gnyis/ mig gi rtsa rus zhen gnyis/ gser gyi skud pa gcig ste mgo la nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ snying rtsa drug glo rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ mchin rtsa gnyis/ mtsher rtsa gnyis/ bsam se'u'i gnyis/ pho ba'i rtsa lnga/ mkhris pa gcig rgyu rtsa gcig long rtsa gnyis/ mkhal ma phyi nang gi rtsa bzhi/ lgang pa'i rtsa gsum ste lnga bcu nga gnyis/ yan lag la 'phar rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ dngul mdung gnyis/ mig dmar gnyis/ phyir mngon pa'i rtsa bcu drug tu 'dus pas mi bgrang*/ gzhan nyi shu/ mchin rtsa gnyis/ mkhal rtsa drug mtsher rtsa bzhi/ mkhris rtsa bzhi ste so drug bsdoms pas brgya dang bcu gnyis so// gtar rtsa gnad du bshad pa de rnams gtar dus na gtar rtsa yin yang*/ mtshon gyi gnad du nas/ gnad du 'gyur ba'i phyir der smos so// de dag phyi sha pags/ bar rus pa/ nang don snod du 'brel bas brgya nyi shu phrag gsum ste sum brgya drug cu/ de la rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa bzhir phye nas brgya dang brgyad cu las lngas dman par phye bas bdun brgya/ de las bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi/ de las drwa ba lta bur gyes par bshad do// rtsa dkar ni/ sngon rabs pa dag srog rtsa dkar po de sgal pa'i dkyil na mar 'jar nas rgyu ste/ rtsa stong la snying 'bras bu'i tshul du smin la/ rtsa smad phra mor gyes te brgyungs pa bzhin song nas gzhug gu thung gi rtsa mig tu thim mo zhes zer yang*/ gzhung las ma bshad pas 'thad pa ma yin no// gzhung las byung ba ni/ rtsa dkar thams cad klad pa'i thad kyi srog rtsa rtse mo nas 'thur du gyes nas/ lus bsgul bskyod kyi bya ba byed pa'i chu rtsa nang du 'brel ba dang phyir mngon pa dag ste/

dang po don snod dang 'brel ba sbas pa'i rtsa dar gyi dpyang thag ces bya bcu gsum klad pa'i rjes zhabs nas don nas/ sked nas mar brgyud de rlung gi rtsa bzhi snying dang rgyu mar 'brel/ mkhris pa'i rtsa bzhi glo long mchin khrir/ bad kan gyi rtsa bzhi pho mtsher mkhal lgang du/ 'dus pa'i rtsa gcig bsam se'u dang 'brel lo// phyir 'brel ba'i rtsa drug yod de/ ltag par sbu gu can gnyis/ ltag zur spu 'khyil nas 'ja' byed gnyis/ sna shal 'og gshong nas rat+na gnyis te drug de dag las gyes pa mgo la gsum/ mdo ris gcig 'das byed gnyis te gsum/ rgyab na brgyungs pa rtsa gcig tshig 'gram 'brel ba gnyis te gsum/ yan lag la bcu'o// bzhi pa mi'i tshe srog gi rten byed pa'i rtsa gsum yod do// dang po srog pa'i rtsa thang shing gi sdong po lta bu lus thams cad la khyab par gnas pa de dang*/ gnyis pa dbugs dang 'grogs nas 'phar ba'i rtsa dang*/ gsum pa bla dang 'grogs te 'khyams pa bla rtsa'o// de dag lus phyi nang sbrel ba dang*/ lus skyed cing gnas pa dang*/ srog gi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir rtsa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa la/ sha gnad/ tshil/ rus/ chu rgyus/ don snod/ rtsa'i gnad de lo 'dab drug dang po spyir gnad ces bya ba/ der mtshon phog na rab tu 'chi/ 'bring du na zhing sbyong*/ tha ma'ang gzhan pas gso bar dka' bas so// de yang sha gnad skrangs ba/ rus gnad zug rngu che/ chu rgyus kyi gnad 'ja' bar byed pa/ lhag ma rnams srog 'dor bar byed pa'o// sha gnad la/ mgo la spyi gtsug gzhag sgor 'khyil ba 'dra ba/ ltag pa'i sha nya gdang gzhibs pa 'dra ba/ 'tshogs sha gzhu shul btang ba 'dra ba/ mur gong gi lug mkhal brtsegs pa 'dra ba gnyis te lnga/ ske la bdud sha gnyis/ rgyang sha gnyis/ ol stong mid pa gnyis te drug byang khog la/ sgal 'dab kyi bshul sha nag po gnyis/ brang gi nu sha gnyis/ sta zur gyi sta sha gnyis/ mchan khung gi gzhag sha gnyis thal gong dam phrag steng gi gnya' sha gnyis/

sog pa'i kha sgor gyi bdar sha khug pa gnyis/ sog mthil lam sog pa'i me long steng gi 'bros sha gnyis/ mchin khri gnyis/ rlig 'bras gnyis te bco brgyad/ yan lag la dpung tshigs kyi lug gzhug gnyis/ lag ngar gyi nywa gnyis/ lag mgo'i mtheb mdzub kyi bar na bdar sha gnyis/ dpyi'i 'chang bzung steng gi sha rgod gnyis/ brla sgang gi sgang sha gnyis/ gnyan gong gi sbal nag gnyis/ byin nywa gnyis/ byin gzhug gnyis te bcu drug yongs dril bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'o// tshil gnad la/ phrag gong gi rmen bu mgo nag gnyis/ dpung pa'i rmen bu smug po gnyis/ sna'i rmen bu dkar po gnyis dang*/ sbrul mgo gnyis te brgyad do// rus gnad la/ mgo la bdud mgo gsum/ srub steng gcig 'phred nyal gnyis/ mig 'bor gnyis/ mkhur tshos gnyis/ za 'gram gnyis/ ltag pa gcig dang bcu gsum/ byang khog la sgal tshigs dang gcig brang rus dang gnyis/ gzhug thung dang gsum/ yan lag la tshigs chen bcu gnyis/ sre long dang gnyis/ long bu gnyis nye bcu drug yongs dril sum cu rtsa gnyis so// chu rgyus kyi gnad la/ lta chu gnyis/ bshul ba'i chu leb gnyis/ gru mo gnyis/ mkhrig ma gnyis/ sgyid chu gnyis/ rting chu gnyis/ chu ba sbal mgo gnyis te bcu bzhi/ don snod kyi gnad la/ snying nag po/ glo ba'i bu/ mchin pa'i mtsho/ mtsher pa'i mu/ mkhal ma'i 'bras bu/ pho ba'i rdzems/ mkhris pa'i rtsi/ khrag long*/ rgyu ma/ gnye ma/ lgang pa'i kha gzhang nag po/ bsam se'u dang bcu gsum/ rtsa gnad la/ rlung rtsa so gnyis/ srog rtsa gya dgu/ rlung khrag 'doms pa'i 'phar rtsa re dgu ste brgya dang dgu bcu tham pa'o// rlung rtsa so gnyis ni/ dar gyi dpyang thag bcu gsum/ sum mdo rigs 'dar byed gnyis/ sbu gu can gnyis/ 'ja' byed gnyis/ rat+na gnyis/ chu rtsa gnyis/ ka ru gnyis/ rus rtsa gnyis/ dpung mgo gnyis/ khrag rtsa gya dgu ni/ snying gi khrag rtsa rtse'u chung gnyis/ snod kha gnyis/

glo ba'i khrag rtsa la/ glo ba'i rtsibs las byung ba'i tshigs 'gram gnyis/ 'di gnyis mchin khri yan glo ba dbang la/ bzhir gyes man mkhal ma'i yul yin pas bcu bzhi pa'i thad ka nas mkhal ma'i rtsa nag ces bsgrags so// sgo ma sgang las byung ba'i nang rgyug gnyis/ glo ma stag mgo las byung grogs stod gnyis/ glo ma brags snga las byung ba'i dgyes dor gnyis/ glo ma bshal ma las byung ba'i sgred bu gnyis/ glo bu thugs khab las byung phyir rgyug gnyis/ glo bu mdzod sna las byung ba bsnol ma gnyis/ glo bu bya bgab las byung gzer 'go gnyis/ glo bu dgra lce las byung zangs ma gnyis/ glo bu lte mig las byung sngon po gnyis/ ma bu sgrog ba lung 'dzin khug pa gnyis/ tshang tshid las byung glo rtsa dung 'bud gnyis/ drug mgo gnyis/ sgang rtsa gnyis/ mchin ba la/ 'ja' byed gnyis/ mig rtsa rus zhen gnyis/ sha ru gnyis/ mon ru gnyis/ ro thung kha zar gnyis/ mchin rtsa smad gsum gnyis/ mtsher pa la bya rkang gnyis/ gzer rtsa gnyis/ rtsa nag gnyis/ rta mthur gnyis/ mkhal rtsa la/ rtsa nag gnyis/ na gu gnyis/ rus zhen gnyis/ rkang 'degs gnyis/ sne rtsa gnyis/ byin gzhug gnyis/ pho rtsa la sbrul mig gnyis/ ka ba gnyis/ bong rmed gcig mkhris pa la/ gser gdung gnyis/ gser gyi ka ba gnyis/ skya ring gnyis/ shal ring gnyis/ srog rten gcig rgyu ma la/ rgyu grogs kyi rtsa gcig long la/ rgyun rtsa gnyis/ rtsa bo che gnyis/ long rtsa gnyis/ bsam se'u'i rtsa gnyis/ lgang ba la/ srog rtsa/ srid rtsa/ chu rtsa rnams so// rlung khrag bsdoms pa'i 'phar rtsa re dgu ni/ mgo la gnyan gyi re thag bzhi/ phyi nang rgyug pa gcig tshangs pa'i skud pa gcig gzer rtsa dgu/ lag ral gnyis/ nang ljon gnyis/ ltag rtsa gcig mtshul rtsa gnyis/ 'gram rtsa gnyis/ rtsel nag gnyis rtsel 'dra gnyis/ gser gyi skud pa gcig grangs sum cu/ byang khog la/ srog ba rtsa/ sbas pa'i rtsa brgyad/

phra khab gnyis/ dngul gyi 'bu ru gnyis/ mtshan ma'i rtsa gnyis te bco lnga'o// yan lag la/ rkang mthil gyi mthil 'phrog gnyis/ bol gong gi 'gul rtsa nag po gnyis/ nang long nang khud kyi lcags kyi sran ma gnyis/ ngar gdong gi gser rtsa ka gdung gnyis/ bgab khung gi bgab rtsa nag po gnyis/ sna rtsa'i snying rtsa mig dmar gnyis/ srin lag gong gi myur ba gnyis/ mdzod spu chung gi steng du 'gul rtsa gnyis/ lag pa'i rus pa 'bur po'i sdebs kyi ltag pa'i rtsa gnyis/ mas zur chu ba'i bar gyi bla rtsa gnyis/ gre mo'i nang khud kyi a so ling ga gnyis/ mchan khung nang gi snying rtsa dngul mdung gnyis te nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ gnad thams cad bsdoms na/ mgo la nga gnyis/ sked la so gnyis/ byang khog stod smad la go lnga/ yan lag la brgya dang nyer gnyis te sum brgya dang gnyis so// de las rab tu gnyan pa dgu bcu go drug yod de/ sha gnad la byin snying mchin khri gnyis/ rlig 'bras gnyis te drug tshil bu'i gnad brgyad/ don snod kyi gnas bcu gsum/ rus pa'i gnad/ ltag pa 'khar 'tshams sre long gnyis/ long bu gnyis te drug rtsa gnad la/ srog ba rtsa/ sbas pa'i rtsa brgyad/ tshangs pa'i skud pa/ gnyen gyi re thag bzhi/ phyi nang rgyug pa/ rtsel 'dra gnyis/ rtsel nag gnyis/ dar dpyangs bcu gsum/ phra khab gnyis/ pho ba'i rtsa lnga/ yan lag gi snying rtsa nyer bzhi ste drug cu re gsum ste/ 'di rnams la 'tshon phog na sman pa mkhas kyang bcos su med pa srog nges par gtong ngo*/ 'bring du gnyan pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu yod de/ sha gnad la bshul sha gnyis/ lag ngar gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ nywa snying gnyis/ sbal nag gnyis/ ol gong mid pa gnyis te bcu gnyis/ chu rgyus la/ ltag pa'i chu leb gnyis/ rus gnad bdud sgo gsum/ 'phred nyal gnyis/ brang rus/ gzhug thung*/ dpyi dang*/ dpung pa/ pus mo ste bcu gnyis/ rtsa gnad la/ sum mdo ris chu rtsa drug rtsel chung gnyis/

tshigs 'gram gnyis/ mkhal ma'i rtsa nag gnyis/ sngon po gnyis/ khug po gnyis/ mkhris rtsa lnga/ rtsa bo che gcig mtsher pa rtsa nag gnyis dang nyer lnga/ sman pa mkhas pa dang thug na bcos su btub pa tsam mo// lhag ma gnyis brgya nga bdun po de rnams gnad du bstan yang mtha' ma yin pas sman pa phal gyis gso bar nus so// bzhi pa la/ phyi dang nang gi bu ga'i lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir dgu /bud med la mngal sgo nu ma gnyis kyis lhag phyi ma la srog zungs bdun/ dri ma gsum/ chu dang zas rgyu ba'i bu ga dang bcu gsum/ bzhi pa lus kyi mtshan nyid kyi yal ga la/ gnod byed nyes pa ste/ yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la dbye ba/ me drod gyur tshul/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i dus te lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po lus zungs bdun dang*/ dri ma gsum/ zungs bdun ni/ dwangs ma/ khrag sha/ tshil/ rus pa/ rkang mar/ khu ba'o// dwangs mas gnod bya 'phel bar byed/ khrag gis rlon cing srog 'tsho bar/ shas g.yogs par/ tshil gyis snum par/ rus pas brtan par/ rkang mar gyis bcud du 'gyur bar/ khu bas mngal 'dzin par byed do// dri ma bshang gci rngul gsum/ bshang gcis zas skom gyi snyigs ma 'drul cing 'byin/ rngul gyis pags pa mnyan cing ba spu brtan par byed do// gnyis pa me drod ni/ gtso bo mkhris pa 'ju byed yin la/ gzhan nang dang lus zungs kun la gnas pa'i drod dag kyang yin no// de stobs dang ldan pa las gnod bya 'phel bar 'gyur la/ gud na zas la sogs pa mi 'ju zhing*/ de las gnod byed nyes pa 'phel bas khong nang kun gyi rgyu'i gtso bo ma zhu ba la 'jog pa yang rgyu mtshan de'o// me drod des zas skom ji ltar bzhu ba'i tshul yang*/ dang por zas skom sogs rlung gis lto bar bcug skom gyis bshig snum gyis mnyen par byas/ der me mnyam rlung gis mkhris pa 'ju byed bus te pho ba'i gnas su de dag sman ltar bskol/ bad kan myags byed kyis myags par byas pas ro dngar lbu ba can du gyur nas bad kan skyed/

bar du mkhris pa 'ju byed kyis bzhu nas rnam par 'tsho bas ro skyur bar song nas mkhris pa skyed/ tha mar me mnyam rlung gis dwangs ma dang snyigs ma gnyis su 'byed cing kha bar gyur nas rlung skyed do// lar kha zas de 'byung ba lnga ldan yin pas lus kyi 'byung ba lnga rgyas par byed do// gsum pa zhu rjes kyi dwangs snyigs gnyis su phye nas snyigs ma rgyu mar lhung*/ der ska ba dang sla ba gnyis su phye nas/ dang po gci ba'am phyi sa/ gnyis pa gci ba'am gcin du 'gyur/ dwangs ma de rang gi drod kyis smin nas pho ba nas mchin lam brgyud de dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgur 'gro ba'i/ dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu ni/ sum sman gyis/ pho ba nas mchin pa'i bar du dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa mig dgu yod par bshad kyang*/ don mchin gnas su pho bar dwangs ma khrid pa'i rtsa gcig mchin gnas su mtsher par/ mchin gnas su mkhris par/ mchin gnas su glo bar/ mchin gnas su snying du/ mchin gnas su klad par/ mchin gnas su mchin par/ mchin gnas su mkhal mar/ mchin gnas su bsam ser/ dwangs ma khrid pa'i rtsa dgu 'di las sha khrag 'phel byed rtsa chen nyer bzhir 'gro grag ste/ gzhung las/ dwangs ma rtsa dgur mchin lam brgyud nas 'gro bar bshad pa dang legs par 'grig go /rtsa 'di dag gi sbugs sbom pa sog ma tsam dang*/ phra ba skud pa tsam mo// sbubs dgu po 'di las ci rigs pa zhig bkag pa'am/ ma bkag kyang rlung gis kha zas dwangs snyigs ma phyed par 'dres pa des khong nad phal cher skyed pa yin no// de mchin pa'i gnas su khrag tu 'gyur la/ tshigs ma pho ba'i be snabs/ khrag de'i dwangs ma las sha/ tshigs ma snod/ mkhris sha de'i dwangs ma las tshil/ tshigs ma bu ga'i dri ma/ tshil de'i dwangs ma las rus pa/ tshigs ma rngul lam zhag rus pa de'i dwangs ma las rkang mar/ tshigs ma las so sen ba spu/ rkang mar de'i dwangs ma las khu ba/ tshigs ma lus kyi phyi nang dang bshang gci'i snum pa'i cha/

khu ba de'i dwangs ma mdangs stobs mchog gi rten du 'gyur zhing*/ tshigs ma mngal mi sdug pa la sogs pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro// de'i mdangs kyi rten yang gtso bo snying gar gnas pa ro tsa na'i thig le skyes bu rnams kyi gzi brjid dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rten chen po'o// bzhi pa zas skom ni/ dwangs ma de zhag re la snga ma'i gnas skabs btang nas phyi ma khrag la sogs pa der 'gyur bas/ dang po zos nas phyis khu bar 'gyur ba'i bar gyi dus ni zhag drug go /ro tsa na ni 'phral la khu ba skyed nus pa dang*/ sman gzhan rnams zhag gcig gis las byed pa gtso che'o// gnyis pa gnod byed nyes pa la/ dbye ba dang*/ mngal na gnas tshul/ rang bzhin me drod/ lte ba/ gnas/ las/ mtshan nyid kyi lo 'dab brgyad/ dang po rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ste rnam par ma gyur pas lus gnas pa/ gyur pas lus 'joms par byed pa/ rlung la srog 'dzin sogs lnga/ mkhris pa la 'ju byed sogs lnga/ bad kan la rten byed sogs lnga'o// gnyis pa mngal du nyes pa gsum pha ma'i khu khrag rnam shes dang sbrul dang de'i dug bzhin 'bral mi shes pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa yin no// gsum pa ma'i kha zas dang spyod lam gyis rlung mkhris bad kan shas che chung 'gyur te/ rlung shas che bar gyur na rang bzhin chung ba rlung gi mi/ mkhris shas che na 'bring mkhris pa'i/ bad kan shas che na chen po bad kan gyi/ nyes pa gsum cha mnyam na 'dus pa'i rang bzhin mchog rlung mkhris gnyis che na rlung gi mi las che/ mkhris pa'i mi las chung bas rlung mkhris gnyis kyi bar ma/ de bzhin du bad mkhris gnyis/ bad rlung gnyis te/ ldan pa'i gsum dril bas rang bzhin bdun du 'gyur ro// bzhi pa me drod kyang rlung gis mi snyoms// mkhris pas rno/ bad kan gyis chung*/ 'dus pas mnyam pa'o// lnga pa rlung gis phra/ mkhris pas mnyan/ bad kan gyis bar ma'o// drug pa gnas pa'i lte ba man chad rlung gi gnas/

lte ba dang snying ga'i bar mkhris pa'i gnas/ snying ga yan chad bad kan gyi gnas so// bdun pa spyi dang bye brag tu phye ba dag ste/ dang po/ rlung gis dbugs 'byin rngub dang*/ skyod pa dang*/ las spyod pa dang*/ shugs 'byin pa dang*/ gnod bya rnams legs par rgyu ba dang*/ dbang po rnams gsal ba dang*/ lus rjes su 'dzin pa bdun no// mkhris pas bkres pa dang*/ skom pa dang*/ zas len cing 'ju ba dang*/ lus drod dang*/ mdangs gsal ba dang*/ snying dpa' ba dang*/ blo dang ldan pa byed pa bdun no// bad kan gyis lus brtan pa dang*/ blo brtan pa dang*/ gnyid log pa dang*/ tshigs pa thams cad 'brel ba dang*/ bzod bsran che ba dang*/ lus 'jam pa dang*/ snum pa bdun no// gnyis pa srog 'dzin pa'i rlung gnas spyi bo/ rgyu lam brang dang gre ba/ byed las ni/ zas skom mid pa dang*/ dbugs rngub pa dag mchil ma 'dor pa/ sbrid pa dang sgregs pa 'byin pa dang*/ blo dang dbang po gsal zhing sems kyi 'dzin byed drug gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung gnas brang*/ rgyu ba'i sna lam dang*/ lce dang*/ lkog ma/ byed las tshig 'byin pa dang*/ stobs dang*/ mdangs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ 'bad rtsol dang*/ dran pa gsal bar byed pa drug khyab byed gyi rlung gnas snying*/ rgyu ba'i lam lus kun/ byed las rkang pa 'degs 'jog 'gro ba dang*/ rkang lag lce rnams kyi brkyang bskum dang*/ bu ga rnams 'byed 'dzum dang*/ lus kyi bya byed phal de la rag lus pa'o// me dang mnyam pa'i rlung gnas pho ba'i zangs tshags/ rgyu lam nang khrol kun/ byed las kha zas 'ju ba dang*/ dwangs snyigs 'byed pa dang*/ lus zungs bdun smin par byed pa gsum/ thur du sel ba'i rlung gnas gzhang*/ rgyu ba'i lam long dang lgang pa gsang ba brla nang*/ byed las khu khrag bshang gci mngal na gnas pa rnams 'byin sdom byed pa lnga/ mkhris pa 'ju byed gnas zhu dang ma zhu ba'i bar pho ba'i zangs tshags kyi 'og tu ma'i mgo lte ba'i thad ka

/byed las zas 'ju zhing dwangs snyigs 'byed pa dang*/ lus kyi drod dang mkhris pa mdangs bsgyur la sogs pa bzhi'i grogs byed pa gsum/ mkhris pa mdangs sgyur/ gnas mchin pa/ byed las ni/ dwangs ma la sogs ser ser ram/ khrag gam/ dmar por sgyur ba la sogs pa byed/ mkhris pa sgrub byed gnas snying*/ byed las yid gzhungs pa dang*/ nga rgyal skyed blo dang*/ 'dod pa sgrub pa gsum/ mkhris pa mthong byed gnas mig byed las gzugs mthong bar byed/ mkhris pa mdog gsal gnas pags pa/ byed las pags mdog gsal bar byed pa/ bad kan rten byed gnas brang*/ byed las myang byed la sogs pa lhag ma bzhi'i rten dang*/ chu yi las te lus kyi rlan rnams dang*/ bsil bar byed pa gnyis/ bad kan myags byed gnas pho ba ma zhu ba/ byed las zas skom myags dang 'drul bar byed pa gnyis/ bad kan myong byed gnas lce/ byed las ro tshor bar byed pa/ bad kan tshim byed gnas mgo byed las dbang po lnga po tshim par byed pa/ bad kan 'byor byed gnas tshigs mig kun/ byed las tshigs kun 'byor pa dang*/ brkyang bskum mnyen pa la sogs pa'i don byed pa gnyis so/ brgyad pa rlung mkhris bad kan gsum nyes pa'i mtshan nyid/ rtsub pa dang*/ yang ba dang*/ grang ba dang*/ sra ba dang*/ phra ba dang*/ g.yo ba drug rtsub ba 'phel bas lus kyi reg bya rtsub cing rtse ba dang*/ yang pas lus dang shes pa yang zhing 'gro snying 'dod pa dang*/ grang bas me dang nyi ma la sred cing phrum ser byed pa dang*/ sra bas bcos par dka' ba dang*/ phra bas skad cig la thams cad khyab par rgyu zhing*/ so sen rtsa bug phra mor 'jug pa dang*/ g.yo bas nad mi rtag cing 'gyur ldog mang ba'o// mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid/ snum dang bcas pa/ rno ba/ tsha ba/ yang ba/ dri ma mnam pa/ 'khru ba/ gsher ba bdun no// snum pa 'phel bas lus dang gdong pa snum pa dang*/ rno bas smin par sla ba dang*/ tsha bas lus drod tsha zhing bsil dang skom la dad pa dang*/

yang pas nad 'phel rkyen kyang gnyen po'i kha na yang ba/ dri mnam pas lus la nad dri che ba/ lto ba snyi bas 'khru skyugs dmar ser/ gsher bas gtar khrag dang lud pa la sogs sla zhing mang ba'o// bad kan gyi mtshan nyid snum pa dang*/ bsil ba lci ba/ rngul ba/ 'jam pa/ brtan pa/ 'byar bag can dang bdun no// snum pa 'phel bas phyi nang thams cad snum zhing*/ bsil bas drod chung ba dang*/ lci bas lus sems lci zhing sgyid pa skyur ba dang*/ rngul bas nad dal phus gsog 'jam pas ring nas ldang zug chung ba dang*/ brtan pas 'gyur ldog nyung gsal bar dka' ba dang*/ 'byar bag can gyis gtar khrag lud pa 'khru skyugs thams cad be snabs nal nal por 'ong ba yin no// lnga pa lus kyi las dbye'i yal ga la/ las dang dbye ba'i lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po spyi'i las/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge mi dge lung ma bstan/ bye brag dbang po lngas rang rang yul lnga so sor 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa rten gyi dbye ba pho mo ma ning gsum/ na tshod kyi dbye ba byis pa dar ma rgan po gsum/ rang bzhin gyi dbye ba lngar bshad pa'i rang bzhin bdun no// drug pa lus 'jig ltas kyi yal ga la/ ring pa'i 'chi ltas/ nye ba'i 'chi ltas/ ma nges pa'i 'chi ltas/ nges pa'i 'chi ltas te lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po/ pho nya/ rmi lam/ nad pa'i rnam 'gyur gsum/ snga ma de la yang pho nya bzang ngan/ pho nya yong dus/ sman pa lam du 'jug dus/ lam du 'phrad pa'i ltas bzang ngan/ nad pa'i khyim gyi ltas te lnga/ bar ma de la ngan rnam dbye bzang gsum/ phyi ma la dngos kyi ngan pa/ shugs la bzang po bstan pa gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ nye ba'i ltas dang*/ ring ba'i ltas gnyis/ gsum pa sngar bshad pa'i ltas rnams snang yang*/ sman dpyad kyis bcos pas nad dang mnyam du zhi bar 'gyur ba de'o// bzhi pa nad zhi yang ltas/ mi zhi ba'i bcos mi len pa'am len yang yang yang ldog pa zungs zad sogs ring ba dang nye ba ma nges pa rnams la 'chi bslus bzlog

shin tu nye ba dang nges pa la ni des bzlog pa med do// sdong po gnyis pa 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas la rgyu/ rkyen/ zhugs tshul/ gnas/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i don te yal ga bdun/ dang po la/ ring rgyu dang nye rgyu ste yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ spyi'i rgyu dang*/ khyad par gyi rgyu ste lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po/ rtsa ba'i rgyu ma rig pa/ gnyis pa de las byung ba'i 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags las rlung nad/ zhe sdang las mkhris pa/ gti mug las bad kan/ cha mnyam pa'am gnyis ldan las lus ldan skyed la/ rnam par phye na nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong*/ nad kyang grangs de nyid du 'gyur bas ma rig pa dang ma bral ba'i bar nad 'byung rung du gnas so// gnyis pa rlung mkhris bad kan da lta rnam par ma gyur la/ 'khrugs zad 'phel sogs kyis rnam par 'gyur rung du gnas pa'o// mkhris pa 'khrugs pas lus zungs bsregs te/ 'di ni me'i rang bzhin tsha bas smad du gnas kyang stod du 'bar/ tshad pa'i nad kun gyi 'byung khungs/ bad kan 'khrugs pas lus kyi me drod 'joms te/ 'di nas chu'i rang bzhin lci la bsil bas stod du gnas kyang smad du lhung*/ grang nad kun gyi 'byung khungs/ rlung ni tsha grang gnyis ka'i grogs po/ tsha dus na sreg dang*/ bsil dus na grang ba'i grogs byed/ lus kyi stod smad bar kun tu rgyu/ tsha grang gnyis ka dkrug cing slong pas na/ thams cad kyi 'byung khungs so// gnyis pa rkyen gyi yal ga la/ nad skye zhing mched par byed pa skye mched kyi rkyen/ nad gsog cing ldang yang zhi bar byed pa gsor ldang zhing zhi ba'i rkyen/ bsags pa slong bar byed pas slong ba'i rkyen te yal ga phre'u gsum/ dang po la/ dus dman lhag log pa dang*/ dbang po dman lhag log pa dang*/ spyod lam dman lhag log pa'i lo 'dab gsum/ dang po dus tsha dus grang dus char dus gsum gyi tsha dus su tsha ba chung ba lta bu dman pa/

tsha dus su tsha drags pa lta bu lhag pa/ tsha dus su grang pa lta bu log pa/ de bzhin du grang dus dang*/ char dus la'ang 'gre'o// gnyis pa dbang po lnga yul la cher mi gtod pa dman pa/ shas cher gtod pa lhag pa/ ha cang nye ring che chung 'jig mi sdug pa la gtad pa/ gsum pa lus ngag yid gsum bya ba chung ba'am bya ba la mi sbyor ba dman/ bstud nas 'jug pa lhag pa/ shugs bkag btsir bcus pa mi dge ba rnams log pa'o// gnyis pa la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ dus kyi yal ga phre'u gsum/ dang po la/ rlung gsog ldang zhi/ mkhris pa gsog ldang zhi/ bad kan gsog ldang zhi ba'i lo 'dab gsum/ dang po phyi'i yul nam zla'i dus/ lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa lnga po de rtsub pa dang*/ yang ba/ skya ba/ g.yo ba bzhi/ dro ba dang*/ mtshungs par ldan na rlung gsog par byed de/ rlung gi mtshan nyid dang tshul mthun pas de dag rang gnas su skyed cing 'phel bar byed pas gsog pa zhes bya'o// rtsub sogs bzhi po de dro bar ldan na dro ba de rlung gi gnyen por song nas rlung mgo mnan nas ldang du mi ster/ yang rtsub yang skya g.yo ba bzhi po de dro ba med pa/ grang bar gyur pa de dang mtshungs par ldan na rlung la mgo mnon med par mi mthun phyogs gcig tu song nas rlung bsags pa de ldang bar byed do// snum pa/ dro ba/ brtan pa/ lci ba 'jam pa lnga dang mtshungs par ldan tsa na rlung gi gnyen po phyogs gcig tu song nas rlung zhi bar 'gyur// gnyis pa yul sogs lnga/ rno dro snum gsum bsil ba dang mtshungs par ldan na tsha ba'i mgo mnan nas mi ldang bar rang gnas su gsog rno dro snum pa gsum bsil ba med pas tsha ba dang mtshungs par ldan tsa na mgo gnon med pas mi mthun phyogs gcig tu song nas mkhris pa bsags pa de ldang bar byed do// rngul ba/ grang ba/ bsil ba/ gnyen pa/ sla ba/ skam pa drug dang mtshungs par ldan tsa na mkhris ba'i gnyen po phyogs gcig tu song bas mkhris pa zhi bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa yul sogs lnga/

lci snum/ 'jam rtul/ brtan pa lnga bsil ba dang mtshungs par ldan tsa na bsil ba des bad kan 'khyams pa ltar song nas mgo mnan nas mi ldang bar rang gnas su gsog lci sogs lnga bsil ba med par dro ba dang*/ mtshungs par ldan tsa na mgo gnon med par bad kan gyi mi mthun phyogs gcig tu song nas bad kan ldang*/ rtsub skya yang tsha rno g.yo ba drug dang mtshungs bar ldan tsa na bad kan gyi gnyis po phyogs gcig tu song nas zhi bar 'gyur ro// de dag kyang dper byed na/ dmag rang sar gsog pa dgra yul du 'grim pa/ dmag zhi ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ gsog pa'i ngo bo/ ldang ba'i/ zhi ba'i ngo bo ste lo 'dab gsum/ dang po rlung rang gi gnas ste ba man du'am/ rus pa'i gnas su 'phel ba la sogs pa zhes btags so// de bzhin mkhris pa snying ga dang lte ba'i bar ram/ rngul lam khrag gi gnas su/ bad kan snying ga yan nam/ dwangs ma sha tshil rkang mar kha ba'i gnas su'o// 'phel ba zhes pa yang gnod byed gsum po des rang bzhin du ma ldang bar rgyu las 'khrugs pas mi mthun pa rnams bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu chags su gyur pa de sa bon du byas pa'i nas chu lud drod sogs kyis cher sbos pa lta bu'o// de'i rtags mi mthun pa'i yon tan 'dod pa ste/ rlung gsog pa'i rtags su drod bcud 'dod/ mkhris pa la bsil 'dod/ bad kan la drod 'dod pa'o// gnyis pa/ rlung bsang dogs pa ba de rang gi gnas nas langs nas bad kan nam mkhris gnas su 'tshangs pa dang*/ mkhris pa rang gnas nas langs nas bad kan nam rlung gnas su/ bad kan rang gnas nas langs nas mkhris pa'am rlung gnas su 'tshangs pa ste/ rang gnas ma yin par zhugs pas log pa'i lam du zhugs pa zhes kyang bya'o// rtags ni rlung mkhris bad kan gyi nad rtags rnams so// gsum pa/ 'phel zad zhi nas sngar bzhin mnyam par gyur pa'o// gsum pa la/ rlung log ldang zhi dus/ mkhris pa bad kan log ldang zhi dus kyi lo 'dab gsum/

dang po sos ka yul dus zas spyod kun mtshungs pas rlung gsog dro bas mi ldang dbyar dus grang bas ldang*/ ston dus snum pa dang dro bas zhi bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dbyar dus mkhris pa gsog ste bsil pas dang*/ ston dus ldang ste snum pa dang dro bas dang*/ dgun stod zhi ste bsil bas so// gsum pa bad kan dgun smad gsog ste bsil snum lci bas so// dpyid dus ldang ste dro bas so// sos ka zhi ste yang ba dang rtsub pas so// 'on kyang 'byung ba'i dus la ma bab par zas spyod dbang gis 'phral la 'byung ba'ang yod do// gsum pa la/ thun mong khyad par gyi rkyen gyi lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po 'byung ba'i dus log ba dang*/ gdon dug mi 'phrod pa'i zas zos pa dang*/ nad gsos pa log pa dang*/ sngon las longs pa'o// gnyis pa/ rlung nad kyi slong rkyen/ mkhris pa/ bad kan/ ldan 'dus kyi slong rkyen bzhi'i bzhi pa rlung mkhris lta bu'i slong rkyen gnyis 'dus pa ldan pa'i rkyen dang*/ gsum ka 'dus pa 'dus pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ro// gsum pa zhu tshul la/ nad kyi nyes rgyu gnod bya bcu 'ben lta bu/ rkyen bzhis bzhugs tshul mda' 'phen pa lta bu'i lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po zungs bdun dri ma gsum ste gnod bya bcu yod pa rten dang*/ gnod byed rlung mkhris bad kan gsum brten par 'brel te/ rlung rus la brten/ mkhris pa khrag dang rngul ba/ bad kan lhag ma/ dwangs ma sha tshil rkang mar khu ba lnga/ bshang gci gnyis te bdun la rten pas so// de yang nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kan gsum 'khrugs pas lus zungs bdun nye bar byas te/ nyes pa dang lus zungs gnyis ka log nas dri ma la gnod par byed do// gnyis pa nad rlung dang rgyu mthun pa'i ro kha ba dang nus pa rtsub la yang ba'i zas zos pa'i dwangs ma de/ khyab byed kyi rlung gis gnod bya bcu rgyu ba'i bu ga rnams su gtor ba khrag nas khu ba'i bar du 'gro rgyu la khrag gam tshil bu'i gnas sogs su slebs dus rlung skye ba'i spyod lam byas kyang*/

de dag bad mkhris kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir rlung 'phel ba dang gsog mi nus/ rus pa'i gnas su slebs pa na rlung skyed pa'i spyod lam byas na/ de'i dwangs ma de rlung skye ba'i rgyu mthun pa yin pa dang*/ bu ga de rus pa rlung gi gnas yin pa dang*/ spyod lam rlung skyed pa 'dzom pa'i phyir/ mkha' la sprin 'dus pa bzhin du rlung rus pa'i gnas su 'phel zhing gsog par byed do// char bab pa ltar du bsags pa rlung slong bar byed pa'i rkyen dang phrad na rlung nad nges pa kho nar ldang ngo*// de bzhin du mkhris pa dang rgyu mthun pa'i ro tsha ba/ nus pa rno dro snum pa'i zas zos nas rus gnas su slebs dus mkhris pa skye ba'i spyod lam byas na mkhris pa gsog mi nus/ khrag gi bu gar slebs dus mkhris pa skye ba'i spyod lam byas na/ de'i dwangs ma de mkhris pa skye ba'i rgyu mthun pa yin pa dang*/ bu ga de khrag gi gnas yin pa dang*/ spyod lam mkhris pa skyed pa gsum 'dzoms pas mkhris pa khrag gi gnas der 'phel zhing gsog la/ bsags pa mkhris pa slong bar byed pa'i rkyen dang phrad na mkhris nad nges par ldang ngo*// de bzhin bad kan dang rgyu mthun pa'i ro mngar ba/ nus pa lci bsil gyi zas zos pa'i dwangs ma khrag gam rus gnas su slebs dus bad kan skye ba'i spyod lam byas kyang bad kan 'phel gsog mi nus/ tshil gnas sogs su slebs dus bad kan skye ba'i spyod lam byas na/ de'i dwangs ma de bad kan skye ba'i rgyu mthun pa yin pa dang*/ bu ga bad kan gyi gnas yin pas dang*/ spyod lam bad kan skyed gsum 'dzoms pas tshil gnas sogs su bad kan 'phel zhing gsog la/ bsags pa bad kan slong ba'i rkyen dang phrad na bad kan nges par ldang ngo*// de dag kyang 'jug sgo drug nas 'jug ste/ pags la gram/ sha la rgyas/ rtsa ru rgyug rus la zhen/ don la babs/ snod du lhung nas bde ba med pa'i nad du 'gyur ro// bzhi pa gnas kyi yal ga la/

spyi'i gnas/ bye brag gi /khyad par gyi gnas kyi lo 'dab gsum/ dang po gong du rlung mkhris bad kan gyi rten du bshad pa dag ste/ rnam par mi gyur pa dang gyur pa gnyis ka'i gnas pa yin pas spyi'i gnas zhes bya'o// gnyis pa dpyi rkang tshigs reg bya rna ba lnga/ rlung rnam gyur gyi rgyu lam/ pho ba/ dwangs ma/ chu ser/ mig pags pa lnga/ mkhris pa rnam gyur gyi rgyu lam/ brang*/ mgul/ glo ba/ sna/ lce lnga/ bad kan rnam gyur gyi rgyu lam mo// gsum pa rlung zhu ba'i gnas long*/ mkhris pa zhu ba dang ma zhu ba'i bar rgyu stod na/ bad kan ma zhu ba'i gnas pho bar/ pho bar zas zhu yang dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa'i phyir der ma zhu ba'i gnas/ rgyu stod der zas skom zhu dwangs snyigs phyed kyang snyigs ma de rgyu mar zhu nas ska sla gnyis su 'byed dgos pa'i phyir/ zhu ba dang ma zhu ba'i gnas snyigs ma long du song ba de zhu zin pas de zhu rgyu med pa'i phyir zhu ba'i gnas zhes tha snyad bzhag go /lnga pa nad kyi mtshan nyid la/ 'phel zad kyi rgyu/ 'phel zad kyi mtshan ma/ 'khrugs pa'i rtags te yal ga phre'u gsum/ dang po la/ nyes pa'i 'phel zad/ lus zungs kyi/ dri ma'i/ 'phel zad de lo 'dab gsum/ dang po spyir nad kyi mtshan nyid ni/ don bya don byed 'phel zad 'khrugs pa ste/ 'phel ba rgyas pa yin la/ zad pa ni 'grib pa/ 'khrugs pa ni gnas dang byed las 'chol ba yin no// de yang zas mi 'phrod pa zos pa'am/ spyod lam mi 'phrod pa byas pas nyes pa 'phel/ zas spyod mi 'phrod pa spangs pa'i 'phrod pa sbyin zhing spyad pas nyes pa zad par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa pho ba'i me drod de mnyam par rang gnas na 'dug na de'i cha shas kyi drod re lus zungs kun la gnas pas de dag 'bar bas lus zungs 'phel/ me drod bri bas zungs rnams zad par 'gyur ba'o// gsum pa/ mang po 'byung ba 'phel ba/ thog pa zad pa'o/ gnyis pa 'phel zad kyi mtshan ma la 'phel ba'i mtshan ma'i rtags

/zad pa'i mtshan ma'am rtags te yal ga phre'u las kyang phre'ur gyes pa gnyis/ dang po la/ nyes pa 'phel ba'i rtags/ lus zungs/ dri ma 'phel ba'i rtags te lo 'dab gsum/ gnyis pa la/ nyes pa zad rtags/ lus zungs/ dri ma/ mdangs zad pa'i rtags te lo 'dab bzhi/ gsum pa 'khrugs pa'i rtags la/ rlung 'khrugs pa'i rtags/ mkhris pa/ bad kan 'khrugs pa'i rtags te lo 'dab gsum/ drug pa nad kyi dbye ba la/ rgyu'i sgo nas dbye ba/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba ste yal ga phre'u gsum/ dang po la/ tshe 'di'i nyes pa/ sngon gyi las/ de gnyis 'dres pa'i lo 'dab gsum/ dang po rang bzhin gnas pa/ khong gi nyes pa/ rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyi rkyen las byung glo bur nyes pa dug mtshon gdon gsum drug yod do// gnyis pa la/ skyes pa'i nad/ bud med kyi/ byis pa'i/ rgas pa'i/ kun khyab thun mong pa'i nad rigs te yal ga phre'u las phre'ur gyes pa lnga/ dang po la/ khu ba/ rlig blugs/ pho mtshan gyi nad de lo 'dab gsum/ dang po de la zad pa dang blugs pa gnyis/ gnyis pa de la rlung gyur/ mkhris gyur/ bad kan/ tshil/ gcin gyur/ rgyu blugs te drug gsum pa de la/ sos zin/ 'bum pa can 'dud drug dbugs 'byar dra ma can dang lnga/ dang po rlung mkhris khrag bad kan/ 'dus pa/ lngar phye ba nad dgu ste yongs dril bcu bdun/ gnyis pa la/ mngal nad/ tsha bas/ skran/ srin te lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan/ 'dus pa las gyur pa lnga/ gnyis pa la/ snying gi khrag tshabs/ glo ba'i/ mchin pa'i/ mtsher pa'i/ mkhris pa'i/ mkhal ma'i/ rgyu ma'i/ 'o ma'i/ nu ma'i/ khrag tshabs gor ba ste khrag tshabs bcu/ mgo bo'i rlung tshabs/ rus pa'i/ snying gi mkhal ma'i/ pho ba'i/ rgyu ma'i/ rlung tshabs te rlung tshabs drug dril bas tsha bas sam rtsa nad bcu/ gsum pa la/ mngal skran/ chu bur can/ khrag skran hrem po/ sha skran bem po/ sme skran/

pho skran rengs pa/ skran ro nag po/ rtsa skran ling pa/ sa bon skran/ khrag skran khu ba ste tsha bas skran dgu/ bzhi pa la/ srin ma ru tsa langs pa/ srin a so khros pa ste gnyis/ yongs dril mo nad la so gnyis/ gsum pa byis pa'i nad la gsor mi rung pa lhan skyes kyi nad dang*/ glo bur ba'i lo 'dab gnyis su dbye yod kyang dang po bzhag nas glo bur ba la/ rags pa/ phra ba/ zhib tshegs te lo 'dab gsum/ snga ma la/ brang nad/ glo mchin/ 'khru skyugs/ rims/ lte ba/ rte'u'i nad brgyad/ bar ma la/ mgo skrangs/ gre 'gags/ mtsher mkhris/ pho long zas zos/ zhes res kyi nad brgyad/ phyi ma la/ mig nad/ rna ba/ kha/ smin bu/ srog rtsa/ sha/ srin/ phol nad brgyad bsdoms pas nyer bzhi'o// bzhi pa rgas nad la/ 'byung ba gud pa ste lo 'dab gcig lnga pa kun khyab thun mong gi nad la/ nyes pas dbye ba brgya dang gcig gtso bos dbye ba/ gnas gyis dbye ba/ rigs kyis dbye ba brgya dang gcig gtso bo'i dbye ba/ gnas kyis dbye ba/ rigs kyis dbye ba brgya dang gcig ste lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po la yang*/ rtsa ba rgyu mkhris pa bad kan gsum/ dang po la spyi bye brag gnyis/ spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ a warta/ da rgan phyi dgye/ da rgan nad dgu/ 'gram pa nyams pa/ lce ldib/ phyogs gcig gug pa/ rtsa 'dzin/ phyogs gcig bskams pa/ lus kun bskams pa/ shing rengs/ dpung 'ja'/ pi sha rtse/ sra 'theng*/ brlab rengs/ lce spyang mgo tsher ma/ gzungs 'khums/ khi la/ rkang rtse/ rkang pa tsha ba ste nyi shu/ gnyis pa gnas kyi dbye ba la/ pags pa la 'gram pa dang*/ sha la rgyas pa dang*/ rtsa la rgyug pa dang*/ rus la zhen pa dang*/ don la babs pa dang*/ snod du lhung ba dang*/ dbang po lnga la me tog shar pa ste bdun/ bye brag gi phye ba la/ srog 'dzin sogs rkyang pa lnga/ de mkhris pa dang 'dres pas lnga/ bad kan dang 'dres pas lnga ste bco lnga yongs dril bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis so// gnyis pa mkhris pa'i nad la yang*/

spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ nad gzhi'i mkhris pa thang la lhags pa/ me drod kyi mkhris pa gzhan gyis gnas gyur pa/ snod kyi mkhris pa kha lung kha shor/ thun mong gi mkhris pa rtsa la rgyug pa ste bzhi'i/ gnyis pa la gnas kyi dbye ba ni/ pags gram la sogs pa bdun/ bye brag gi phye ba/ 'jug byed la sogs pa rkyang pa lnga/ de rlung dang 'dres pa lnga/ de bad kan dang 'dres pa lnga ste mkhris nad nyi shu rtsa drug go /gsum pa bad kan gyi nad la/ rang rgyud can dang*/ gzhan rgyud can gnyis/ dang po la/ spyi bye brag gnyis/ spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po bad kan lhen dang*/ me drod nyams pa dang*/ mgul 'gags dang*/ grum bu dkar po dang*/ bad kan 'ju skem dang drug /gnas kyi dbye ba ni/ pags la gram pa sogs bdun no// bye brag myags byed sogs lnga/ rlung dang bsdoms pas lnga/ de mkhris pa dang bsdoms pas lnga ste bco lnga/ gnyis pa gzhan rgyud can la/ bad kan ser po dang*/ smug po gnyis/ phyi ma la/ byer ba/ rgyas pa/ rdol ba/ 'gyings pa bzhi ste bsdoms pas bad kan gyi nad la sum cu rtsa gsum dril bas brgya dang gcig gnyis pa gtso bos dbye ba brgya dang gcig ni rtsa ba/ rang rgyud can dang gzhan rgyud can gnyis/ dang po la/ rlung 'phel ba/ rlung rab tu 'phel ba/ rlung mchog tu 'phel ba gsum/ mkhris pa 'phel ba/ rab 'phel/ mchog 'phel/ bad kan 'phel ba/ rab 'phel/ mchog 'phel te 'phel ba dgu/ rlung zad pa/ rlung rab tu zad pa/ rlung mchog tu zad pa ste gsum/ mkhris pa zad pa/ rab zad/ mchog zad/ bad kan zad pa/ rab zad/ mchog zad de zad pa dgu nad rkyang pa'i 'phel zad bco brgyad do// gnyis pa gzhan rgyud can la/ ldan pa/ 'dus pa/ bla gnyan gyi nad gsum/ dang po la/ nyes pa gnyis dang ldan pas ldan pa zhes bya la/ de la rlung mkhris ldan pa cha mnyam du 'phel ba/ bad mkhris ldan pa/

bad rlung ldan pa cha mnyam du 'phel ba ste/ cha mnyam du 'phel ba gsum/ rlung mkhris ldan pa'i rlung rab tu 'phel zhing mkhris pa lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ rlung dang bad kan du ldan pa'i rlung rab tu 'phel zhing bad kan lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ mkhris pa dang rlung du ldan pa'i mkhris pa rab tu 'phel zhing rlung lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ mkhris pa dang bad kan du ldan pa'i mkhris pa rab tu 'phel zhing bad kan lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ mkhris pa dang rlung du ldan pa'i mkhris pa rab tu 'phel zhing rlung lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ mkhris pa dang bad kan du ldan pa'i mkhris pa rab tu 'phel zhing bad kan lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ bad kan dang rlung du ldan pa'i bad kan rab tu 'phel zhing rlung lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ bad kan dang mkhris par ldan pa'i bad kan rab tu 'phel zhing mkhris pa lhag par 'phel ba ste/ gcig tu 'phel zhing cig shos lhag par 'phel ba drug go /rlung mkhris ldan pa'i cha mnyam du zad pa/ bad mkhris ldan pa'i cha mnyam du zad pa/ bad rlung ldan pa'i cha mnyam du zad pa ste cha mnyam du zad pa gsum/ rlung mkhris ldan pa'i nang nas rlung rab tu zad cing mkhris pa lhag par zad pa dang*/ rlung dang bad kan ldan pa'i nang nas rlung rab tu zad cing bad kan lhag par zad pa dang*/ mkhris pa dang rlung du ldan pa'i nad nas mkhris pa rab tu zad cing rlung lhag par zad pa dang*/ mkhris pa dang bad kan du ldan pa'i nang nas mkhris pa rab tu zad cing bad kan lhag par zad pa dang*/ bad kan dang rlung du ldan pa'i nang nas bad kan rab tu zad cing rlung lhag par zad pa dang*/ bad kan dang mkhris pa ldan pa'i nang nas bad kan rab tu zad cing mkhris pa lhag par zad ste/ gcig rab tu zad cing gcig shos lhag par zad pa drug ste ldan pa'i 'phel zad bco brgyad/ gnyis pa ni/ nyes pa gsum ka 'dus pas 'dus pa zhes bya la/ de la nyes pa gsum cha mnyam du 'phel ba'i 'dus pa gcig

rlung rab tu 'phel zhing mkhris pa 'bring du 'phel ba bad kan mtha' mar 'phel ba'i 'dus pa dang*/ rlung rab tu 'phel zhing bad kan 'bring du 'phel ba mkhris pa mtha' mar 'phel ba'i 'dus pa dang*/ mkhris pa rab bad kan 'bring rlung tha mar 'phel ba'i 'dus pa dang*/ mkhris pa rab rlung 'bring bad kan mtha' mar 'phel ba dang*/ bad kan rab rlung 'bring mkhris pa mtha' mar 'phel ba'i 'dus pa dang*/ bad kan rab mkhris pa 'bring rlung mtha' mar 'phel ba'i 'dus pa ste rab 'bring mtha' gsum sbyar ba'i 'dus pa drug 'dus nad las rlung mkhris gnyis lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ bad mkhris gnyis lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ bad rlung gnyis lhag par 'phel ba ste gnyis lhag par 'phel ba'i 'dus pa gsum dang*/ 'dus nad las rlung lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ mkhris pa lhag par 'phel ba dang*/ bad kan lhag par 'phel ba ste gcig lhag par 'phel ba'i 'dus pa gsum ste/ de ltar 'dus pa'i 'phel ba bcu gsum/ nyes pa gsum cha mnyam du zad pa gcig rlung rab tu zad cing mkhris pa 'bring du zad la bad kan mtha' mar zad pa dang*/ rlung rab tu zad la bad kan 'bring du zad cing mkhris pa mtha' mar zad pa dang*/ de bzhin mkhris pa rab bad kan 'bring rlung mtha' mar zad pa dang*/ mkhris pa rab rlung 'bring bad kan mtha' mar zad pa dang*/ bad kan rab rlung 'bring mkhris pa mtha' mar zad pa dang*/ bad kan rab mkhris pa 'bring rlung mtha' mar zad pa ste rab 'bring mtha' mar sbyar ba la zad pa drug ste/ 'dus nad las/ rlung mkhris gnyis lhag par zad pa dang*/ bad mkhris gnyis lhag par zad pa dang*/ bad rlung gnyis lhag par zad pa ste gnyis lhag par zad pa'i 'dus pa gsum/ 'dus nad las/ rlung gcig pa lhag par zad pa dang*/ mkhris nad gcig go /bad kan gcig pa lhag par zad pa ste gcig lhag par zad pa'i 'dus pa gsum ste zad pa bcu gsum/ dril bas 'dus pa'i 'phel zad nyi shu rtsa drug rlung 'phel zhing mkhris pa zad la bad kan mnyam pa dang*/

rlung 'phel zhing bad kan zad la mkhris pa mnyam pa dang*/ mkhris pa 'phel zhing bad kan zad la rlung mnyam pa dang*/ mkhris pa 'phel rlung zad bad kan mnyam pa dang*/ bad kan 'phel zhing rlung zad la mkhris pa mnyam pa dang*/ bad kan 'phel zhing mkhris pa zad la rlung mnyam pa ste 'phel zad 'dres pa drug rlung zad cing bad mkhris gnyis 'phel ba dang*/ mkhris pa zad cing bad rlung gnyis 'phel ba dang*/ bad kan zad cing rlung mkhris gnyis 'phel ba ste gcig zad gnyis 'phel gsum/ rlung 'phel zhing bad mkhris gnyis zad pa dang*/ mkhris pa 'phel zhing bad rlung gnyis zad pa dang*/ bad kan 'phel zhing rlung mkhris gnyis zad pa ste gcig 'phel gnyis zad gsum ste/ de rnams bsdoms pas 'phel zad bdun cu don bzhi'o// bla gnyan ni/ nad sngar yod kyi steng du nad gzhan 'byung bas bla gnyan zhes brjod/ de la zhugs pa dang*/ log pa dang*/ 'dom pa'i dbye bas dgu tshan gsum ste/ dang po zhugs pa dgu ni/ rlung gi gnas su mkhris pa rkyang pa zhugs pa dang*/ bad kan rkyang ba zhugs pa dang*/ bad mkhris gnyis ldan par zhugs pa dang*/ mkhris pa'i gnas su rlung rkyang pa zhugs pa dang*/ bad kan rkyang pa zhugs pa dang*/ bad rlung ldan par zhugs pa dang*/ bad kan gyi gnas su rlung rkyang pa zhugs pa dang*/ mkhris pa rkyang pa zhugs pa dang*/ rlung mkhris ldan par zhugs pa ste rnam pa dgu'o// log pa'i bla gnyan ni/ nad rang nyid ma zhi bar gzhan du log pa la bya ste/ de dag dgu ni rlung ma zhi bar bad kan rkyang par log pa dang*/ mkhris pa rkyang pa zhugs pa dang*/ rlung mkhris ldan par zhugs pa ste rnam pa dgu'o// nad sna gnyis gsum 'thab pa la 'doms pa zhes bshad de/ de dgu ni/ rlung gis mkhris pa'i gnas phyogs nas bad kan dang 'thab pa dang*/ rlung gis bad kan gyi gnas phyogs nas mkhris pa dang 'thab pa dang*/ rlung gis rang gnas bzung nas bad mkhris ldan pa la 'thab pa dang*/

de bzhin du mkhris pas rlung gi gnas phyogs nas bad kan dang 'thab pa dang*/ mkhris pas bad kan gyi gnas phyogs nas rlung dang 'thab pa dang*/ mkhris pa rang gnas bzung nas bad rlung ldan pa la 'thab pa dang*/ de bzhin du bad kan gyis rlung gi gnas phyogs nas mkhris pa dang 'thab pa dang*/ bad kan gyis mkhris pa'i gnas phyogs nas rlung dang 'thab pa dang*/ bad kan gyis rang gnas bzung ste rlung mkhris ldan pa la 'thab pa ste dgu'o// de ltar bla gnyan gyi nad nyi shu rtsa bdun no// bsdoms pas brgya rtsa gcig go /gsum pa gnas kyi dbye ba brgya dang gcig ni/ rtsa ba sems la gnas pa'i nad dang*/ lus la gnas pa'i nad gnyis las/ sems la gnas pa'i nad ni myos byed dang*/ brjed byed gnyis so// lus la gnas pa ni/ lus kyi stod dang*/ smad dang*/ phyi dang*/ nang la gnas pa ste/ de'i nang nas lus kyi mgo la gnas pa ni/ mgo bo'i nad spyi dang*/ mig nad dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ mchu dang*/ so dang*/ lce dang*/ ske'i lba ba dang*/ bad kan gyi nad dang dgu /gre ba'i nad la/ na ba dang*/ gag pa dang*/ mgul 'gags dang*/ skad 'gags pa dang bzhi/ nam tshong gi nad la skom dang*// skyigs bu dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ cham pa ste lus stod kyi nad la dbye ba bco brgyad do// lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i nang ni/ snying dang*/ glo ba dang*/ mchin pa dang*/ mtsher ba dang*/ mkhal ma dang*/ pho ba dang*/ mkhris pa dang*/ rgyu ma dang*/ long dang*/ lgang pa dang bcu'i steng du bud med la mngal skyes pa la bsam se'u ste don snod kyi nad bcu gcig don snod spyi la gnas pa'i nad ni/ ma zhu ba dang*/ glang 'thabs dang*/ skran dang*/ sur ya dang*/ tshad 'khru dang*/ rgyu gzer dang drug go /sgos su snod spyir gnas pa ni/ 'khru ba dang*/ skyugs pa ste bsdoms pas don snod kyi nad rigs bcu dgu'o// lus kyi smad la gnas pa'i nad ni/ gzhang 'brum dang*/

mtshan bar rdol ba dang*/ rtug 'gags dang*/ gcin 'gags pa dang*/ gcin snyi ba dang rnam pa lnga'o// lus kyi phyi la gnas pa'i nad kyi nang nas pags pa la gnas pa'i nad ni/ sha bkra dang*/ bas bldags dang*/ g.yan pa dang*/ glang shu dang*/ za kong dang*/ shu ba dang*/ reg pa'i dug dang*/ 'dzer pa dang*/ do khab dang*/ nad gzhan pags pa la gram pa bcu/ sha'i nad la lba ba dang*/ rmen bu dang*/ nad gzhan sha la rgyas pa dang gsum/ 'di'i lba ba ma yin gyi lus gzhan gyi lba ba ston pa yin no// rtsa ba'i nad ni/ rtsa dkar gyi nad dang*/ rtsa nad kyi nad dang*/ nad gzhan rtsa la rgyug pa dang gsum mo// rus pa'i nad la/ dreg dang*/ rkang 'bam dang*/ nad gzhan rus la zhen pa gsum yin zhing*/ sha rus kun la khyab pa'i nad rigs ni/ grum bu'i nad de phyir gnas pa'i nad rigs nyi shu'o// lus kyi phyin nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad ni/ mkhris pa dang*/ smug po dang*/ dmu chu dang*/ 'or dang*/ skya rbab dang*/ gcong chen zad byed dang*/ tsha ba ma smin pa dang*/ rgyas tshad dang*/ stongs tshad dang*/ gab tshad dang*/ rnyings tshad dang*/ snyogs tshad dang*/ 'grams dang*/ 'khrugs dang*/ rims kyi nad dang*/ 'brum bu dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ sbyar dug dang*/ rdzi dug dang*/ gzer gyi dug dang*/ rlungs dug dang*/ sha dug dang*/ mi 'phrod pa'i dug dang*/ btsan dug dang*/ rtsi dug dang*/ srin bu'i dug dang*/ sbru+ul dug dang*/ khyi dug dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon dang*/ gza' nad dang*/ mdzer nad dang*/ 'bras dang*/ me dbal dang*/ srin dang*/ mgo bo'i rma dang*/ de bzhin du byang khog dang*/ yan lag dang*/ ske'i rma ste lus kyi phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad rigs sum cu rtsa bdun te bsdoms pas brgya dang gcig go /bzhi ba rigs kyi dbye ba la brgya dang gcig ni/ khong nad/ rma nad/ tshad nad/ thor bu'i nad bzhi las/ dang po la/ ma zhu ba rgyu/ gcong nad 'bras bu gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ rigs/ grogs/ dus kyi nad bzhi/ gnyis pa la/

gcong nad gsar rnying gnyis/ dang po la/ bad kan skya bo/ smug po/ mkhris pa/ dug gcod rnam pa bzhi/ dang po bad kan lhen sogs drug gnyis pa la/ byer ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ gyen du rdol ba dang*/ 'thur du ral ba dang*/ 'gyings pa dang*/ 'dril ba dang*/ gab pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ 'or du lhung ba dang*/ grang ba lding chad dang bcu'o// gsum pa la/ thang la lhag pa sogs bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ tsha sbyor dang grang sbyor gnyis so// gnyis pa gcong nas rnyed pa la/ skran dang*/ dmu chu dang*/ 'or dang*/ skya rbab dang*/ zad byed dang*/ dang po la/ khrag skran/ mkhris pa'i/ lhen gyi/ rdo'i/ rlung gi srin gyi/ rtsa'i/ chu'i skran dang brgyad do// gnyis pa la/ byer pa'i chu dang*/ zags pa'i/ mkhris pa'i chu dang gsum mo// gsum pa la/ tsha 'or dang grang 'or gnyis so// bzhi pa la/ glo ba skya rbab dang*/ snying*/ mchin pa/ mtsher pa/ chu ser skya rbab dang lnga'o// lnga pa la/ rlung dang*/ mkhris pa dang*/ bad kan dang*/ bla gnyan bzhi ste khong nad la bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad do// gnyis pa rma la/ lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ glo bur ba'i rma gnyis so// dang po la/ 'bras dang*/ rmen bu dang*/ sur ya dang*/ rkang 'bam dang lnga'o// me dbal dang*/ gzhang 'brum dang*/ rlig blugs dang*/ mtshan par rdol ba'i rma dang brgyad/ gnyis pa la/ gnas dang rigs gnyis kyi/ gnas ni mgo dang*/ byang khog dang*/ yan lag dang gsum yin la/ rigs kyi sgo nas bshus pa dang*/ bcad pa dang*/ rnam par bcad pa dang*/ 'phyang ba dang*/ lhung ba dang*/ phug pa dang*/ gshags pa dang*/ grugs pa dang brgyad de/ de ltar rma'i dbye ba bcu dgu'o// gsum pa tshad pa la/ tsha ba ma smin pa dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ stongs tshad dang*/ gab tshad dang*/ rnyings tshad dang*/ rnyongs tshad dang drug 'grams pa la/ lus kyi phyi 'grams pa dang*/ nang 'grams pa gnyis/ 'khrugs la/ rgyas 'khrugs dang*/ stong 'khrugs dang*/ 'jam 'khrugs dang gsum mo// rims kyi nad la/ bal nad dang*/ rgyu gzer dang*/
