'brum pa dang*/ gag lhog dang*/ cham pa dang lnga ste/ de ltar tsha ba'i nad rigs bcu drug go /'thor bu'i nad dang*/ skad 'gags dang*/ skyigs bu dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ skom dad che ba'i nad dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ glang thabs dang*/ srin gyi nad dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ skyugs pa dang*/ dri ma 'gags pa dang*/ gcin 'gags dang*/ gcin snyi ba dang*/ tshad 'khru dang*/ dregs dang*/ grum bu dang*/ chu ser dang*/ rtsa dkar dang*/ pags pa'i nad dang bcas bas bco brgyad/ de dril bas brgya dang gcig ste gso yul gyi nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ de re re yang gzhan dbang bcos kyang 'chi ba/ kun brtags gdon gyi nad rim gros grol ba/ yongs grub ma bcos na 'chi la bcos na 'tsho ba ltar snang ma bcos kyang rang bzhin gyis 'tsho ba bzhir phye bas stong drug brgya bzhi'o// gsum pa la/ nad grangs med par dbye ba dang*/ tsha grang gnyis su bsdu ba ste lo 'dab gnyis/ gnod bya bcu/ nyes pa bco lnga/ rkyang pa ldan dus du mar 'byung bas na brgyad khri bzhi stong dam dpag tu med par 'gyur la/ de dag thams cad kyang grangs ming sogs rgyal ba 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul lo// gnyis pa nyes pa ci tsam bshad kyang rlung mkhris bad kan gsum las mi 'da' la/ bad rlung gnyis grang ba/ mkhris pa tsha ba ste gnyis su ma 'dus pa med do// nad kyi gnas ni/ gnod byar 'du ba yin no// bdun pa so so'i don la/ rang rang skyed pa'i rgyu/ nad kyi byed brag mi phyed pa'i sngar tshul nad rtags gsal ba'i tshul phyed pa/ rang gnas mthar thug shugs rdzogs pa skyel du gyur pa ste lo 'dab bzhi/ phyi ma'ang rnam grangs brtags pa/ gtso bo stobs bzhir phye ba yin no// gsum pa bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas kyi sdong po la/ rgyun spyod/ dus spyod/ gnas skabs kyi spyod pa ste yal ga gsum/ dang po la/ tshe rkyang pa'i spyod lam/ 'jig rten mi chos kyi spyod lam dam pa lha chos kyi spyod lam ste yal ga phre'u gsum/

dang po la/ rgyun du bde bar gnas shing tshe bsring ba'i phyir bsrung ba/ bcang ba nad kyi slar rkyen spangs/ 'gro 'dug thabs/ nyal po thabs/ sku byug bya thabs/ rtsol bas bcag thabs/ dril phyis bya thabs/ khrus bya thabs/ mig dang glo bur ba'i nad la skyel ma brtan pa ste lo 'dab dgu /gnyis pa la/ yon tan gyi gzhi mi chos bstan pa dang*// de spyod pa'i phan yon te lo 'dab gnyis/ gsum pa la/ dam pa'i chos la 'bad pa'i rgyu'i gtso bor bshes gnyen bsten pa/ sdig pa spong ba/ dge ba sgrub pa/ rang rgyud 'dul ba ste lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa dus spyod la/ dus mtshams nyi ma'i bgrod pas gzung ba dang*/ nam zla dus drug gi spyod lam ste/ yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ dus kyi rtsis bgrod pa gnyis su sman gyi nus pa zad 'phel bstan pa ste lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po dus mtha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma gcig de'i skad cig ma drug cu la thang gcig thang sum cu la yud tsam gcig yud tsam sum cu la nyin zhag gcig nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig zla ba bcu gnyis la lo/ de la yang dgun dpyid dbyar gsum/ dgun la dgun stod dgun smad/ dpyid la dpyid dang sos ka /dbyar la dbyar dang ston te drug de re re la/ zla ba gnyis/ bzhir phye na/ dgun dpyid dbyar ston/ de re re la/ ra ba/ 'bring po/ tha chung re zla ba gsum gsum yod/ dbyar dgun nyi ma gang la ldog ra ba/ ston dpyid nyin mtshan gang la mnyam par ra ba brtsi'o// 'dir nyi ma brgyad gsum zhes pa ni rags par brtsis pa ste/ snron gyi ra ba'i tshes brgyad la dbyar nyi ldog na/ dgun nyi mgo'i tshes brgyad la ldog go /nyi ldog gi bar ram dbus kyi brgyad la nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung ste dbo dang khrums so// bsdoms pas brgyad gsum zhes pa'o/ de yang byang du bgrod pa mthun drug pa'i tshe/ nyi ma'i gdung gcig bsil ba'i ri la reg pa zhes gsungs te/

don nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang gling gi dbus drang por sleb dpang bsil ri dang mnyam de tsam nas dbyar nyi ldog de nas nyi ma lhor bgrod pa'i zla ba gsum na ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung zhing*/ de nas yang zla ba gsum nyi ma lho gling gi lho'i tshangs thig khar sleb/ gdung gcig rta gdong rgod ma kha'i me dang dpang mnyam pa de tsam nas dgun nyi ldog de nas nyi ma byang du 'gro ba'i zla ba gsum nas dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung bas dbus nas log pa zhes bya'o// rnam gzhag 'di'i phal ni mngon pa dang phal cher mthun no// bod lta bur dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam nas zhag brgyad na 'brug gi sgra grag ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i zhag bcu na 'brug gi sgra chad do zhes gtso bo che ba la dgongs nas gsungs so// zhib mor brtsi ba dus kyi 'khor lo bzhin du'o// gnyis pa byang du bgrod par tshugs nas nyi ma rlung gi nus pa 'phel nas shin tu rno tsha rtsub par gyur nas des zla ba dang po'i yon tan mnan nas lci rtul bsil ba zhi/ dgun smad ro tsha ba/ dpyid kha ba/ sos bska ba stobs dang ldan pa ste ro phul du phyin par 'gyur ro// mi rnams kyi me drod bri bas stobs je chung 'gro /lhor bgrod par zug nas zla ba stobs dang ldan te nyi ma'i nus pa mnan pas/ char babs rlung gis tsha ba zhi bar byas nas dbyar ro skyur ba/ ston lan tsha/ dgun mngar ba stobs skye'o// mi'i me drod 'phel bas stobs kyang skye'o// gnyis pa nam zla dus drug gi spyod lam la/ dgun stod kyi spyod lam/ dgun smad kyi/ dpyid kyi/ sos ka'i/ dbyar gyi/ ston gyi spyod lam ste lo 'dab drug gsum pa gnas skabs kyi spyod lam la/ bkres pa bcos pa/ skom pa/ skyugs pa/ sbrid pa/ g.yal ba/ dbugs/ gnyid/ lud pa/ mchil ma/ 'phyen/ bshang ba/ gcin/ khu ba bkag pa bcos pa ste lo 'dab bcu gsum/ bzhi pa 'tsho ba zas kyi sdong po la/

zas kyi tshul shes pa/ zas bsdam pa/ zas tshod ran par za ba ste yal ga gsum/ dang po la/ zas kyi tshul shes pa dang*/ skom gyi tshul shes pa'i yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ 'bru'i sde/ sha'i/ snum gyi/ sdo ngad kyi/ g.yos kyi sde ste lo 'dab lnga/ zas skom legs par spyad pas lus dang srog 'tsho/ dman pa'am/ lhag pa'am/ log par spyad pas nad dang srog 'joms par 'gyur ba zhes spyir bshad nas/ lo 'dab dang po de la/ gram can dang lgang bu can gnyis/ gnyis pa de la/ khron rko ba/ mchu rko ba/ ri dwags/ gcan gzan/ rtsal mthus za ba/ mis bdag pa/ khung du gnas pa/ brlan la gnas pa ste brgyad/ gsum pa la/ mar/ til mar/ rkang mar/ tshil bzhi/ bzhi pa de la/ ros phye ba tsha kha gnyis/ gnas kyis phye ba skam gsher du skyes pa gnyis so// lnga pa de la/ thug pa/ 'bras yos/ zan/ skyur g.yos/ tshod ma/ tshang spod kyi sde dang drug go /gnyis pa skom gyi tshul shes pa/ rlung sel bad kan skyes pa 'o ma zho'i sde/ mkhris sel bad rlung skyed pa chu'i sde/ bad kan sel mkhris pa skyed pa chang gi sde ste lo 'dab gsum/ gnyis pa zas bsdams pa la/ dug ldan gyi zas bsdam pa dang*/ mi 'phrod pa'i zas bsdam pa'i yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ srog 'tsho'i slob dpon gzhag pa/ dug yod med brtag pa/ stag re ba po 'chag tshad pa la brtag pa/ yod par dgos na dor ba ste lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ mi 'phrod pa'i nus pa gang dang gang mi 'phrod pa dug tu 'gyur ba/ mi 'phrod pa rten 'phrod pa spong dgos na ji ltar bya ba'i lo 'dab ste gsum/ mtha' ma 'dir 'dris goms sgo nas cha yi bslab par bya zhes pa la/ grangs gyi bslab pa dang goms nas bslab pa gnyis/ dang po zhag dang po mi 'phrod pa cha gsum/ 'phrad pa gcig gnyis par mi 'phrad pa gcig pu/ gsum par phyed ma/ bzhi lnga gnyis la mi 'phrod pa gcig pu/ drug par 'phrad pa gsum/ mi 'phrod pa gcig bdun brgyad dgu bcu la mi 'phrod pa kho na bcu gcig pa dang po ltar/

bcu gnyis par 'phrod pa gcig pu/ bcu gsum par phyed ma/ bcu bzhi bco lnga par kho na'o// gnyis pa dang po mi 'phrod pa gsum/ 'phrod pa gcig bar du phyed ma/ mtha' ma 'phrod pa gsum/ mi 'phrod pa gcig ma goms kyi bar du'o// gsum pa zas tshod ran par za ba la/ zas tshod zin pa'i ngo bo/ ma zin pa'i rkyen/ ji ltar 'dzin pa/ rjes la skom bsten tshul te lo 'dab bzhi/ lnga pa sbyor ba sman gyi gnas la/ sman ro/ zhu rjes nus pa/ sbyar thabs bstan pa ste yal ga bzhi/ dang po la/ rten dbye ba/ ngo bo/ sde tshan las te yal ga phre'u bzhi/ dang po la/ ro'i rten/ so so'i rgyud/ 'byung ba so so'i nus pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ dang po sman gyi spyi tsam gyi rten 'byung ba lnga yin te/ sas gzhi rten/ chus brlan cing gsher/ mes drod 'phel zhing smin/ rlung gis g.yo 'gul gyis bskyod nas nam mkhas go phye ste skye bar 'gyur la/ de yang rgyu dus su 'byung ba lnga ka tshogs kyang de la shas che chung yod pas 'bras dus kyi ro tha dad pa dang*/ de dag kyang gang shas che ba de dang de'i ming du btags te sa sman zhes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa rgyu dus su 'byung ba lnga char tshogs kyang 'byung ba gnyis shas che ba las 'bras bu ro tha dad du skye ba'i tshul gang zhe na/ sa chu shas che ba las mngar ba/ me las skyur ba/ chu mes lan tshwa/ chu rlung gis kha ba/ me rlung gis tsha ba/ sa rlung gis bska ba skyed do// gsum pa sa sman gyis/ lus lci/ brtan/ rtul/ 'jam/ snum/ skam/ mkhrang*/ brtas/ 'dus pa ste yan lag mkhregs shing sra ba rlung gi nad sel ba'o// chu sman gyis/ lus kyi sla/ bsil/ lci/ rtul snum/ 'jam/ gnyen/ brlan/ zas 'drul zhing myags pa dang*/ sems tshim zhing ngoms pa dang*/ tshigs dang yan lag sdud cing 'byor par byed pa dang*/ mkhris nad sel lo// me sman gyis/ tsha/ rno/ skam/ rtsub/ yang*/ snum/ g.yo/ lus kyi drod skyed pas zas 'ju ba dang*/

smin par byed pa dang*/ mdangs skyed pa dang*/ bad kan sel bar byed pa'o// rlung sman gyis/ yang*/ rtsub/ grang*/ g.yo/ skya ba/ skam pa/ sra zhing skyed pa dang*/ thams cad du khyab par byed pa dang*/ bad mkhris sel ba'o// nam mkha'i ni 'byung bzhi'i sman la spyir khyab pa ste/ khong stod dang*/ yang pa dang*/ go 'byed pa dang*/ ro drug po shas cher skyed pas 'dus nad sel bar byed pa'o// sman du mi 'gyur ba'i 'byung rdzas med ces bstan no// de yang skyugs sman lta bu gyen du 'dren pa'i sman rnams ni me dang rlung gi sman/ bkru sman lta bu 'thur du 'byin pa'i sman rnams ni sa dang chu'i sman yin zhing phyi ma ro mngar bas shas cher skyed do// gnyis pa mngar ba dang*/ skyur ba dang*/ lan tshwa dang*/ kha ba dang*/ tsha ba dang*/ bska ba dang lo 'dab drug lus srog 'tsho bar byed pa'i stobs/ gong ma gong ma che ba/ dper na rgas gzhon gyi gral rim lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi ngo bo ste lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po lce'i dbang po'i myang bya'i yul du gyur pas ro zhes bya'o// gnyis pa mngar ba'i ro ni myang zhing lce dang 'phrad pa na kha la chags shing 'byar bad kan du 'gyur sred pa skye ba dang*/ skyur ba so rtse/ bzhin sdud pa/ kha chu 'dzag pa/ lan tshwa/ lce dang gre ba la reg na tsha ba/ mchil ma lug kha bas kha'i dri ma sbyong ba dang*/ skyug bro bas yi ga bzlog pa'o// tsha ba ni lce dang rkan gyi sbubs sreg pa ste tsha tsag tsag byed pa dang*/ mig chu 'dzag pa'o// bska ba ni lce dang rkan la chags pa mnyam byed pa dang*/ rtsub snyam pa dang*/ bem bem pa dang*/ gre ba dang rtsa'i sbugs 'gags par byed do// bzhi pa la/ shing mngar rgun 'brum sogs mngar ba'i sman gyi sde tshan/ si 'bru ltar bu sogs skyur ba'i/ rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa sogs lan tshwa'i/ nim pa tig ta sogs kha ba dang*/ na le sham dang bca' lga sogs tsha ba dang*/

tsan dan dang a ru ra la sogs pa bska ba'i sde dang*/ ga bur la sogs pa ldan pa'i ro ste lo 'dab bdun/ lnga pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi lo 'dab gnyis/ spyir mngar skyur lan tshwa gsum gyis rlung 'joms/ kha bska mngar bas mkhris pa sel/ tsha skyur lan tshwas bad kan sel lo// bye brag ldan pa'i ro mngar bas rlung mkhris/ skyur pas bad rlung*/ bska bas bad mkhris/ rkyang pa'i ro'i lan tshas rlung*/ kha bas mkhris pa/ tsha bas bad kan sel lo// de bas na nad ldan pa gsum gyi gnyen por ldan pa'i ro dang*/ rkyang pa gsum gyi gnyen por rkyang pa'i ro gsum bshad do// 'o na 'dus pa'i nad la yang gnyen po 'ong rigs na de mi ston pa ci yin zhes brgal na/ 'dus ba'i nad la rkyang pa gsum sdebs gcig tu sbyar kyang chog ldan pa gsum po sdebs gcig tu sbyar kyang chog drug ka sdebs gcig tu sbyar kyang chog pas gnyen po sgos su ma bstan no// 'o na ldan pa'i nad la yang gnyen po bshad mi dgos te gnyis gnyis sbyar bas chog pas so zhe na/ de ni mi rigs te/ tsha ba dang lan tshwa sdeb tu btub kyang*/ lan tshwa dang kha ba gnyis sam/ kha ba dang mi 'phrod pas sdeb tu mi btub bo// mngar pa'i ro las skyes nas 'phrod pa dang*/ lus zungs mthu stobs bskyed pa byis pa rgan sdebs so// gre nad glo nad rnams la phan pa dang*/ mdangs bkrag dbang po bzang lus rtas pa dang*/ rma 'byor pa dang*/ tshe ring 'tsho bar byed pa dang*/ snum pa dang*/ dug dang*/ rlung mkhris sel ba yin la/ bstan bcos las bud med kyi nu zho skyed pa'ang bshad do// ha cang bsten drags na/ bad kan las byung pa'i nad dang*/ tshil bu skyed cing*/ me drod 'bri/ lus sbom pa ste ha cang 'phel ba/ gcin nad lba ba rmen bu sogs skyed do// skyur ba'i las me drod skyed/ yi ga 'byed/ tshigs 'phrul pa/ gcod pa/ 'ju ba reg pa bsil/ rlung 'gags rgyu bar byed pa sogs so// ha cang bsten drags na lus lhod/

mig rab rib/ mgo 'khor skya rbab/ 'or med pa la/ g.yan pa 'thor bu'i/ skom rigs skyed/ lan tsha'i las sra ba 'byin/ 'khyil ba 'byin/ 'gags pa 'byin par byed/ snum dang dugs kyi/ rngul dang*/ rno/ yi ga 'byed cing*/ ma zhu ba gcod par byed/ ha cang bsten drags na/ skra byi/ sha skem/ gnyer ma mang*/ stobs 'bri/ skom dad dang*/ mdze nad dang*/ dug me dbal/ khrag mkhris skyed do// 'dir sra ba zhes pa ni/ rengs shing 'gyur mi shes pa/ 'khyil ba bshad ba sogs 'gags pa/ 'gags pa ni rtsa sbubs 'gags pa zhes bshad do// kha ba'i las/ yi ga 'chus ba ste rang zhe ma zhim pa/ srin skom dug /mdze brgyal ba/ rims/ rlon/ mkhris pa rnams 'joms/ 'drul ba dang*/ tshil dang*/ zhag /rkang*/ bshang gci/ skom/ yid gzhungs/ nu nad dang skad 'gags pa sel la/ bstan bcos las bad kan yang sel bar bshad do// ha cang bsten drags na/ lus zungs zad/ rlung nad dang bad kan gyi nad skyed do// tsha bas lkog nad/ gag pa/ mdze/ ma zhu/ 'or nad sel/ rma 'jig drod skyed/ 'ju byed/ yi ga 'byed/ tshil dang 'drul bag skem pa sbyor zhing zas 'jig pa/ sbubs 'byed pa/ 'chi ba spyod pa/ bad kan sel ba rnams so// ha cang bsten drags na/ khu ba stobs zad/ lus 'khums 'dar skems/ brgyal zhing rked pa rgyab sogs na bar byed do// bska ba'i las khrag mkhris bad kan sel/ tshil dang 'drul bag skem/ rma 'tsho/ bsil/ pags mdog dwangs/ bsten drags na/ be snabs 'khyil ba/ bshang ba sri ba/ lto sbo ba/ snying nad skems dang rtsa sgo 'gag bstan bcos las ro tsa nyams par bshad do// mdor bsdu na/ mngar ba'i ros rlung sel/ 'bru rnying skam sha ma gtogs pas bad kan skyed par bshad kyang*/ dmigs bsal g.yag rgod nya lug sha dang sbrang rtsis de la phan pa yod do// skyur bas bad kan sel/ mkhris pa skyed kyang dmigs bsal skyu ru ra yis khrag mkhris tsha ba sel ba yod do// lan tshwas bad rlung sel yang*/

dmigs bsal lce myang rgyam tshwa ma gtogs pas mkhris pa skyed la/ ha cang bsten drags na lci bas bad kan skyed/ kha bas mkhris pa sel bad rlung skyed kyang*/ dmigs bsal ka rañja dang sle tres kyis bad rlung sel ba yod do// tsha bas rlung dang bad kan sel/ sgog skya pi pi ling min bas mkhris pa skyed/ dmigs bsal bad kan la mi phan pa kong lga lta bu/ ha cang drags na yang ba dang rtsub bas rlung skyed do// bska bas mkhris pa sel/ dmigs bsal tsan dan smug po lta bu/ a ru ra phal cher bad rlung gnyis la gnod do// gnyis pa zhu rjes la dngos dang*/ nyes pa sel tshul te lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po mngar ba zhu rjes dus su yang sa chu shas che ba las ma 'gyur bas zhu rjes mngar ba'o// de bzhin du skyur ba me dang sa las ma 'gyur bas zhu rjes gnyis ga skyur ba'o// kha ba yang chu dang rlung las ma 'gyur bas ro dang zhu rjes gnyis ka kha'o// lan tshwa ni me dang chu gnyis las skyed pa las zhu rjes dus su me yi stobs 'bri bar 'gyur te/ sa chu shas che bas mngar ba'o// tsha ba ni me rlung gnyis las skyed pa yin yang*/ zhu rjes su me bri ste rlung gi stobs su 'gyur bas/ rlung shas che bas ro kha bar zhu ba'o// bska ba ni sa dang rlung las gyur ba yin yang*/ zhu rjes dus su stobs chur 'gyur te/ chu rlung stobs che bas kha bar zhu ba'o// dmigs bsal ro dang zhu rjes mthun par bshad pa la/ mi mthun pa yang 'byung*/ mi mthun par bshad pa la mthun par byung ba yang yod do// gnyis pa nyes pa gsum po gnyis gnyis re res sel/ zhes pas zhu rjes re res nyes pa gnyis gnyis 'joms pa ste/ zhu rjes mngar bas rlung dang mkhris pa gnyis sel/ skyur bas rlung dang bad kan/ kha bas bad kan dang mkhris pa/ kha bas bad kan sel mi rig zhes rgol na/ mi rigs pa ma yin te/ kha ba de yang la rtsub pas bad kan lci la 'jam pa 'joms/ 'o na ro yi dus su mkhris pa sel la bad kan la gnod par bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/

ro yi dus su rdzas kyi dngos po rang rgyud du yod pas rtsub yang gnyis las bsil ba stobs che bas gnod pa yin la/ zhu rjes dus su me drod gsum gyis bzhus pas bsil nus pa bri nas yang rtsubs stobs che bar 'gyur bas te/ dper na rgya bod kyi khyad bzhin no// gsum pa sman nus pa bstan pa la/ ro nus spyir bshad pa dang*/ ngo bo bye brag tu bshad pa'i yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ nus pa/ stobs/ yon tan gsum ste yal ga phre'u las kyang phre'ur gyes pa gsum/ dang po la/ rnam grangs/ nad sel tshul/ nad skyed pa'i tshul te lo 'dab gsum gyi dang po/ lci yang gnyis/ snum rtsub gnyis/ rno rtul gnyis/ tsha bsil gnyis te brgyad do// gnyis pa lci snum gnyis kyis rlung sel/ bsil rtul gnyis kyis mkhris pa/ yang rtsub tsha rno bzhis bad kan sel lo// lci snum gnyis la dro ba mi 'dug pas rlung la cang phan nam snyam na/ rlung zung du 'jug pas lci la dro dang*/ snum la dro ba gnyis kyis rlung nad bad kan dang bsdongs pa sel/ lci la bsil dang snum la bsil ba gnyis kyis rlung nad mkhris pa dang ldan pa sel lo// bsil drod gang rung gcig dang mi ldan pa'i lci rtul mi srid pas so// gsum pa bad kan sel ba'i yang rtsub gnyis/ mkhris pa sel ba'i bsil gsum gyis rlung skyed par byed do// rlung gi mtshan nyid dang tshul mthun pas so// bad kan sel ba'i tsha rno gnyis/ rlung sel ba'i snum pa dang gsum gyis mkhris pa skyed de/ de'i mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i phyir ro// lci snum bsil rtul bzhis bad kan skyed de/ de'i mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i phyir ro// de ltar brgyad po de yon tan bcu bdun gyi nang nas snying por gyur pa dang*/ nad kyi steng du nus mthu phul du byung bas mthu 'am nus pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa stobs la/ gnas kyi dbang du byas pa'i bsil drod/

lus kyi dbang du byas pa'i bsil drod phul du gyur pa'i lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po ri gangs can lta bu gnas bsil bas de'i sman bsil ba/ 'bigs byed dro bas de'i sman dro ba/ gnyis pa dus zla ba stobs su gyur pa'i dbang gis bsil ba dang*/ nyi ma stobs su gyur pa'i dbang gis tsha ba phul du byung ba'o// de las tsha bas grang nad dang*/ bsil bas tshad nad sel bas de gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i sman med do// gsum pa yon tan ni/ rnam grangs dang rgyu mtshan gyi lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jam pa/ lci/ dro/ snum/ brtan/ grang*/ rtul/ bsil/ mnyen/ sla/ skam/ skya/ tshwa/ yang*/ rno/ rtsub/ g.yo ba ste rlung sel ba'i yon tan lnga/ mkhris pa sel ba'i yon tan drug bad kan sel ba'i yon tan drug ste bcu bdun/ de la rlung sel ba'i yon tan lnga la/ 'jam pa ni rlung rtsub pa'i gnyen po ste/ sle tres kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 'bras thug yos thugs lta bu'o// lci ba ni/ rlung yang ba'i gnyen po ste/ kha ro tshwa dang*/ bu ram dang*/ rus rnying dang*/ zan skam gyi tshod ma lta bu'o// dro ba ni/ rlung grang ba'i gnyen po ste/ gsar 'jam dang*/ zwa tshod dang*/ lhug gog gi tshod ma/ lug sha lta bu'o// snum pa ni/ rlung phra ba dang sra ba'i gnyen po ste/ gsar 'jam dang*/ zwa tshod dang*/ lhug gog gi tshod ma/ lug sha lta bu'o// snum pa ni/ rlung phra ba dang sra ba'i gnyen po ste/ mar dang*/ 'bru mar dang*/ rkang mar dang tshil la sogs pa lta bu'o// brtan pa ni rlung g.yo ba'i gnyen po ste/ dza ti/ sgog skya/ la phug la sogs pa lta bu'o// mkhris pa sel ba drug la/ grangs bshad pa la/ grang ba'i dngos por skya bcas bcug nas/ skya bcas ni mkhris pa snum bcas kyi gnyen po ste/ phye thug rdor med dang dral thug rtsam skyo dang chu grog la sogs pa skyon med rnams so// rtul ba mkhris pa rno ba'i gnyen po ste/ cu gang*/ ut+pal/ go dor/ bong nga dkar dmar la sogs pa skom sman dang dug rnams so// bsil ba ni mkhris pa tsha ba sel ba'i gnyen po ste/

ga bur/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ gi'u wang*/ tig ta/ hong len la sogs pa rnams so// mnyen pa ni mar gsar pas mkhris pa yang pa sel ba'am/ chu grang dang*/ ja dang*/ ba'i zho dar dang*/ mar gsar pa dang*/ skyabs dang*/ khur tshod rnams so// sla ba ni mkhris pa dri mnyam pa'i ste bshal sman rnams so// skam pa ni mkhris pa 'khru gsher gyi gnyen po ste/ 'bru bcud thams cad do// bad kan sel ba drug la/ skya ba ni/ bad kan snum pa'i gnyen po/ sran ma/ sran chung*/ cong zhi lta bu'o// tsha ba ni bad kan bsil ba'i ste/ na le sham dang*/ tsi tra ka dang*/ sman lga shing kun la sogs pa'o// yang ba ni bad kan lci ba'i ste/ g.yer ma dang*/ gsar yos/ thug pa dang*/ chu skol la sogs pa lta bu'o zhes bshad pa la/ de rnams kyis lci ba sel mi nus te/ me bzhi yun du brten pa ni lci ba sel ba'i yang ba yin no zhes 'ga' zhig zer ro// rno ba ni bad kan rtul ba'i ste/ rgya tshwa dang*/ chang dang*/ bong nga nag po dang*/ sngo tsha ba gsum lta bu'o// rtsub pa ni bad kan 'jam dang 'byar bag can gnyis kyi ste/ star bu dang*/ cong zhi rgod rtul dang*/ nya sha phag sha la sogs pa'o// g.yo ba ni bad kan brtan pa thams cad kyi gnyen po ste/ skyugs sman thams cad de ltar bcu bdun po des nad kyi mtshan nyid nyi shu 'joms pa'i phyir yon tan zhes bya'o// de yang snum pa/ skam pa/ rtsub pa gsum gyis nad kyi mtshan nyid gnyis gnyis 'joms pa yin no// don dril na/ rlung sel ba'i sman gang la 'jam pa lci ba dro ba snum med mi srid/ mkhris pa sel ba'i sman la bsil rtul grang ba med mi srid/ sla skam gnyis dus dang bstun te gar dgos spyad pa'o// bad kan sel ba'i sman la tsha rno yang rtsub skya ba lnga med mi srid/ g.yo ba nad dang bstun pa'o// de ltar yon tan las bcu bdun las ro'i las byed pa rnams ni 'byung ba gnyis gnyis las byung ba yin pas nus pa zhu rjes kyang ro'i rjes su 'byung ngo*// zhu rjes dang nus pa las byed pa rnams ni 'byung ba shas che chung yod pas ro'i rjes su mi 'brang ngo*// ro'i rjes su 'byung ba de dag gi rten yang*/

dang po mngar ba sa chu gnyis las byung bas sa la nus pa drug chu la bdun te bcu gsum yod pa'i gnyis kar lci rtul/ 'jam/ snum pa yod pa'i lci ba gnyis nang phrad pas gcig tu 'dril te/ shin tu lci bar 'gyur pa bzhin lhag ma gsum la yang 'dra bas nus pa brgyad bzhir song*/ chu'i sla ba dang sa'i skam pa gnyis go log pas 'thab pas skam pa 'di stobs 'bri/ sla ba'i nus pa 'thon 'ong ste/ sla ba chu'i nus pa bdun gyi che shos yin pas dang*/ skam pa sa'i nus pa drug gi chung shos yin pas so// sa'i brtan pa dang chu'i bsil mnyen gnyis gcig tu mi 'dra la 'thab kyang mi 'thab/ de ltar rgyu'i nus pa bcu gsum la 'bras bu'i nus pa brgyad 'byung ba ste/ snum lci 'jam brtan bzhis rlung sel/ sla bsil rtul mnyen bzhis mkhris pa sel bas/ mngar ba de rlung mkhris sel ba ldan pa'i ro yin te/ brgyad ka bad kan skyed par byed/ zhu rjes dngar bar zhu'o// skyur ba me las byung bas sa la nus pa drug me la bdun te bcu gsum yod pa'i gnyis ka'i skam snum gnyis 'dril/ sa'i lci ba dang me'i yang ba/ me'i rtsub pa dang sa'i 'jam pa/ me'i rno ba dang sa'i rtul ba/ sa'i brtan pa dang me'i g.yo ba rnams 'thab pas/ yang ba/ 'jam pa/ rtul ba/ g.yo ba bzhi gtor/ me'i tsha ba dang sa'i brtan pa gcig mi 'thab mi 'dril bas rgyu'i nus pa bcu gsum la 'bras bu'i nus pa bdun byung ba'i tsha rno rtsub gsum bad kan sel/ snum lci brtan gsum gyis rlung sel bas bad rlung gnyis sel ba'i ldan pa'i ro/ skam pas 'khru gsher la phan pa yang*/ mkhris tshad dbal tshogs pa'i rdzas la yin gyis dang po nas min no// tsha rno snum gsum gyis mkhris pa lhag par skyed/ zhu rjes skyur bar zhu'o// lan tshwa me chu gnyis las byung ba'i me chu gnyis ka nus pa bdun bdun te bcu bzhi yod pa'i gnyis ka snum pa 'dri/ me'i skam pa/

chu'i sla ba/ me'i tsha ba dang*/ chu'i bsil ba/ me'i dro ba dang chu'i rtul ba/ me'i yang ba dang chu'i lci ba gnyis rnams 'thab pas/ sla ba dang*/ bsil ba dang*/ rtul ba dang*/ yang ba rnams gtor/ me'i g.yo ba chu'i mnyen pa mi 'dril mi 'thab pas rgyu'i nus pa bcu bzhi la 'bras bu'i nus pa brgyad byung ba'i rno dro rtsub g.yo bzhis bad kan sel/ snum lci dro gsum gyis rlung sel/ sla mnyen gyis mkhris pa sel ba'i skabs srid kyang dro rno snum dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i tshe mkhris pa skyed pas nus pa brgyad yod kyang phan thogs pa bdun/ ha cang bsten drags na bad kan skyed pas/ rlung sel ba rkyang pa'i ro zhes rnam par bzhag la/ zhu rjes dngar bar zhu'o// kha ba chu rlung gnyis las byung ba yin pas/ chu la nus pa bdun/ rlung la drug ste grang bsil 'dres nas shin tu bsil ba/ chu'i lci ba/ rlung gi yang ba/ chu'i 'jam pa/ rlung gi rtsub pa/ rlung gi skam pa/ chu'i sla ba gnyis rnams 'thab pas yang ba dang*/ 'jam pa dang*/ skam pa rnams gtor/ chu'i snum pa mnyen rtul/ rlung gi skya g.yo mi 'drel mi 'thab pas rgyu'i nus pa bcu gsum la 'bras nus bdun byung pa'i sla bsil rtul mnyen bzhis mkhris pa sel/ yang rtsub g.yo ba gsum gyis rlung skyed/ bad kan la yang rtsub g.yo ba bzhi spyir phan kyang 'di bsil ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa yin pas gnod do// de'i phyir mkhris pa sel bad rlung skyed pa rkyang pa'i ro/ zhu rjes kyang kha bar zhu'o// tsha ba me rlung gnyis las byung ba yin pas/ me la nus pa bdun rlung la drug ste bcu gsum yod pa'i gnyis ka'i yang rtsub skam g.yo 'dril/ me'i tsha ba/ rlung gi grang ba/ me'i snum pa/ rlung gi skya ba 'thab pas grang snum gtor/ me la rno ba lhag pa de ltar rgyu'i nus pa bcu gsum la 'bras nus bdun byung ba'i yang rtsub tsha rno skya g.yo drug gis bad kan sel/

tsha bas grang ba sel/ ha cang drags na yang rtsub g.yo bas rlung nad skyed/ skam pas mkhris pa sel/ yang rno ba dang mtshungs par ldan pas mkhris pa skyed pa bad kan sel/ rlung skyed pa rkyang pa'i ro/ zhu rjes kha bar zhu'o// skam pa sa dang rlung las gyur ba yin pas/ sa la nus pa drug rlung la drug ste bcu gnyis yod pa'i skam 'dril/ sa'i 'jam pa dang rlung gi rtsub pa 'thab pas 'jam pa gtor/ sa'i lci snum rlung gi yang skya mgo mnyam nus pa med/ sa la rtul ba rlung la grang ba lhag pas rgyu nus bcu gnyis las 'bras nus lnga byung ba'i grang rtul skam gsum gyis mkhris pa sel/ rtsub pas bad kan sel/ grang rtsub gnyis kyis rlung skyed pas bad mkhris sel/ rlung bskyed pa rkyang pa'i ro/ zhu rjes kyang kha bar zhu'o// zhu rjes dang rus pas las byed pa'i sman rnams ni ro drug gang yin yang rgyu ste/ rlung sel ba'i sman rnams chu me gsum gyis skyed pas te/ snum 'jam lci brtan dro ba lnga 'byung ngo*// mkhris pa sel bar byed pa'i sman ni sa chu rlung*/ gsum gyis skyed pas te/ grang rtul bsil mnyen sla skam drug 'byung*/ bad kan sel bar byed pa'i sman rnams ni me rlung gnyis las skyed pas te/ tsha yang rno rtsub g.yo skya drug 'byung*/ de la mngar bska kha ba gsum bad kan la mi gnod na tsha bar zhu'o// tsha skyur bska ba gsum bad kan la mi phan na zhu rjes mngar bar zhu'o// mngar skyur lan tshwa gsum rlung la phan na kha bar zhu'o// kha bska tsha ba gsum rlung la mi gnon na tsha bar zhu'o// kha mngar bska bas mkhris pa la mi phan na zhu rjes tsha bar zhu'o// tsha skyur lan tshas mkhris pa la mi gnod na zhu rjes bska bar zhu'o// de ci'i phyir na/ phan gnod nus pa rnams kyis zhes ni mngar skyur kha gsum gzhu ba'i phyir ro// nus mthu brgyad po la che chung yod dam med ce na/ yod do// skyur ba la sa'i lci ba/

lan tshwa la chu'i lci ba yod pas mnyam yang rdzas kyi dngos po lci bar gnas pas 'di skyur ba las skyur ba'i lci'o/ lan tshwa shin tu lci bar bshad pa zhig kyang byung bas de dang 'gal zhe na mi 'gal te/ mngar ba lci yang bsil ba dang mtshungs par ldan pas grang ba 'joms ma nus/ lan tshwa'i lci ba dro bas grang yang gnyis 'joms nus pa'i phyir bzhi der de lci bar bshad pa yin no// skyur mngar la lan tshwa gsum rgyu'i 'byung ba gnyis gnyis yod pa'i drug kar snum pa yod par mtshungs kyang 'bras dus su snga ma las ches che ba'i khyad par 'byung ba ni mngar ba las skyur ba dro/ skyur pa las lan tshwa dro bas/ ji tsam dro ba des snum pa'i nus pa 'thon 'ong bas so// mkhris pa sel ba'i nus ba tsha rtul gnyis la/ bska bas rlung las gyur pas nus pa grang ba tsam de bas mngar ba bsil te/ sa chu las gyur pas chu'i bsil ba yod la/ snga ma'i bsil ba las de stobs che ba'i phyir ro// de bas kyang kha ba bsil te/ chu rlung las gyur bas chu'i bsil ba/ rlung gi grang ba 'dril bas shin tu bsil ba yin no// ro bska ba sa rlung las 'gyur bas sa'i rtul ba yod do// de bas kha ba rtul te chu klung las byung ba chu'i rtul ba yod pas so// snga phyi gnyis la rgyu'i rtul ba re rer mnyam pa las 'bras dus su khyad 'byung ba ci yin zhe na/ bska ba bas kha ba bsil che bas rtul ba'i nus pa cher 'thon/ mkhris pa 'drul ba mi 'drul par byed pa ste/ don las myur du byed mi ster ba yin no// mngar ba de bas kyang rtul te sa chu gnyis las byung ba/ rgyu gnyis ka la rtul ba yod pas gcig tu 'dril nas shin tu rtul ba'o// bad kan sel ba'i rtsub yang rtsub tsha rno bzhi las/ skyur ba yang la rtsub ste sa me las byung ba tsha rno rtsub gsum gyis 'ju sla ba'i yang ba'am/ grogs lan tshwa dang bsdebs pas yang la/ sa'i 'jam pa me'i rtsub bas gtor nas rtsub pa 'then pa'i khar/

skyur ba'i rno tsha gnyis kyis rbad pas lhag par rtsub pa 'ong*/ de bas tsha ba ches yang pa rtsub ste/ me rlung las byung ba/ me rlung gnyis ka la yang rtsub gnyis gnyis yod pa 'dril ba dang*/ rtsub pas tsha rno gnyis kyi grogs byas pas so// de bas kyang kha ba yang la rtsub ste/ chu rlung las byung ba chu'i lce 'jam/ rlung gi yang rtsub gnyis kyis gtor nas grang bsil g.yo ba gsum gyis yang rtsub stobs skyed pas so// 'grel ba mkhan po dag bska skyur tsha gsum rim pas yang la rtsub ces bsgyur cing*/ gzhung las skyur ba bas tsha ba yang la rtsub par bshad pa bad kan la dgongs/ tsha ba bas kha ba yang la rtsub pa rlung skyed pa la dgongs zhes 'don no// skyur ba sa me gnyis las byung ba me che rno gnyis/ de bas lan tshwa tshwa la rno ste chu me gnyis las byung bas me la rno/ gnyis ka las dro ba 'byung la/ 'ju ba'i nus pa yang 'di rno bas so// tsha ba de las kyang tsha la rno ste/ me'i tsha ba rlung gi grang ba 'thab pas tsha ba'i nus pa 'thon me la rno ba lhag pas so// de ltar ro nus pa gsum mthun na ma bcos pa'i sman zhes bya ste nad kyi steng du stobs che/ ka ra bu ram lta bu ro mngar mnyam la/ dang po bsil/ gnyis pa dro ba lta bu/ ro drug po kun la yod pa ni/ rten stobs las 'byung ba zhes bya ba rgyu 'byung ba shas che chung gis ro re re la drug drug tu phye ba sum cu rtsa drug nas mtha' yas pa'i bar du 'gyur pa bzhin nus pa yang 'dra bas so// gyur pa las byung ba zhes bya ba chu las chang ngam/ 'o ma las zho lta bu dang po'i ro las phyis kyi rkyen gyis 'gyur ba rnams so// sbyar ba'i dbang las byung ba zhes bya ba/ thang phye ril bu sogs sbyor ba'i grogs kyi nus pas so sor 'don pa ste/ se 'bru brgyad pa'i rigs so so lta bu'o// ro nus zhu rjes gsum mi mthun pa nus pa dbang ches pas nus pas zhu rjes zil gyis gnon/

zhu rjes kyis ro zil gyis gnon/ gang zil gyis mnan pa de'i nus pa mi 'thon/ ro nus zhu rjes mthun na ro'i las byed pa'i rjes su 'byung ba zhes bya'o// ro bzhin du song na gnod par rigs pa la mi gnod pa rnams zhu rjes kyi las byed pa ste/ mngar yang bad kan la mi gnod pa/ skam pa'i sha lta bu la sogs pa'o// ror bshad pa ltar phan rigs pa la mi phan par gnod pa dang*/ gnod par rigs pa la phan pa ro las go ldog pa ste/ nus pas las byed pa zhes bya ste/ mngar yang rlung la gnod pa shing mngar lta bu sogs so// de ltar shes par byas nas ros las byed pa'i sman rnams ro ltar bsdebs te sbyar/ zhu rjes dang nus pa bsdebs mi dgos/ nus pas las byed pa rnams la nus pa bsdebs pa zhu rjes kyis las byed pa rnams la zhu rjes bsdebs pa sde tshan lnga'am bdun bzhin du'o// gnyis pa ngo bo bye brag tu bshad pa la/ rin po che'i sogs kyis bstan pa ste/ rin po che'i sman dang*/ rdo/ sa/ shing*/ rtsi/ thang*/ sngo/ srog chags kyi sman gyi nus pa ste lo 'dab brgyad do// bzhi pa sbyar thabs la/ sman gyi sde tshan/ ro sbyor/ nus sbyor gyi lo 'dab ste gsum/ dang po ga pur tsan dan sogs kyis/ gnyis pa la ro sdebs sogs kyis gnyis su sbyar ba la bco lnga/ gsum par sbyar ba la nyi shu/ bzhi par sbyar ba'i bco lnga/ lnga par sbyar ba la drug drug par sbyar ba la drug ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun/ de ltar du rkyang bar sbyar ba drug bsnan pas re gsum mo// rkyang par sbyor ba drug ni/ mngar ba gcig pu sbyor ba/ skyur ba/ lan tshwa/ kha ba/ tsha ba/ bska ba gcig pu sbyor ba dag go /gnyis su sbyor ba bco lnga ni/ mngar ba la sbyor ba lnga/ skyur bar bzhi/ lan tshwa gsum/ kha ba gnyis/ tsha ba gcig go dang po mngar ba de skyur ba dang sbyar ba/ de bzhin lan tshwa/ kha tsha/ bska ba dang sbyar ba dag go /gnyis pa mngar ba bor nas skyur ba lan tsha dang sbyar ba/

de bzhin kha tsha bska ba dang po/ gsum pa skyur ba bor nas lan tshwa dang kha ba sbyar ba/ tsha ba bska ba'o// bzhi pa lan tshwa bor nas kha ba dang tsha ba sbyar ba dang*/ bska ba'o// lnga pa kha ba bzhag ste tsha bska sbyar ba'o// gsum du sbyar ba nyi shu ni/ mngar ba la sbyor ba bcu/ skyur ba la drug lan tshwa ba la gsum/ kha ba la gcig go /dang po mngar skyur gyis gzhi byas lan tsha dang sbyar ba/ de bzhin kha tshwa bska ba la ste bzhi/ skyur ba bor nas mngar lan tshwa kha ba sbyar/ tsha skam la ste gsum/ skyur lan tshwa gnyis bor nas/ mngar kha tsha bar sbyar/ bska bas te gnyis/ skyur lan tshwa kha gsum dor nas/ mngar tsha bska ba dang sbyar ba gcig go /gnyis pa mngar ba bzhag nas skyur lan tshwa kha ba dang sbyar ba/ tsha skam la ste gsum/ lan tshwa bor skyur kha tsha ba dang sbyar/ bska ba gnyis/ lan tshwa kha ba gting gzhag nas/ skyur tshwa bska ba sbyar ba gcig go /gsum pa mngar skyur bor nas/ lan tshwa kha ba tsha bar sbyar ba dang*/ bska gnyis kha ba bor/ lan tshwa tsha ba bska bar sbyar ba gcig go /bzhi pa kha tsha bska gsum sbyor ba gcig go /bzhi pa sbyor ba bco lnga ni/ mngar sbyor bcu/ skyur sbyor bzhi/ lan tshwa sbyor ba gcig ste/ dang po mngar skyur lan tshwa gsum gyis gzhi byas kha ba dang sbyar ba/ tsha bska la ste gsum/ mngar skyur kha ba gsum tsha bar sbyar ba/ bska ba la ste gnyis/ mngar skyur tsha bska sbyar ba gcig mngar lan tshwa kha ba dang*/ tsha ba dang sbyar ba dang*/ bska ba pa gnyis/ mngar lan tsha kha ba tsha bar sbyar ba gcig mngar lan tshwa bska ba gcig go /gnyis pa skyur lan tshwa gsum tsha ba dang sbyar/ bska ba ste gnyis/ skyur lan tshwa bska dang sbyar ba gcig skyur kha tsha bska sbyar ba gcig go /gsum pa lan tsha kha tshwa bska pa sbyar ba gcig go /lnga sbyar drug ni/ mngar ba'i lnga/ skyur ba'i gcig go /dang po bska ba bor te mngar skyur lan tshwa kha ba tsha bar sbyar ba/ tsha ba bor te mngar skyur lan tshwa kha bskar sbyar ba/

kha ba bor te mngar skyur lan tshwa tsha bska sbyar ba/ lan tshwa bor te mngar skyur kha tsha bska bar sbyar ba/ skyur ba bor te mngar lan tsha kha tsha bska bar sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa mngar ba gzhag nas/ skyur lan tshwa kha tsha bska ba lngar sbyar ba gcig go /drug tu sbyar ba gcig ni ro drug tu sbyar pa'o// de dag 'phel zad bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por phye'o// 'o na sbyor ba la drug cu re gsum las mi 'dug 'phel zad don bzhi 'dug pa nad re'i gnyen por sbyor ba re dgos pas chad do snyam na ma yin te/ rkyang pa la 'phel zad bco brgyad yod pa'i 'phel ba gsum/ zad pa gsum du 'dus la/ sbyor ba gcig lhag pa ni gar dgos bslan pa'i phyir yin no// zhes grag go nus pa'i sbyor ba la/ zhi byed du sbyor ba/ sbyong byed du sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po thang phye/ lde gu/ ril bu/ sman mar te sde tshan lnga'am/ sman chang*/ bri ta gnyis bsnan pas bdun/ bsdu na sman chang thang gi khong du dang*/ bri ta ril bu'i khongs su'o// gnyis pa rlung la 'jam rtsi/ mkhris par bshal/ bad kan la skyugs/ 'dus par ni ru ha/ mgo dang nam tshod gi nad la sbyongs te/ de dag bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad thams cad kyi gnyen por che'o// drug pa cha byad dpyad kyi gnas kyi sdong po la/ lus phyi nang gi nad 'byin cing zhi bar byed pa'i dpyad dang*/ dpyad kyi cha byad de yal ga gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jam/ rtsub/ drag po ste lo 'dab gsum/ dang po dugs/ lums/ byug pa gsum/ gnyis pa la/ gtar/ sreg 'bugs pa gsum/ gsum pa la/ 'dral/ gcod/ 'drud/ 'byin pa bzhi'o// gnyis pa dpyad kyi cha byad la/ zug rngu rtag pa'i cha byad/ zug rngu 'byin pa skam pa'i/ gtsags bu/ thur ma'i/ phran bu'i cha byad de lo 'dab lnga/ dang po la/ khab mgo mde'u 'tshol/ rnag brtag 'brum brtag bzhi/ gnyis pa la skam chen/ skam chung gnyis/ dang po la/ seng ge kha/ kang ka mchu/ bya rog mchu/ phyi ma la/

mthing ril mchu/ 'drul skam/ 'jam rtse gsum/ gsum pa la/ sbu gu'i sgro 'dra ba/ ltag nyal/ sta re kha/ 'jab rtse/ lce zor/ dral gtsags drug bzhi pa la/ sbubs can sbubs med gnyis/ snga ma la/ sbal mgo smyug kha/ byid po'i mchu gsum/ phyi ma la/ nas 'dra/ sbal mgo zangs bur/ 'bri lce/ mdung rtse so dang lnga/ lnga ba la/ skyud bu/ sog le/ chan pa/ med gsor/ sna 'bru/ mngal thur/ tre gug 'phrul thur/ se stel kha gnyis/ 'od kha gtse'u/ rma bkru/ rngabs ra/ bum par spu gri/ tel pa/ sha khab ste bco brgyad do// bdun ba rnam par ma gyur pa'i lus nad med tha mal gyi gnas kyi sdong po la/ mi na bar bya ba dang*/ ring du 'tsho bar bya pa'i yal ga gnyis/ dang po la/ nad skyed pa'i rgyu rkyen spang ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa ste/ lo 'dab gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ tshe zad rgas pa'i nad gso ba bcud len te phan yon/ gnas/ rten/ bya thabs kyi lo 'dab bzhi/ phyi ma la/ gtso bor blangs pa dang*/ zhar dpyad gnyis/ dang po la/ snum bcos khrus dang khong sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes/ bar ma la/ rlung can gyi bcud len/ tsha ba can gyi/ grang ba can gyi/ chu ser can gyi/ cha mnyam gyi bcud len lnga/ phyi ma la blang spang*/ phan yon 'bras bu/ zhar dpyad gsum/ brgyad pa nad ngos 'dzin rtags kyi gnas kyi sdong po la/ kha mar bcos la dgos pa nyes pa dngos su ston pa'i brtag pa/ skye bos mkhas zer mgu phyir ngan g.yo skyon gyis brtag pa/ gso tshe blang dor bya ba'i phyir spang blang mu bzhir brtag pa ste yal ga gsum/ dang po la/ slong ba rgyu'i sgo nas brtag pa dang*/ mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas dang*/ phan gnod bstan pa'i sgo nas brtag pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ de dag kyang slong ba sogs kyis bstan pa ste/ dang po la/ rgyu gang byas pa/ rkyen ci byung*/ zas gang zos/ spyod lam gang byas brtag pa ste bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ brtag pa'i gzhi/ brtag pa'i yul/

brtag pa'i sgo/ brtag pa'i tshul bzhi'i dang po la/ nad kyi mtshan nyid 'phel ba/ zad pa/ gsog pa/ ldang ba/ 'khrugs pa ste lnga/ gnyis pa la/ mig rna ba sna lce lus te dbang po lnga/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste yul lnga/ lud pa/ 'khru/ skyugs/ chu/ khrag ste dri ma lnga ste bco lnga/ gsum pa la/ yul dus/ rang bzhin na tshod/ nyin zhag zas zos/ gnas te bdun/ bzhi pa la/ mthong ba yul rig reg pa lus rig thos pa sgra rig ste gsum/ de dang po la/ kha dog bongs/ dbyibs/ lce dang chu la brtag pa lnga/ gnyis pa de la/ lus kyi/ tsha grang*/ 'bur 'jam rtsa la brtag pa ste lnga/ gsum pa de la/ rkyen gang gis na/ na lugs gang ltar na/ lus kyi gang na/ skam gsher la sogs pa'i gnas gang du na/ dus gang tsam na ni dri ba lnga ste bco lnga'o// gsum pa phan gnod bstan pa'i sgo nas brtag pa la/ zas 'phrod pa dang*/ mi 'phrod pa dang*/ spyod lam 'phrad pa dang*/ mi 'phrod pa/ sman 'phrad pa dang*/ mi 'phrad pa/ dpyad 'phrod pa dang*/ mi 'phrod pa brgyad de yongs dril 'di la lag len lnga bcu nga bzhi yod do// gnyis pa skye bo mkhas zer mgu la ngan g.yo skyon gyis brtag pa la/ mtshan nyid/ shes par bya ba/ mtshang 'dru/ dus bsring ba/ sngar rjes bcad pa/ gcud la bor ba/ spo la 'don pa/ thab 'og gzhug pa ste lo 'dab brgyad kyi dang po la/ spyi dang khyad par gyi rtags shes pa gnyis/ gnyis pa mtshang 'dru/ ci na/ ji ltar na/ zas gang btang*/ sman pa sus bcos/ zhag grangs ci tsam song shes pa ste lnga/ bar ma de la re re/ brgyad pa la/ zas phye/ gnyen po/ rdzong la bros pa gsum ste yongs dril bco lnga/ gsum pa gso tshe spang blang bya phyir mu bzhir brtag pa la/ gso sla ba dang*/ bka' ba gnyis/ gso ba tsam/ spang bar bya ba dang bzhi/ dang po la yan lag ldan pas gso sla ba/ gang zag nad pa'i sgo nas gso sla ba/ nad kyi sgo nas gso sla ba ste gsum/ de'i dang po la yang*/ sman pa/ sman/ nad g.yog ste gsum gyi dang po la/

sman pa mkhas pa/ gzhung don shes pa/ las rnams mthong ba/ gtsang sgra che ba ste bzhi/ gnyis pa de la/ cho ga mang ba/ yon tan ldan pa/ phun sum tshogs pa/ 'phrod par sbyar ba ste bzhi/ gsum pa de la/ shes pa sgrim pa/ snying rje che ba/ gtsang sbra/ blo dang ldan pa ste bzhi/ dril bas bcu gnyis/ gnyis pa gang zag nad pa'i sgo nas gso sla ba la/ skyes bu na tshod gzhon pa/ blo dul ba/ snying stobs dang ldan pa/ sman dpyad bzod pa/ rdzas byug pa/ smin pas bsgo ba nyan pa/ shes par nus pa/ nad rtags dris pa'i lan zlos mkhas pa ste brgyad/ gsum pa nad kyi sgo nas gso sla ba/ rgyu dang*/ sngar tshul dang*/ mtshan nyid chung ba dang*/ gnod bya dang*/ yul mi mtshungs pa/ dus mi mtshungs pa/ rang bzhin mi mtshungs pa dang*/ bla gnyan gyi gnod pa med pa dang*/ lan gcig la rkyang par gnas pa dang*/ gsar pa'i nad dang*/ rim la yul dus mtshungs pa dang*/ chu 'gags gnod bya bsdams pa dang*/ khrag skran rnying ba ste bcu gsum/ gso dka' ba snga ma la/ rigs 'gre sbyar na mang du yod kyang*/ thabs mang pos yun ring por gso dgos pa gcig tu bsdus so// de las kyang go zlog pa tshe'i lhag ma lus la gso srid pa tsam ste gcig spang bar bya ba la gso thabs med pas spang bar bya ba dang*/ yod kyang spang bar bya ba gnyis kyi sngon la srog gcod pa'i gnad dgu yod pa/ de dag gis zin pa dgu/ nges pa'i 'chi ltas kyis zin pa gso ba tsam gyis yul las phyin ci log tu gyur pa ste bcu gcig go /gnyis pa la/ rgyal po la sdang ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sdang ba/ 'gro ba spyi la sdang ba/ sman pa la brnyas pa/ lus sems brel ba/ 'byor pa med pa/ sman pa'i ngag la mi nyan pa/ tshe zad pa/ mya ngan la gnas pa// bstan pa bshig pa'i las byed pa ste bcu/ bsdom pas lnga bcu nga drug ste brtag thabs la yongs dril lag len brgya nyer lnga'o// dgu pa rtogs nas ji ltar gso tshul gyi sdong po la/

spyi'i gso tshul/ khyad par gyi gso tshul te yal ga gsum/ dang po la/ ji ltar gso/ gang gis gso/ gsos pa'i tshad de lo 'dab rnam pa gsum/ dang po de la rang gnas su gsog dus su bsal ba dang*/ langs dus su gzhan la gnod pa med par gso ba dang*/ nad gzhan skyes na stobs gang che ba bcos pa dang gsum/ gnyis pa de la gsog dus zhi ba dang*/ langs nas sbyangs ba dang*/ 'phral du bsal ba/ sman zas ma zos par btang ba/ sman zas kyi sngon du btang ba/ sman zas kyi dbus su btang ba/ sman zas kyi mtha' la btang ba/ sman mtshan mor btang pa ste bcu gsum/ gsum pa de la/ ma zhi ba'i rtags 'dug na bcos pa dang*/ zhi nas lhag po mi sbyor ba gnyis te bsdoms pas bco brgyad/ gnyis pa bye brag gi gso tshul la/ ma zhu ba dang bcas pa dang*/ rang rgyud can/ gzhan dbang can te lo 'dab gsum gyi dang po de la/ sman gyis rtse bcil ba dang*/ rtags thob nas sbyang ba dang*/ steng 'og nas rang byung sman gyis mi dgag pa dang*/ ma smin pa mi sbyang pa ste bzhi/ gnyis pa de la/ smin par bya ba dang*/ slar sbyang ba dang*/ khong du ma 'dus na phyi nas sbyang ba dang*/ khong du 'dus pa nang nas sbyangs pa ste bzhi/ gsum pa de la/ bla gnyan chung na snga ma'i nad gso ba dang*/ bla gnyan stobs chen de sngon la gso ba gnyis te bcu/ gsum pa khyad par gyi gso tshul la/ nad ngos ma zin ring byi la 'jab pa lta bu sad mda'i bcos/ ngos zin nas spo la dar 'phyar ba lta bu dngos bcos/ gnyen po thog tu mi 'bab pa ste rta rgod dkyus su 'jug pa lta bu nad lam gzung ba'i bcos/ sngar btses kyi nad la skyar mo nya len pa lta bur dman lhag log pa brtag pa'i bcos/ stobs chen gyi nad la mi sha can 'phrang du 'phrad pa ltar spang gnyen cig car grang sprod kyi bcos/ stobs chung ba'i nad skas gdang mas 'dzeg lta bu yang spang gnyen rim gyis pa'i bcos/ rkyang pa'i nad la dpa' bo dgra 'dul lta bu de zhi gzhan la gnod pa med pa'i bcos/

ldan dus kyi nad la gtso bo me shor gyi 'khrug pa bsdum pa lta bu kha mtho ba mnan dma' ba kha 'dzin pa'i bcos/ kun la mdzo khal lug khal lta bur gnas skabs dang bstun pa'i bcos te lo 'dab dgu'i dang po rlung gi sad mda'/ mkhris pa'i/ bad kan gyi/ pho long gi waganyan gyi/ srin gyi/ khrag gi 'khrugs kyi/ rlung gzer gyi/ sbyar dug gi tsha grang 'dres pa'i/ bshal gyi/ me rtsa'i/ gtar kha'i/ rnag gi spyi'i sad mda' chung du ste bcu drug gnyis pa la/ nad ngos 'dzin gdeng rnyed nas nad kyi gnas skabs 'di dang 'di tsam nas gsos zhes lung ston pa/ mi 'tshe na 'di tsam nas 'chi zhes lung ston pa gnyis so// gsum pa la/ bad rlung gis grogs thang gis dbye ba dang*/ nad zungs kyi khrag thang gis phye nas gtar ba dang*/ smug po dug tshad gnyis byer ba bsdus nas bsad pa dang*/ gab tshad la grang ba'i mgo phur nas drod kyi bshu ba dang*/ ma zhu spyi'i nad smin par byed pa dang*/ smin nas sbyang ba dang*/ bshal gyi sngon 'gror sman gyi nad kun brtul ba ste brgyad/ bzhi pa la/ sbyor ba dman na gnyen po skyed pa/ lhag nas gzhan langs na mnan pa/ log nas nad stobs skyes na sbyor ba bsgyur ba ste gsum mo// lnga pa la/ tsha ba stobs che na ga pur sman gyi chu/ rtse la chung dogs pa gtar ba dpyad kyi chu/ kha zas 'ben la gtad pa zas kyi/ bsil sar sdod pa spyod lam gyi chu ste chu bzhis bcos/ grang ba stobs chen drod dgu sbyar ba sman gyi me/ me rtsa dpyad kyi me/ drod bcud can zas kyi/ gnas gos dro ba spyod lam gyi me ste me bzhis bcos pa ste brgyad/ drug pa la/ dang po la spyod lam zab pas bcos pa/ des ma zhi na phan gnod zas kyis/ des ma zhi na bsil drod sman gyis/ gsum kas ma non na dpyad kyis bcos pa ste bzhi'o// bdun pa la/ rlung ma langs par bcos pa shes pa/ de bzhin mkhris pa/ bad kan bcos pa ste rkyang pa gsum/

gzhan ma langs par bcos shes pa dang*/ rlung gi nad la ro kha tsha bsten pa lta bu rlung ma zhi mkhris par bzlog pa dang*/ bad kan du bzlog pa/ mkhris pa lan tshwa tsha ba bsten pas mkhris pa ma zhi bad kan du bzlog pa dang*/ rlung du log pa/ bad kan la lan tshwa bsten pas bad kan ma zhi rlung du log pa dang*/ mkhris pa bzlog pa/ mngar ba dang lan tshwa lhag pas rlung zhi bad kan skyed pa dang*/ rlung zhi mkhris pa skyes pa/ tsha bas bad kan zhi rlung skyes pa dang*/ mkhris pa skyes pa/ mngar bas mkhris pa bad kan dang rlung skyes pa ste bzlog rgyu bcu gnyis/ mi 'phrod pa'i rkyen gyis 'dus pa log pa'i gcig ste bcu drug brgyad pa la/ ldan 'dus gang mtho ba mnan pa gcig snying*/ glo ba/ mchin pa/ srog rtsa/ mkhal ma/ mtsher pa/ pho ba/ mkhris pa/ rlung*/ bad kan/ khrag chu ser/ gnyan dang gdon te gnas dang nad gzhi so so'i kha 'dzin gtong ba bcu bzhi/ snga phyi re mos bcos pa dang*/ ltag pa sprad pa dang*/ gung gnyis su mkhris tshad bsad pa dang*/ srod dang snga dro pho ba'i me drod gso ba/ dgong dang tho rangs rlung la rngan pa ster ba ste nyi shu'o// dgu pa la/ gnod bya dang*/ yul dang*/ dus dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ na tshod dang*/ khams dang*/ gnas dang*/ me stobs dang*/ nyams stobs dang*/ goms pa bcu ste gya bdun/ bsdoms pas rtogs nas ji ltar gso tshul lag len brgya dang bco lnga'o// bcu pa gang gso ba'i thabs kyi sdong po la/ thun mong pas gso ba dang*/ khyad par gyi gso ba'i yal ga gnyis/ dang po la stobs bskyed pa brtags par bya ba dang*/ nyams smad pa bsnyung bar bya ba'i yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ brtas par bya ba'i yul/ gang nas brtags par bya ba/ brtas par bya ba'i phan yon/ brtas pa grags pa'i skyon/ de'i bcos thabs te lo 'dab lnga'i/ dang po de la rlung che ba dang*/ zungs zad pa dang*/ khyim gsar gyis dub pa dang*/ sbrum ma btsas rjes dang*/ khrag zags pa dang*/

glo rdol ba dang*/ rgas pa gnyid med pa dang*/ mya ngan gyis dub pa dang*/ dka' thub byed pa dang rtsol bas dub pa dang*/ sos ka'i dus/ gnyis pa de la/ zas bcud can dang*/ sman mar dang gnyis/ dpyad 'jam rtsi dang*/ khrus bsku mnye dang gsum/ spyod lam gnyid log pa dang*/ dal bar 'dug pa dang sems dga' ba gsum/ gsum pa de la stobs 'phel ba dang*/ nad 'joms pa gnyis/ bzhi pa de la/ thal drags pas kha tsho che bas dang*/ 'bras dang*/ rmen bu dang*/ rmongs bag dang*/ lus lci ba dang*/ lud pa mang ba dang*/ bad kan 'phel te bdun/ lnga pa nad de dag bcos pa gcig gnyis pa nyams smad pa snyung bar bya ba la yang*/ yul gang gis smad pa/ phan yon/ drags skyon/ de bcos thabs te lo 'dab lnga'i dang po la/ ma zhu bsnum zos kyi nad dang*/ brla rengs pa dang*/ rims nad dang*/ gcin snyi 'gags pa dang*/ gci ba 'gags pa dang*/ tsho ches pa dang*/ chu ser gyi nad dang*/ bad kan rgyas pa dang*/ mkhris pa rgyas pa dang*/ stobs ldan dar babs dang dgun dus so// gnyis pa de la/ ma snyoms pa snyoms par byed pa zhi ba dang*/ slong ba nas phyir 'byin pa sbyang ba gnyis/ dang po la/ zas sman spyod lam dpyad bzhi/ dang po nyams stobs chung ba bsnyung bar bya ba gcig gnyis pa stobs 'bring la/ grang ba drod skyed pa/ tshad pa la smin par byed pa gnyis/ gsum pa stobs che ba la/ rtsol bas bcag pa/ rngul dbyung ba gcig bzhi pa stobs lhag par che na/ me rtsa dang*/ dugs dang*/ lums dang*/ gtar kha'i dpyad bzhi/ phyi ma la/ sbyor ba ma zhu ba'i gnas nas skyugs kyis drang ba/ zhu ba'i gnas la ni ru ha yis sbyang ba/ lus spyir te bshal gyis sbyang ba/ rtsa nad rtsa sbyong ste dril bas bcu bzhi/ gsum pa de la/ dbang po gsal ba/ lus yang ba/ yi ga bde ba/ bya byed brtson pa/ bkres skom dus gcig 'byung ba/ bshang ba dang rlung bde bar rgyu ba'o// bzhi pa de la/ zungs zad pa/ sha skem pa/ mgo 'khor ba/ gnyid med pa/

mdangs shor ba/ skad dma' ba/ dbang po nyams pa/ kha skom pa/ kha 'gag byin pa/ brla/ gzhug to/ rtsib logs/ snying kha/ klad pa rnams na ba/ rims kyis 'debs pa/ skyugs 'dod/ rlung nad de bco brgyad de rnams kyis bcos/ phan tshun 'gal rkyen spang gnyen/ rlung dang bad mkhris rgyab bsnol du bcos pa dang*/ rten brten pa gcig par bcos pa ste/ yon tan dang skyon bzhag lag len drug cu/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi gso tshul la/ rlung bcos/ mkhris bcos/ bad kan bcos pa/ rkyang pa bcos pa/ ldan pa bcos pa/ 'dus pa bcos pa/ tsha grang gnyis su bsgril te bcos pa'i lo 'dab bdun/ dang po de la rlung gsog dus/ til mar lci snum/ 'jam dro'i bcud zas/ spyod lam dro gnas su bsdad pa/ yid 'ong gi tshig snyan pa/ gnyid log gos dro ba'o// sman thang la rus bcud gsum/ mgo khrel/ bcud bzhi/ shing kun gsum thang ste bzhi/ rlung la phan pa'i phyi ma rnams dang*/ 'don sbyor la sha dkar/ skyur/ sgog 'don te bzhi/ don lde gu'i sbyor ba yin/ rlung la phan pa'i rtsa ba'i sman mar dang*/ mar rnying drod kyi 'jam rtsi dang*/ bsku mnye dang*/ snum can gyi dugs dang*/ rlung gsang du me rtsa/ gnyis pa de la/ mkhris pa gsog dus ba ra'i mar gsar/ bsil zas/ spyod lam bsil sar dal bar 'dug pa/ dri bzang bsil ba byugs pa/ sman pa bsil ba'i sngo sman thun mong du sbyar ba/ thang sman thun mong du sbyar ba/ la sman thun mong du sbyar ba/ mtha' ma de la/ tsha ba rab 'bring mtha' gsum la/ ga pur tsan dan gi wang gtso bor byas te sbyar bas gsum/ bshal/ rngul dbyung*/ chu'i 'khrul 'khor/ gtar kha/ bsil ba'i dugs/ gsum pa de la/ bad kan gsog dus/ sbrang rtsi/ yang rtsub kyi zas dro la chung bar za ba/ spyod lam me nyi bsro ba/ gos dro ba gyon pa/ skam sar rtsol bas 'chag pa/ nyin gnyid log pa/ sman la thang phye gnyis/ dang po la/ lan tshwa'i thang*/ tsha ba'i thang*/ de gnyis 'dres pa'i thang ste gsum/

phyi ma la/ se 'bru'i sbyor ba/ dwa lis/ thal sman gyi sbyor ba gsum mo// mdor bsdus na/ tsha skyur yang rtsub rno ba brten pa/ dpyad du skyugs la/ dugs dang*/ me rtsa/ thur ma/ bzhi pa rkyang bar bcos pa la/ rlung 'jam rtsi bcud kyis bcos pa/ mkhris pa bshal bsil gyis bcos pa/ bad kan skyugs dang drod kyis bcos pa gsum/ lnga pa rlung dang mkhris par ldan pa bsil bcud ldan pas bcos pa/ bad mkhris ldan pa bsil la yang pas bcos pa/ bad rlung ldan pa drod la bcud pas bcos pa ste gsum/ drug pa 'dus pa bcos pa ni/ sil bcud yang pa gsum 'dzom pas bcos pa gcig bdun pa tsha grang gnyis su 'dril te bcos pa la/ tsha ba thams cad bsil gyis bcos pa/ grang ba thams cad bad kan ltar bcos pa/ rlung ni tsha grang gang dang 'brel ba de ltar du bcos pa gsum ste/ lag len drug cu/ yongs su dril bas lag len sum brgya drug cu yin no// bcu gcig pa bya byed sman pa'i gnas la/ rgyu dang*/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ las/ 'bras bu ste yal ga drug dang po la/ sman pa blo dang ldan pa/ bsam pa dkar pa/ dam tshig ldan pa/ rnam pa gzo ba/ bya ba la brtson pa/ mi chos mkhas pa ste lo 'dab drug gnyis pa la/ nyes pa'i mtshan nyid shes pa/ gnod bya'i mtshan nyid shes pa/ gnyen po'i mtshan nyid shes pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ gsum pa la/ sman pa zhes pa dang*/ lha rje zhes brjod pa'i lo 'dab gnyis/ bzhi pa la/ sman pa bla na med pa dang*/ khyad par can/ phal pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ lnga pa la/ thun mong pa'i las dang*/ khyad par gyi las te lo 'dab gnyis/ drug pa la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ste lo 'dab gnyis so// rgyud bzhi'i bshad pa gzhan la phan pa'i gter las/ bshad rgyud rnam par phye ba'i skabs gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa man ngag rgyud kyi rgyas par bshad pa la/ de nas ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po de ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te dgos 'dod 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so zhes pa nas/

khyod kyis dris shig nga yis bshad lung sbyin/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mdor bstan/ drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus sogs rtsa ba brgyad/ skabs bco lnga/ le'u go lngas rgyas par bshad pa las/ dang po'i lus gso ba'i yan lag dang*/ byis pa dang*/ mo nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ mtshon dang*/ dug dang*/ rgas pa dang*/ ro tsa ba gso ba'i yan lag ste rtsa ba brgyad/ dang po la/ nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs dang*/ khong nad dang*/ tshad pa dang*/ lus stod dang*/ don snod dang*/ gsang nad dang*/ 'thor bu dang*/ lhan skyes rma'i nad gso ba ste brgyad/ byis nad/ mo nad/ gdon/ mtshon/ dug nad/ rgas pa/ ro tsa ba gso ba la re re ste sdong po bco lnga/ dang po la/ rlung*/ mkhris bad kan/ 'dus nad smug po bcos pa ste yal ga bzhi/ dang po la/ rgyu rkyen dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rtags dang*/ bcos thabs te yal ga phre'u bzhi/ dang po la/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi lo 'dab gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi yal ga phre'u las kyang phre'ur gyes pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba'i lo 'dabaganyis/ dang po gzhan rgyud log pa'i lam du zhugs pa ste/ a wa ta la sogs pa sngar bshad pa nyi shu/ de dag bsdu na rengs pa dang*/ 'khums pa dang*/ bskums pa dang*/ sbos pa dang*/ 'ches pa dang*/ gzer ba dang*/ 'phros pa dang*/ lkugs pa'am 'bogs pa ste brgyad du 'du'o// gnyis pa rang rgyud gnod bya la zhugs pa ste/ bdun gyi dang po pags 'grams la gcig gnyis pa sha la rgyas pa la/ sha dang tshil zhugs gnyis/ gsum pa rtsa la rgyug pa la/ rtsa khrag chu bar rgyug pa gsum/ bzhi pa rus la zhen pa la/ rus tshigs/ rkang*/ bcud la zhugs pa bzhi/ lnga pa don la babs pa la/ glo bar/ snying la/ mchin par/ mtsher par/ mkhal mar zhugs pa dang lnga/ drug pa snod du lhung ba la/ zas la/ ma zhu ba la/ zhu ba'i gnas la/ mkhris pa la/ bshang ba la/ gci ba la/ mngal du zhugs pa ste bdun/ bdun pa dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba la/

mgo mig rna ba/ sna/ so/ lce/ lus kun la zhugs pa ste dril bas nyer dgu/ de dag mdor bsdu na/ mgo snying*/ glo/ mchin/ pho/ long*/ mkhal rlung ste bdun du 'du'o// gnyis pa bye brag gi nad la/ rkyang pa dang 'dres pa ste lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po srog 'dzin sogs lnga/ gnyis pa de dag mkhris pa dang*/ 'dres pa lnga/ de dag bad kan dang 'dres pa lnga ste bcu bsdoms pas bco lnga/ dril bas rlung nad re bzhi/ mdor bsdus gnyis/ bgrang bas don dgu /gsum pa rtags la/ spyi brtag pa dang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i brtag pa ste/ yal ga gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ dang po la/ slong ba rgyu'i sgo nas brtag pa/ mtshan nyid rtags kyi/ phan gnod goms pa'i sgo nas brtag pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ bar ma la spyi dang bye brag dril bas lag len drug bzhi pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gi bcos thabs te yal ga phre'u las kyang phre'ur gyes pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zas/ spyod/ sman/ dpyad de lo 'dab bzhi'i sman la/ khu ba chang*/ 'don sbyar/ phye ma/ sman mar lnga/ rim pa bzhin drug lnga/ bzhi/ gcig drug bzhi ste dril bas lag len nyer brgyad/ gnyis pa bye brag gi bcos thabs la/ rigs kyi dbye ba rnams bcos pa/ gnas kyi/ nad tshags kyi bcos pa ste lo 'dab gsum gyi dang po la/ a wa ta rkyang pa bcos pa dang*/ de bad kan dang 'dres pa/ de mkhris pa dang 'dres pa/ dar ya kan sogs/ brla rengs/ gzugs khums sogs/ sran 'theng sogs/ rtsa 'dzin sogs bcos pa ste brgyad/ gnyis pa de la/ sha pags la zhugs pa bcos pa gcig tshigs la/ rus pa/ rkang la/ bcud la/ rgyus tshigs rtsa gnyis la gcig chu bar la/ khrag la/ snying la/ glo bar/ mchin par/ mtsher par/ mkhal mar/ zas ma zhu ba gnyis la gcig zhu gnas su/ mkhris par/ mngal du/ bshang bar/ gcin la/ mgor/ rna bar/ mig snar/ sor/ lus kun la zhugs pa bcos pa ste rtsa gsum/ gsum pa de la/ srog 'dzin gyi rlung bcos/ gyen rgyu'i/ khyab byed kyi/

me mnyam gyi/ thur sel gyi rlung bcos/ mkhris par 'dres pa/ bad kan dang 'dres pa/ rengs 'khums gnyis la gcig bskams pa/ sbos pa/ 'chos pa/ gzer ba/ 'phyis pa/ lkugs pa/ mgo rlung*/ snying*/ glo/ mchin/ pho/ long*/ mkhal rlung bcos pa ste nyer gcig bsdoms pas lag len brgyad cu// gnyis pa mkhris nad bcos pa la/ rgyu rkyen dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs/ rjes bcad de yal ga drug dang po rgyu dang mthun pa'i lo 'dab gcig gnyis pa la/ mtshon/ dug zas/ gdon/ rkyen te lo 'dab bzhi/ gsum pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi sgo nas dbye pa ste yal ga phre'u gnyis/ rigs dang rtags kyi dbye ba'i lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po la bzhi'i dang po/ nad bzhi'i mkhris pa thang la lhags pa la gcig gnyis pa me drod kyi mkhris pa gzhan gyur ba la/ rlung gi gnas gyur/ ma zhu ba'am bad kan gyi gnas gyur/ khrag gi gnas gyur te gsum/ gsum pa snod kyi mkhris pa/ kha lung kha shor la/ mchin pa rgyas pa'am/ skrangs sam/ skran gyis mkhris yul phrogs pas mkhris pa dbang med du phyir kha lud pa/ pho skran gyis mkhris yul phrogs pa'i dang*/ mkhris pa rang la skran zhugs pa'i kha lud dang*/ 'grams sam rlung rkyen gyis mkhris pa kha shor ba ste bzhi/ bzhi pa thun mong gi mkhris pa rtsa la rgyug pa dang*/ 'grams tshad mkhris par babs pa'i rtsar rgyug 'khrugs tshad mkhris par babs pa'i/ rims tshad mkhris par babs pa'i/ zas spyod rang bzhin gyis mkhris pa 'phel bas rtsar rgyug pa bzhi'i phyi ma la/ sha ser dang mig ser gnyis su phye nas bsdoms pas bcu gsum mo// mdor bsdu na/ rtsa ba bzhir phye ba'i thog mtha' gnyis khrag dang mkhris pa 'phel ba yin pas rang rgyud can zhes bya/ don tshad pa yin no// bar ma gnyis rkyen stobs kyi mkhris pa'i yul phrogs nas mkhris pa nyams pa yin pas gzhan rgyud can zhes bya don grang ba'o// gnyis pa gnas sam rtags can gyi dbye ba la bdun gyi/

pags pa la grams pa/ rtsa ru rgyug pa/ rus la zhen pa rnams la re re/ don la babs pa la/ snying*/ glo ba/ mchin pa/ mtsher pa/ mkhal mar zhugs pa lnga/ snod du lhung ba la/ pho ba dang*/ long la/ rgyu mar/ lgang pa dang*/ mngal du zhugs pa ste lnga/ dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba la/ mgo la/ mig la/ rna bar/ sna la/ lce la/ lus kun la zhugs pa ste bsdoms pas nyi shu/ gnyis pa bye brag gi dbye ba la/ rkyang pa dang*/ 'dres pa ste lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po 'ju byed sogs lnga/ gnyis pa de dag rlung dang 'dres pa lnga/ bad kan dang 'dres pa lnga ste bco lnga/ de dag kyang tsha grang gnyis su sdud/ bsdoms pas mkhris nad zhe bdun no// rigs dang gnas kyi mdor bsdus gnyis gnyis/ bsnan pas nga gcig bzhi pa rtags la/ spyi rtags dang bye brag gi rtags te lo 'dab gnyis te dang po la/ spyi rtags/ tsha ba'i/ grang ba'i rtags te gsum/ gnyis pa la/ rigs/ gnas/ bye brag gi rtags te bsdoms pas lag len drug lnga pa bcos thabs la yang*/ spyi bcos dang*/ bye brag gi bcos te lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po la/ mkhris nad tsha ba'i sman dpyad zas spyod lam bzhi/ dang po la/ thang gnyis/ phye ma gnyis/ gnyis pa la gtar/ sbyang ba gnyis kyi phyi mar bsdu sbyang zhi gsum gyi mtha' ma la gsum mo// gnyis pa la/ mkhris pa grang ba'i sman dpyad zas spyod kyi bzhi/ snga ma la gnyis/ bar ma la skyugs bshal zhi byed gtar ba'i sdom dang bsdoms pas nyi shu'o// gnyis pa la/ rigs gnas/ bye brag gi bcos gsum gyi snga ma la/ gnas gyur gsum/ kha lung gsum/ rtsa rgyug gi sha ser/ mig ser bcos pa brgyad/ de'i dang po rlung gi gnas gyur/ zas sman sbyong dpyad/ ma zhu ba bad kan gyi gnas gyur la/ sman gnyis/ sbyang zhi gnyis/ dpyad khrag gi gnas gyur la/ sman dpyad gnyis la mchin skran kha lud la/ sman gtar sbyong*/ me skran gyi kha lud la/ sman dpyad la gnyis/ mkhris skran la/ sman gnyis/ gtar sbyong sreg

sha ser sman gtar sbyang zhi/ mig ser la thang sbyar gtar sman gnyis te so gcig go /bar ma la/ pags grams sha rgyas gnyis la bsdoms pa/ rtsar zhugs/ rus zhen/ dang po la/ byug pa gsum sbyong gtar lums sman mar/ gnyis pa la/ sman gtar sbyong zhi/ gsum pa la/ sbyong sman zas lums/ gcig drug gnyis gcig gnyis mtha' ma la/ 'jug byed mdangs sgyur sgrub byed/ mthong byed/ mdog gsal/ bad rlung dang 'gres pa bcos pa'i snga mar/ phyi rjes gcod pa yal ga dang mthun pa'i lo 'dab gcig gcig ste/ bsdoms pas lnga bcu/ dril bas lag len brgya rtsa gcig gsum pa bad kan gyi nad la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te yal ga phre'u lnga/ dang po dang gnyis pa la/ yal ga dang mthun pa'i lo 'dab re re/ gsum pa dbye ba la/ rang rgyud can dang*/ gzhan rgyud can te/ yal ga phre'u las phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ spyi dang bye brag gi dbye ba ste phre'u las nyag mar gyes pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba'i lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po la/ bad kan lhen sogs drug gnyis pa la bdun gyi dang po bzhi re re/ don la bab par/ snying*/ glo/ mchin/ mtsher pa/ mkhal mar babs pa lnga/ snod du lhung ba la/ pho ba/ long*/ rgyu ma/ mkhris pa/ lgang ba/ mngal lhung drug dbang po la me tog shar ba la/ mgo mig rna ba/ sna/ lce lnga/ bye brag gi dbye ba la/ rkyang pa dang 'dres pa ste lo 'dab gnyis/ dang po myags byed sogs/ gnyis pa de dag rlung dang 'dres pa lnga/ bad kan dang 'dres pa lnga ste bsdoms pas bzhi bcu rtsa gcig gzhan rgyud can bad kan ser po dang*/ smug po gnyis te bad kan gyi nad zhe gsum/ bzhi pa rtags la spyi rtags/ bye brag gi rtags te yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ slong ba rgyu brtag pa/ mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa/ phan gnod bstan pa'i sgo nas brtag pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ gnyis pa la/ rigs/ gnas/ bye brag gi rtags brtag pa gsum ste lag len drug

lnga pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gi bcos te yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po zas spyod sman dpyad lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ rigs kyi bcos/ gnas kyi bcos/ nad tshegs kyi bcos/ gzhan dbang can gyi bcos te lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po la/ lhen bcos/ lhen skran du chags pa bcos pa/ lcags dreg me nyams/ mgul 'gags/ grum bu dkar po/ 'ju skems bcos pa ste bdun/ gnyis pa la/ pags sha/ rtsa rus/ snying*/ glo/ mchin/ mtsher pa/ mkhal/ pho/ mkhris/ rgyu/ long gcig lgang pa/ mngal/ mgo rna ba/ mig sna/ lcer zhugs pa bcos pa ste bcu dgu/ gsum pa la/ rten byed/ myags byed/ myong byed/ tshims byed/ 'byor byed/ rlung mkhris dang 'dres pa ser po/ smug po brgyad de so brgyad bsdoms pas lag len zhe bzhi'o// de ltar bad kan ni lci rtul bsil ba'i phyir khong na nad kun gyi rtsa ba byed/ sha pags rtsa tshigs sogs su byer ba nyung*/ rang gnas las gzhan du zhugs pa dkon/ phal cher ma zhu bas rkyen byed pas pho bar rgyas pas bcos pa'i tshe pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces pa yin no// bzhi pa 'dus nad smug po bcos pa la/ 'dus pa zhes pa yang*/ rang bzhin rgyu'i 'dus pa/ byung tshul dus kyi 'dus pa/ 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i 'dus pa gsum la bya zhing*/ bar pa ni ma smin pa'i tsha ba/ mtha' ma dug nad yin pas de gnyis bzhag nas snga ma la ston la/ ming gzhan bad kan smug po zhes kyang bya'o// de la rgyu/ rkyen/ gnas/ dus/ rigs/ rtags/ bcos thabs/ rjes bcad de yal ga phre'u brgyad/ dang po bad kan sogs kyis rgyu byas pa ste lo 'dab gcig gnyis pa la/ tsha bas rkyen byas pa smug po yas babs/ grang bas rkyen byas pa smug po mas chags te lo 'dab gnyis/ gnas la rang gnas dang*/ gzhan gnas te lo 'dab gnyis kyi snga ma la/ pho bar gnas pa/ mchin par/ rgyu mar/ long du gnas pa ste bzhi/ phyi ma la nang byer dang phyi byer gyi gnyis/ de'i dang po la/ srog rtsar zhugs pa/

mchin lam 'dril ba/ khrag la zhon pa/ tshigs pa'i mkhar la zhugs pa/ mgo la byer pa/ glo bar/ snying la/ mtsher par/ mkhal mar/ bsam se'ur byer ba ste bcu/ de'i gnyis pa la/ sha rgyas/ pags grams/ rtsar byer/ tshigs byer te bzhi/ bzhi pa dus la/ dang po tsha ba'i dus/ bar du tsha grang 'thab pa'i dus/ mtha' ma grang ba lding chad pa'i dus te lo 'dab gsum/ lnga pa rigs la/ byer ba/ rgyas pa/ 'gyings pa/ 'dril ba ste lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po la/ phyi byer nang byer gnyis/ gnyis pa rdol ba dang ma rdol ba gnyis/ gsum pa la/ gab pa dang ma gab gnyis/ bzhi pa la/ gsar pa rnying pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ bsdoms pas 'dus nad so gnyis/ drug pa rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag gi rtags te lo 'dab gnyis kyi dang po la/ rtsa chu nad rtags/ lo ma/ phan gnod brtan pa'i sgo nas brtag pa lnga/ gnyis pa bye brag gi rtags la/ yul la brtag pa/ gnas skabs dus la brtag pa/ nad kyi sgo la brtag pa ste gsum/ dril bas lag len brgyad/ de ltar smug po ni khong nad phal gyi rgyu/ mi mkhas pa dug gi tsha ba'am/ grang ba'am/ sa nang du 'khrul srid pas brtag pa la mkhas par bya'o// bdun pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gi bcos thabs te yal ga phre'u las phre'ur gyes pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zas/ spyod lam/ sman/ dpyad de lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa bye brag gi bcos la/ gnas dang sbyar te bcos pa/ dus dang sbyar te bcos pa/ rigs dang sbyar te bcos pa ste lo 'dab gsum gyi snga ma la/ pho bar gnas tshe bad kan ltar bcos pa/ mchin par khrag ltar/ rgyu mar mkhris pa ltar/ long du gnas tshe rlung ltar bcos pa ste bzhi/ bar pa la tsha dus rgyas pa 'joms pa/ 'thab dus gnas su zhi bar byed pa/ grang ba lding chad bcos pa ste gsum/ mtha' ma la/ byer ba chung ba/ byer ba che ba/ mgo snying*/ glo/ mtsher/ mkhal ma/ bsam se'u/ nang rtsar/ phyir ching*/ shin tu rgyas pa gyen rdol/ thur du ral ba/ gab pa/ 'gyings ba/

smug po'i skran shin tu rnyings pa bcos pa ste bcu drug de ltar bsdoms pas lag len so lnga/ lar smug po 'dus nad yin pas gso dka'/ nad sgyur kha lci bas lan res zhi mi thug bcos bskyar zungs la ma ltas par dpyad bstud drag na nad dang zungs mnyam du 'dzad pas/ nad stobs cung zad bri nas lus zungs gso yang nad bcos so// de ltar skabs dang po la nad nyis brgya nyer lnga/ lag len brgya gya dgu yod do// gnyis pa khong nad bcos pa'i sdong po la/ ma zhu ba/ skran/ skya rbab/ 'or/ dmu chu/ gcong chen/ zad byed bcos pa ste yal ga drug bad mkhris rlung gis 'ju ba'i mthu nyams pa ste/ dang por bad kan myags byed kyis myags ma nus/ de nas mkhris pa 'ju byed kyis bzhu ma nus/ me mnyam rlung gis dwangs snyigs 'byed ma nus pas ma zhu ba zhes bshad do// de yang ma zhu ba ni khong nad thams cad kyi rgyu/ 'bras bu gcong nad rnams so// dang po la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ gyur tshul/ dbye ba/ rtags/ de'i bcos thabs te yal ga phre'u drug dang po bad kan lci zhing bsil pa ste lo 'dab gcig gnyis pa la/ rten ma goms pa/ mi 'phrod pa/ ngo bos mi 'jug ba'i rkyen byed pa ste lo 'dab bzhi/ gsum pa la/ gcong ji ltar skyed pa'i lo 'dab gcig bzhi pa la rdzas kyi dbye ba/ ngo bo'i/ rigs/ grogs/ dus kyi dbye ba ste yal ga phre'u las phre'ur gyes pa lnga/ dang po la/ gyong*/ brlan snum ma zhu ba ste lo 'dab gsum gyi dang po la/ rtsam pa/ sdo dang*/ sha rid/ gnyis pa la/ chang chu/ 'o ma/ zho da ra/ ja lnga/ gsum pa la/ rtsi mar/ 'bru mar/ tshil/ zhag rkang ste lnga/ zhar ro dang sman ma zhu ba ste bco lnga/ gnyis pa la/ snyigs ma ma zhu ba dang*/ dwangs ma ma zhu ba ste lo 'dab gnyis/ phyi ma la zags pa/ byer ba/ 'gyings ba ste gsum/ gsum pa la/ be snabs/ gsus nad/ ma zhu shing 'dra/ ma zhu dug 'dra ste lo 'dab rnam pa bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ rlung ldan/ mkhris ldan/

bad kan ldan pa gsum/ lnga pa la/ gsar rnying gi lo 'dab gnyis te bcu bzhi bsdoms pas nyer brgyad/ lnga pa la/ rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag gi rtags te lo 'dab gnyis/ drug pa bcos thabs la/ gsar pa bcos pa dang*/ rnying pa bcos pa ste yal ga phre'u gnyis/ dang po la/ spyi dang bye brag gis bcos pa'i lo 'dab gnyis kyi dang po la/ ma zhu ba chung du zas spyod kyi/ 'bring sman dugs/ chen po skyugs ni ru ha bshal dpyad de brgyad/ gnyis pa la/ rtsam pa/ sha/ sngo/ chang*/ ja/ chu gcig zho dar/ 'o ma gcig mar tshil gcig rdo/ sman/ dwangs ma/ ma zhu be snabs/ gsus nad/ shing 'dra/ dug 'dra/ rlung ldan/ mkhris ldan/ bad kan ldan pa bcos pa ste bcu/ rnying pa bcos pa gcig ste bsdoms pas lag len nyer brgyad/ de yang spyir 'bras bu gcod nad la/ gsar pa dang*/ rnying pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lhan/ lcags dregs/ me drod nyams pa/ dug gcong*/ smug po mkhris pa'i nad/ rnying pa'i gcod nad la/ skran/ skya rbab/ 'or/ dmu chu/ gcong chen zad byed lnga las/ dug 'og tu ston pa gzhan gsar pa rnams sngar bshad zin pa 'dir rnying pa sde lnga ston no// gnyis pa la/ zhu ba ste rnying 'dril ba skran te/ de la rgyu/ rkyen dbye ba/ gnas sa/ gyur tshul rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi gsum pa la/ bad kan gyi zas skran/ lhen skran/ rdo skran/ rlung gi lding skran/ khrag skran/ mkhris skran/ rtsa skran/ spu skran/ srin skran/ chu skran/ rnag skran te bcu gcig bzhi pa gnas la/ glo ba'i skran/ snying gi mchin khri/ mchin pa'i/ mcher pa'i/ mkhal ma'i/ mkhris pa'i/ pho ba'i/ long gi rgyu ma'i/ lgang ba'i/ mngal skran te bcu gnyis/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ phyi skran/ bar skran/ nang skran te/ lnga pa la/ gyur tshul dngos dang mdor bsdus/ tsha skran/ grang skran gnyis su bsdus te bshad pas skran nyer brgyad/ drug pa rtags la/ spyi'i rtags dang*/ bye brag gi rtags gnyis/

bdun pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gi bcos thabs te gnyis/ dang po la/ tsha skran nang bar/ phyi'i skran sman gyis bcos pa ste bzhi/ grang skran nang bar/ phyi skran sman gyis bcos pa de dag zas kyis bcos pa ste brgyad/ gnyis pa bye brag gi bcos pa la/ snying gi chu skran/ glo mig gi rtsa skran/ mchin pa'i khrag skran/ mtsher skran/ mkhal tshil gyi tsha skran/ ma zhu'i zas skran sogs/ snod kyi mkhris skran/ rgyu'i skran/ pho long gi smug po'i/ khrag skran/ rlung gi lding skran/ srin skran/ mngal skran/ lgang skran/ mdor bsdus nas bcos pa gcig ste lag len nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gsum pa dwangs ma mchin nas su zungs su 'gro ma 'dod pa nang khrag gam/ chu ser rgyas pa rlung gis rtsa mig tu gtor bas lus kun sobs pa ste ming skya rbab la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ glo la skya rbab/ mchin pa'i/ mtsher pa/ chu ser/ rlung gi skya rbab dang lnga/ gsum pa rtags la/ spyi'i rtags dang*/ bye brag gi rtags gnyis/ bzhi pa bcos thabs la spyi dang bye brag gi bcos thabs gnyis/ phyi ma la/ glo ba'i skya rbab bcos pa/ mchin pa'i/ mtsher pa/ chu ser/ rlung gi skya rbab bcos pa lnga ste lag len brgyad/ de yang skya rbab rnying pa la/ 'or nad dang*/ sbyong sngas na phyi chur 'gyur/ 'or nad rnying pa dmu chur 'gyur bas/ 'or dang skya rbab nyid kyis bcos ma thub 'phyis na dmu chu'i bcos la sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa thor nad skya rbab tu song ba yun rings nas 'or du lhung ba ste ming 'or nad la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po la/ zas dus rkyen gyis bskyed pa gsum// gnyis pa la/ rlung 'or/ mkhris 'or/ khrag 'or/ bad kan gyi 'or dang drug /gsum pa rtags la/ spyi rtags dang*/ bye brag gi rtags gnyis/ bzhi pa bcos thabs te gnyis/ phyi ma la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan/

gnad dug byung gi 'or gsor ba ste drug ste gsum/ bsdoms pas lag len brgyad/ lnga pa lus phyi nang bar nad kyi chu bsags pa steming dmu chu la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ dbye ba/ gyur tshul/ gnas/ rtags/ bcos thabs/ phyi rjes bcad pa ste lo 'dab brgyad kyi gsum la/ nad chu/ gdon chu/ dug chu gsum/ dang po la/ byer chu/ zags chu/ 'khyims chu/ rgyu rdol gyi chu bzhi'i dang po de la/ khrag byer/ mkhris byer/ chu byer gsum/ gnyis pa la/ don zags/ snod zags/ skran zags gsum gyi sngon ma/ mchin zags/ mtsher zags/ glo ba'i zags chu gsum/ bar ma la/ pho zags/ long gi zags chu gnyis/ phyi ma la/ khrag skran gyi/ rtsa skran gyi/ chu skran gyi zags chu gsum ste bsdoms pas chu rigs kyi nad bco lnga/ bzhi par ji ltar de dag 'gyur ba dang*/ mdor bsdu na/ rlung mkhris bad kan gyi chu gsum mam/ tsha chu grang chu gnyis su 'du bar bstan pa gsum/ lnga pa gnas la/ phyi nang bar gyi chu gsum ste chu nad nyer gsum/ drug pa rtags la/ spyi'i rtags dang*/ bye brag gi rtags gnyis/ dang po 'jug pa/ bar du smin pa/ mtha' ma rgyas dus/ 'tsho 'chi brtags pa bzhi/ bdun pa bcos thabs la/ dang po dang bar du gcod pa gnyis/ gnyis pa la spyi khyad par gnyis/ dang po la/ chu'i 'ol kha bsgyur ba/ gnyis pa rgya mtsho gnas su skem pa/ gsum pa rdzing gi 'or khung brtol ba/ bzhi pa mtsho mo yur du drang ba/ lnga pa rtsal 'gag mig gzhug pa ste lnga/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi bcos la/ khrag byer/ chu byer gsum/ mchin zags/ mcher/ glo/ pho ba sogs skran/ gdon/ dug byung*/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan gang shas che ba bcos pa ste dgu lag len bcu bzhi/ rjes bcad la gcig ste bsdoms pas lag len nyer gsum/ drug pa dwangs ma ma smin pas dri mar gyur pa'i nad lus zungs zad par byed pa ste/ ming gcong chen po zad byed pa/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ de'i bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/

gnyis pa la/ rlung gyur gyi zad byed/ mkhris pa bad kan gyi zad byed/ gcong chen nad kyi bla gnyan te bzhi/ phyi ma la/ ma zhu ba/ 'khru ba/ skyugs pa/ cham pa/ lud pa/ skad 'gags/ yi ga 'chus pa ste bdun bsdoms pas nad bcu/ gsum pa rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ snga ma la/ dang po bar mtha' ma gsum/ bzhi pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ phyi ma la/ rlung gyur/ mkhris gyur/ bad kan las gyur pa/ gcong chen/ mdor bsdus kyis bcos pa ste bzhi/ dril bas lag len bcu/ khong nad la nad brgya/ lag len brgya dang gcig yod do// gsum pa mkhris pa thang la lhags nas gnod bya sreg par byed pa ming tshad pa ste/ de bcos pa la/ tsha ba spyi bcos/ 'khrul gzhi bsal ba tsha grang gal mdo/ tsha ba ri thang mtshams/ tsha ba ma smin pa/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba/ stongs pa'i tsha ba/ gab pa'i tsha ba/ rnyings pa'i tsha ba/ tsha ba'i rnyongs pa/ 'grams kyi tsha ba/ 'khrugs kyi tsha ba/ rims kyi tsha ba/ 'brum pa/ rgyu gzer/ gag lhog cham rims bcos pa ste yal ga bcu drug dang po la/ tsha ba'i rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ rgyu mtshan/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi dang po la/ ring rgyu dang nye rgyu ste gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ 'phel/ dus/ gdon/ zas spyod kyi rkyen te bzhi/ lnga pa la lnga/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ rten/ dus/ nyes pa/ gnas sa/ ldang dus/ rgyud/ gnas skabs/ rigs kyi dbye ba ste brgyad/ dang po la/ byis pa/ dar ma/ rgan gyi tshad pa/ gnyis pa la/ gsar rnying gnyis/ gsum pa la/ rlung gi tsha ba/ mkhris pa/ bad kan/ khrag chu ser gyi tsha ba lnga/ bzhi pa la/ phyi bar nang la gnas pa gsum/ lnga pa la/ ston dpyid ldang ba/ dgung gnyis su ldang ba/ drug pa la/ rang rgyud can dang gzhan rgyud can gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ ldan tshad 'dus tshad gnyis/ bdun pa la/ ma smin pa tsha ba/ rgyas tshad/ stongs tshad/ gab tshad rnyings tshad/ rnyongs tshad de drug brgyad pa la/ 'grams tshad/ 'khrugs tshad/ rims tshad/ dug tshad bzhi/

bsdoms pas nad nyer brgyad/ gnyis pa la/ smyo ba/ lkugs pa/ yer pa/ 'thibs pa/ mgo gzir ba/ mgo 'khyoms pa/ mig tsha ba/ rna ba 'on pa/ sna khrag 'dzag pa/ kha lce skam pa/ skom dad che ba/ dang kha 'gags pa/ skyigs bu 'byams pa/ gzer che ba/ glo mang ba/ glo mi khogs pa/ 'khru pa/ skyug pa/ dri chu 'gags pa/ dri chu khrag tu 'dzag pa/ dri ma 'gags pa/ rngul 'byams pa/ lus drod phyir shor ba/ rkang lag na rengs 'khums pa/ kha yo/ mig yo/ pho 'bras rnams kyi dang po la/ tsha smyo grang smyo/ gnyis pa la/ tsha lkugs grang lkugs/ gsum pa la/ tsha yer grang yer/ bcu gsum pa la/ tsha 'byams grang 'byams/ bcu bzhi pa la/ khrag gzer/ gnyan gzer/ rlung gzer gsum/ bcu bdun pa la/ tsha 'khru grang 'khru/ bco brgyad pa la/ tsha skyugs grang skyugs gnyis kyi dang po la/ khrag skyugs mkhris skyugs gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ chu tsam stong skyugs gnyis/ bcu dgu pa la/ tsha bas chu 'gags dang*/ grang bas chu 'gags gnyis te bsdoms pas so brgyad/ dril bas re drug drug pa la/ 'gyur med ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ spang blang mu bzhi'i kha dmar gdags pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ spyi rtags dang bye brag gi rtags gnyis las/ dang po la/ phyi rtags slong ba rgyu rkyen gyi sgo nas brtag pa/ nang rtags mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas/ gsang rtags phan gnod kyi sgo nas brtag pa gsum ste bsdoms pas lag len lnga/ bdun pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ nad dang gnyen po bcos tshul/ dus las mi 'da' ba gnad kyi gdams pa/ tsha ba'i dngos po 'joms pa'i gnyen po gsum/ gnyis pa dus las mi 'da' ba gnad kyi gdams pa la/ ngo bo nyid kyi dus las 'da' ba bcos pa/ sbyor ba dman pas/ sbyor ba log pas/ sbyor ba lhag pas dus las 'das pa bcos pa ste bzhi/ gsum pa tsha ba'i dngos po 'joms pa'i gnyen po la/ zas/ spyod/ sman/ dpyad de lo 'dab bzhi/ dang po la/ bsten thabs bcu gcig zas skom phan pa bsten pa/

ngo bo nyid kyi mi 'phrod pa drug la sogs pa spang pa/ gnyis pa la/ mthun pa dang mi mthun pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gnas/ gos/ bya ba'i spyod lam gsum/ gsum pa la/ zhi dang sbyang ba gnyis/ dang po la/ thang*/ phye/ sman mar gsum/ dang po la/ smin thang*/ dbye thang*/ bsdu thang*/ sad thang*/ dgug thang*/ skam thang ste bdun/ bar ma la/ sngo sbyor/ rtsi sbyor/ 'dres pa gsum/ de'i bar ma/ 'bar ba tshad stobs bsad pa'i phye ma/ ldan tshad dus gcig 'joms pa'i phye ma/ rnyings tshad rtsad nas 'don pa'i phye ma ste gsum/ dpyad la gtar gyis khrag ngan/ rtsa lam sbyang ba/ rngul gyis tsha rlangs pa spur dbyung ba/ dugs kyis 'phral kyi zug gzer bcag pa/ lums kyis tsha byer 'grams pa 'don pa/ chu yis phyi tshad me dbal bcag pa/ me yis tsha ba 'bros 'phrang bsdams pa ste drug bye brag gi bcos thabs la/ sngar gyi so brgyad las/ phol 'bras por so bdun/ bsdoms pas lag len brgyad cu/ dang po la/ nad dang gang 'tshams sgo nas bcos pa/ tsha grang 'dres pa dbye ba'i bcos/ byer ba bsdus nas gzhom pa'i bcos gsum/ dang po la/ lus zungs na tshad dang sbyar ba bcos pa/ shad stobs dus dang sbyar ba/ nyes pa'i sgo nas bcos pa/ gnas kyi sgo nas/ gtso bo'i sgo nas/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas/ rigs kyi sgo nas bcos pa bdun/ gnyis pa 'khrul gzhi gsal ba tsha grang gal mdo la/ 'khrul pa'i gzhi nad/ gal mdo lag len te yal ga phre'u gnyis kyi dang po la/ rgyu rkyen yul dus rang bzhin na tshod gnas nyin zas goms bcus rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka tsha ba phyi rtags grang yang ngo bo tsha ba/ rgyu rkyen yul dus rang bzhin na tshod gnas nyin zas goms bcus rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka grang ba phyi rtags tsha la ngo bo grang ba ste lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ nad gzhi ltar snang 'khrul so rtags kyis gsal ba/ rtags ltar snang 'khrul so bcos kyis gsal ba/ bcos kyis ltar snang 'khrul so goms pas gsal ba/

goms pa'i ltar snang 'khrul so bcos bskyed kyis gsal ba/ bcos bskyed ltar snang 'khrul so rtsa chus gsal ba ste lo 'dab lnga/ de la lnga phrugs zhes bya la/ de'i phyi ma la/ phyi rtags log la ngo bo ma log pa/ ngo bo log la phyi rtags ma log pa/ gnyis ka ma log pa/ gnyis ka log pa bzhi'i dang po la/ grang ba rgan po tsha ba rgan po gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ tsha ba grang ba'i 'og 'grims rkun bur skye ba/ grang ba tsha ba'i 'og 'grims rkun bur skye ba/ rlung gi tsha ba'i 'og 'grims rkun bur bcos pa ste gsum/ 'di la nad bcu gcig lag len rgan po gnyis bsdoms pa la bcos thabs gcig ste bcu'o// gsum pa ri thang mtshams kyi tsha ba ngos 'dzin bcos pa'i thabs la/ rlung gi zhu 'khyags sngon nas bsu ba/ mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags 'phrang la sgug pa/ bad kan zhu 'khyags phyir rjes gcad pa ste lo 'dab gsum/ dang po la/ rlung gi zhu 'khyags de ngos 'dzin gnyis kyi phyi ma la phyi nang*/ gsang ba phugs 'tshol sman gyis brtag pa gsum/ gnyis pa la/ mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyag ngos gzung rtags/ bcos thabs gsum/ bad kan gyi zhu 'khyams/ de ngos 'dzin bcos pa'i thabs gnyis te/ nad gsum lag len drug go /bzhi pa tsha ba ma smin pa bcos pa la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin rgyu/ nad khams rkyen gyi ma smin pa gsum/ lnga pa la/ rang nyid ma smin pa/ smin long med pa/ smin du mi 'dod pa gsum gyi snga ma la/ stobs chen stobs chung gnyis/ bar ma la/ gnad du bab pa dang*/ sbyor ba log pa'i smin long med pa gnyis/ gsum pa la/ rlung bad kan rkyen gyis byer nas smin du mi 'dod pa gsum gyi phyi ma la yang*/ bya shor/ byer/ sdigs/ rnyogs pa bzhi ste nad bcu/ drug pa rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag phyis 'byung kha mar smin pa'i rtags dang bzhi/ bdun pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/

dang po la/ bcos tshul dang*/ gnyen po gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ sman/ dpyad/ zas/ spyod bzhi/ bye brag gi bcos la/ stobs che chung*/ smin long med pa/ bad kan gyis ma smin pa/ rlung gis ma smin pa/ rkyen gyis byer pa gsum gyi phyi ma la yang*/ bya shor/ byer ba/ mgo sdigs/ rnyogs pa bcos pa'o// lag len bco brgyad/ lnga pa tsha pa rgyas pa la/ rgyu rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun/ gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin/ dus/ rkyen gyis rgyas pa gsum/ lnga pa la/ rigs/ stobs/ babs pa'i sgo nas dbye ba gsum gyi snga ma la/ rims rgyas/ 'khrugs rgyas gnyis bar ma la/ stobs chen stobs chung gnyis/ phyi ma la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ snying la babs pa/ srog rtsa la/ glo la/ mchin pa la/ mtsher pa la/ mkhal ma la/ pho ba la/ mkhris pa la babs pa ste dril bas rgyas tshad bcu gsum/ drug pa rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ bdun pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ snga ma la/ bcos pa'i tshul dang*/ gnyen po gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ sman/ spyad/ zas/ spyod bzhi/ dang po la/ zhi sbyang gnyis/ dang po thang phye gnyis/ dpyad la/ gtar/ rngul 'don/ chu tshags/ dus bzhi/ bye brag gi bcos la/ snying*/ srog rtsa/ glo/ mchin/ mtsher/ mkhal/ pho ba/ mkhris pa la babs pa bcos pa ste nyer gcig drug pa tsha ba stongs pa la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin/ rkyen/ gnas kyis stongs pa gsum/ lnga pa/ dbye ba la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ tsha stongs/ rtsa stongs/ rlung stongs gsum/ gnyis pa la/ rims stongs/ khrag mkhris pa/ bad kan/ chu ser/ glo snying stongs pa drug ste bsdoms pas dgu /bdun pa la/ spyi bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ bcos tshul dang*/ gnyen po gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ tsha ba stongs pa'i sman/ dpyad/ zas sbyong*/ rtsa stongs kyi/ rlung stongs kyis bcos gsum/ bye brag drug
