bcos pa drug ste lag len bcu/ bdun pa tsha ba gab pa la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin/ rkyen/ gnas kyi gab pa gsum/ lnga pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi dbye ba gnyis kyi snga ma la/ tsha stobs can/ grang stobs can gnyis/ phyi ma la/ snying la tsha ba gab pa/ mkhal mar/ pho bar gab pa gsum dril bas gab tshad lnga/ drug pa/ rtags kyi nad ngos gzung ba/ rtsa chus mtshang 'dru ba/ gtar gyis phugs rdugs pa/ zas dang smin gyis mgo bshu ba ste bzhi/ bdun pa bcos la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ bcos pa'i tshul dang*/ gnyen po gnyis/ phyi ma la/ sman/ zas/ spyod/ dpyad bzhi/ bye brag gi bcos la/ snying la gab pa sogs bcos pa gsum ste lag len brgyad/ brgyad pa rnyings pa'i tsha ba la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin/ sbyor ba dman pas rnyings pa gsum/ lnga pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rlung ldan rlung med gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ sha la rgyas pa/ pags la grams pa/ rtsa la rgyugs pa/ rus la zhen pa ste rnyings tshad drug drug pa rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ bdun pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi bcos gnyis/ dang po la/ bcos tshul gnyen po gnyis phyi ma la/ sman/ zas/ spyod gsum/ bye brag la/ sha pags/ rtsa byer/ rus zhen bcos pa gsum ste lag len bdun/ dgu pa tsha rnyongs pa la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin/ rkyen gyi rnyongs pa gnyis/ phyi ma la/ bcos sngas pa dang kha thal gnyis/ sngas pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ tsha rnyongs chung che/ grang rnyongs chung che bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ pags gram/ shar rgyas/ rtsar rgyug rus zhen/ don la babs pa/ snod du lhung ba drug drug pa rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis bdun pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi bcos gnyis/

dang po la/ spyod tshul dang gnyan po gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ tsha rnyogs grang rnyongs chung che bcos pa gsum/ bye brag gi bcos la/ sha pags gcig mchin mtsher gcig rtsar rgyug rus zhen/ snod lhungs/ glor babs/ snying babs/ mchin babs/ mtsher babs/ mkhal babs bcos pa ste bcu/ bcu pa 'grams kyi tshad pa la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun gyi snga ma la/ phyi'i yul bzhi 'grams pa dang*/ nang gi don snod 'grams pa gnyis/ dang po la sha 'grams/ rus 'grams/ rtsa 'grams/ chu rgyus 'grams pa bzhi'i dang po la/ nywa 'grams dang*/ sha gzhan 'grams pa gnyis/ gnyis pa rus 'grams la/ tshigs/ rkang*/ mgo bo'i srubs/ rtsibs 'grams bzhi/ gsum pa rtsa 'grams la/ mgo bo'i byang khog gi yan lag gi rtsa 'grams dang bzhi/ gnyis pa nang don snod 'grams pa la/ snying 'grams/ srog rtsar/ glo bar/ mchin par/ mchin khri/ mtsher pa/ mkhal ma/ pho ba/ long*/ rgyu ma/ mkhris pa/ lgang pa/ bsam se'u 'grams pa dang bcu gsum/ drug pa la/ spyi bye brag gnyis/ bdun pa la/ spyi bcos dang*/ bye brag gi bcos gnyis/ dang po la/ sman/ dpyad/ zas/ spyod bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ 'grams tshad nyi shu rtsa gsum bcos thabs bcu gcig pa 'khrugs tshad la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bdun/ lnga pa dbye ba la/ rgyas 'khrugs/ stongs 'khrugs/ 'jam 'khrugs gsum/ dang po la/ nad rigs kyi/ babs sgo/ lud pas dbye ba gsum/ dang po la/ tshad 'khrugs/ tsha 'grams/ tsha rims gsum gyi snga ma la/ tsha rgyas/ tsha lkugs dug thabs gsum/ bar ma la/ tsha rdol/ khrag smug gnyis/ phyi ma la/ 'du ba'i tsha rims dang*/ gnyen gyi tsha rims gnyis/ babs sgos dbye ba la/ snying 'khrugs/ glo mchin/ pho mchin/ mkhal ma/ rtsa mkhris/ rlung 'khrugs brgyad/ lud pas dbye ba la/ skya sob/ dmar ba/ dmar ser/ smug nag sre bo/ dmar thang*/ ser dwangs/ sngon po lbu sog ste brgyad/

gnyis pa stongs 'khrugs la/ tsha stongs/ grang stongs gnyis te dril pas nyi shu rtsa drug drug pa rtags la/ spyi dang bye brag skag dus gsum/ bdun pa la/ bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis/ phyi ma la/ sman/ zas/ spyod/ rjes bzhi/ bye brag la 'khrugs tshad nyi shu rtsa drug bcos pa/ bcu gnyis pa rims bcos pa la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ rgyu mtshan/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab drug bzhi pa la/ bal nad/ 'brum bu/ rgyu gzer/ gag lhog cham pa dang lnga yod kyang 'dir bal nad la/ babs sa gnas dang sbyar te dbye ba/ rim pa dus dang sbyar te/ nad bzhi'i rigs dang sbyar te dbye ba gsum/ dang po la/ skyi dang ba spu+ur babs pa/ pags pa/ rtsa la/ sha la/ snod du/ don la/ rus la babs pa dang bdun/ gnyis pa la/ bad kan gyi dus/ mkhris pa'i/ khrag gi rlung khrag 'thab pa'i dus ri thang mtshams kyi dus dang lnga/ gsum pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus pa'i/ gnyan gyi rims dang lnga/ dang po la/ 'dar bu dang*/ yer bu gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ le brgan dang*/ klad gzer gnyis/ gsum pa la/ rmongs bu dang*/ lkugs pa gnyis/ bzhi pa la/ rgyun rims/ rtag pa'i/ nyin gcig pa/ nyin gsum pa/ nyin bzhi pa dang lnga/ lnga pa la/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug gi rims/ klad gzer gyi rims smyon tre tre ho dang gsum ste bcu bzhi bsdoms pas bal nad nyi shu rtsa drug lnga pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi rtags gnyis kyi snga ma la/ ma smin/ rgyas/ stongs rims kyi smin tshul gsum/ phyi ma la/ babs sa gnas kyi gnas/ rim pa dus/ 'dus rims kyi brtag pa gsum/ de'i phyi ma la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi spyi la/ dang po/ bar/ mtha' ma gsum/ drug pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gi bcos gnyis/ dang po ma smin/ bar du smin rgyas/ mtha' ma ri thang mtshams dus kyi bcos gsum/ gnyis pa bye brag gi bcos la/ babs sa gnas sbyar ba bcos pa'i bdun/ rim pa dus dang sbyar te bcos pa lnga/ nad bzhi rigs dang sbyar te bcos pa la/

rlung mkhris bad kan rnam pa gnyis/ 'dus rims kyi bcos la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ smin byed zhi bya/ gso ba gsum gyi zhi ba la/ gsar rnying gnyis kyi dang po la/ nyes pa'i stobs kyis bcos pa/ tsha ba nad kyi stobs kyis bcos pa gnyis/ bye brag gi bcos la/ rgyun rims sogs lnga/ gnyan rims kyi bcos la spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyi dang po la/ rtsa'i 'bros 'phrang bsdams pa/ gnyen po sbyar bas bsad pa/ ro dbyung ba/ nad lhag bsal ba bzhi/ bye brag la/ mgor babs/ snying babs/ glor babs/ mkhal babs/ pho bar babs pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ rims smyon tre tre ho/ mkhris yul rlung gis phrogs pa/ ma zhu'i rgyu byas pa/ rgyu mar babs pa bcos pa rnams so// bcu gsum pa/ 'brum bu'i rims la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab drug gi bzhi pa la/ nag po dang dkar po'i rigs gnyis/ dang po la/ skrangs ba glang gnya'/ khrag skam rtsel te shig zangs gzer sbu gu can dang gsum/ gnyis pa la/ sha ra skya shar/ rmog 'go spyi zlum/ sib bu kob rtse dang gsum ste dril bas drug lnga pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi rtags gnyis/ drug pa la/ spyi bcos dang khyad par gyi bcos gnyis/ dang po la/ ma smin pa'i dus spu sgo dbye ba/ nad rgyas tsha ba khong nas phyi la 'bul ba/ khong shor phyir drang ba/ mtha' ma 'brum rjes bsub pa ste bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ thang phye gnyis/ de'i phyi ma la/ rtsi sbyar dug sbyar gnyis/ gnyis pa bye brag gi bcos la/ rigs dang babs sar sbyar ba gnyis kyi dang po la/ glang gnya'/ khrag skam rtsal te shig zangs gzer gnyis bsdoms pas gcig ste gsum/ gnyis pa la/ snying*/ glo/ mchin/ rgyu ma/ mig gre ba/ lgang par babs pa bcos pa rnams so// bcu bzhi pa rgyu gzer bcos pa la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab drug gi bzhi pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/

dang po la/ don 'khrug snod 'khru/ stobs chen/ stobs chung bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ rgyu gzer/ rgyu 'khor/ rgyu 'khrol/ rgyu khugs bzhi ste rgyu gzer kyi nad brgyad/ drug pa bcos thabs la/ gsar rnying*/ dus dang sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ de'i dang po la/ nad stobs che chung*/ che ba la/ snod kyi rtse srung*/ mkhris pa'i me bsad/ rgyu long gi rngul sbyang*/ nad ngos gnyan pos bsad/ mchin pa'i zags bsdams/ 'khru ba'i kha dog bsgyur/ mtha' mar chu bor rgyun lam bcad pa dang bdun/ stobs chung la/ dang po rtsa kha bsdam/ bar du tsha ba rol du bsad/ mtha' ma chu bo'i rgyun lam bcad pa gsum/ bye brag gi bcas pa bzhi/ bco lnga pa gag lhog gi rims bcos pa la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab lnga/ gsum pa la/ lhog pa dang gag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'byung bas dbye ba/ nad bzhis/ rigs kyis dbye ba gsum/ dang po la/ sa lhog chu lhog me lhog rlung lhog bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ dkar po/ nag po/ khra bo gsum/ gsum pa la/ rgod/ yang rgod/ yam bu/ yum mo dang bzhi ste/ lhog pa'i nad bcu gcig /gnyis pa gag pa la/ pho gag mo gag bu gag gnyan gag dang bzhi ste dril bas gag lhog gi nad bco lnga/ bzhi pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gi rtags gnyis/ spyi la/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ bye brag la/ gag pa dang*/ lhog pa ngos gzung ba gnyis/ bcos thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ zas spyod/ bsad/ spyang dogs pa bzhi/ bsad pa la/ mthun pa sman gyis/ mi mthun gnyen pos/ nus pa sngags kyis bsad pa gsum gyi bar ma la/ rkyang sbyor/ gtso 'khor sbrags ma/ mang sbyor gsum gyi snga ma la/ sngon 'gro/ bsdu/ bsad/ log gnon bzhi/ bar ma/ gtso 'khor sbrags ma la/ gnyen po yod med gnyis/ bye brag gi bcos la/ lhog pa dang gag pa bcos pa gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ zhi/ zhugs/ dpyad/ sbyong*/ nad log bcos pa lnga'o// bcu drug pa cham pa bcos pa la/

rgyu/ rkyen/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab lnga/ gsum pa la/ gre cham/ glo cham/ rims cham gsum/ rtags la gsum/ bcos la gsum/ bzhi pa lus stong gso ba'i sdong po la/ mgo nad/ mig nad/ tsha ba'i nad/ sna nad/ kha nad/ mgul nad/ lba ba bcos pa ste yal ga drug dang po la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ gtso bo dang*/ phal pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan/ bad mkhris ldan pa/ bad rlung ldan pa/ rlung mkhris ldan pa/ rlung gi nad dang brgyad/ gnyis pa la/ ma rlung bu la shor ba/ rmen 'bras/ slog pa can/ skra byi ba/ spyi ther pa/ skra dkar dang drug ste mgo nad bcu bzhi/ bzhi pa bcos thabs la/ gtso bo'i bcos thabs brgyad/ pha'i nad la skra byi ba dang spyi ther bcos thabs bsdoms pas lnga/ gnyis pa mig nad la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ mig chu/ mig tsha/ ltung ba/ ling thog rab rib/ 'gribs pa dang drug gi dang po la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan/ 'dus pa'i/ srin bu'i/ skrang nad dang bdun/ gnyis pa la/ skam/ gsher/ dmar tshag gsum/ gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan las gyur pa bzhi/ drug pa la/ srod long*/ phyi nang*/ bar 'grib bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ sha lhag sha 'dzer/ rtsa dra/ sngo rib/ ling ros khebs pa lnga/ gsum pa la/ chu 'khrugs dang*/ rtsa mdangs nyams pa gnyis/ bzhi pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus pa'i nad dang bzhi ste mig nad sum cu rtsa bzhi/ bzhi pa bcos thabs la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ sman dpyad/ zas spyod/ mi 'phrod pa spangs pa gsum/ gnyis pa la/ mig chu'i bcos bdun/ skam/ gsher/ mig tshag kun gyi bcos te gsum/ ltung ba'i rlung*/ khrag mkhris bsdoms pa/ bad kan gyur pa gtses pa gsum/ ling thog gi khrag mkhris pa/ bsdoms pa/ rlung bad kan rab rib kun la spyi bcos gcig srod long sha mdzer/ sha lhag sngo rib/ phyi 'grib/ nang 'grib/ bar 'grib/

de'i phyi ma la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ phyi rjes gsum/ dang po la/ nad/ dus/ rim 'gro/ dpyad kyi sngon 'gro bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ cho ga gsangs/ brdeg thabs/ bsal thabs/ sol tshad/ brtan par bya ba/ legs nyes brtag pa ste bdun gyi snga ma la/ thur ma'i tshad dang*/ bca' gzhi gnyis/ gsum pa phyi rjes la/ zas spyod dang bslab pa dang*/ log gnon gnyis/ phyi ma la/ 'grams pa dang*/ 'gribs pa dang*/ zhar ba gsum bcos pa/ gsum pa rna ba'i nad la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ na ba dang*/ 'on pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rlung mkhris bad kan/ khrag gyur bzhi/ 'dus gyur rnag 'dzag 'brum bu byung ba gnyis te drug gnyis pa la/ sgra bcas 'on pa/ rna spabs kyis 'gags pa/ skam 'on/ ma rlung bu la shor ba dang bzhi ste rna ba'i nad bcu/ bcos thabs la nad kyi dbye ba bcu bcos pa/ bzhi pa sna nad bcos pa la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ bcos thabs gsum/ gnyis pa la/ sna bsubs/ 'brum thor/ sha lug rnag 'dzag khrag 'dzag dang lnga/ bcos thabs la yang de lnga'i bcos thabs te lnga/ lnga pa/ kha'i nad la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ chu nad rnyil/ so rtse/ rkan/ gre ba'i nang dang drug dang po la/ gre mchu/ sho ra/ bad kan/ gcen/ khrag rgyas/ kha shu dang drug gsum pa la/ bad kan/ rlung*/ khrag mkhris pa/ se 'bras/ srin dang drug bzhi pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ lce lhag /lce skrangs dang lnga/ lnga pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag /bad kan/ 'dus pa/ 'bras/ rmen bu dang bdun/ drug pa la/ lce chung babs pa/ lce 'dra/ rkan 'brum/ chu bur/ rus sbal rkan min dang drug ste kha nad sum cu so gcig /bzhi pa de dag bcos pa'i thabs sum cu so gcig /drug pa mgul nad la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ rlung lba/ mkhris/ khrag /bad kan/ tshil/ 'dus/ g.yang*/ byur lba dang brgyad/ bcos thabs la spyi dang bye brag gi bcos thabs gnyis/ dang po la/ sman chang phye ma dang*/ dpyad/ sngags bcos/ log gnon drug

gnyis pa la/ de dag gi bcos te bad tshil gnyis bsdoms pa'i bcos te bdun/ lnga pa don snod gso ba'i sdong po la/ snying nad/ glo nad/ mchin nad/ mtsher nad/ mkhal nad/ pho nad/ long nad bcos pa ste brgyad/ dang po la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs dang lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ snying 'phyos/ snying gzer/ snying tsha/ snying gi chu ser/ snying 'thibs/ snying gi srin bu/ snying nad kha le nag po dang bdun gyi gnyis pa la/ rlung gzer dang*/ khrag gzer gnyis/ gsum pa la/ tsha ba rgyas pa dang*/ 'khyil ba gnyis/ bzhi pa bcos thabs la/ snying nad dgu pa'i bcos kha re re/ gnyis pa glo ba'i nad gso ba la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ thang po/ skya rbab/ tsha ba/ chu gsher/ thes po/ glo lcong*/ glo rgyas/ bung tshang can dang brgyad kyi gsum pa la/ tsha subs tsha gzer gnyis te dgu/ bzhi pa la/ de dag gi bcos thabs dgu/ gsum pa mchin pa'i nad gso ba la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ le brgan rgyas pa/ ldem bu/ dug thabs/ chu shor/ rkun bu/ 'or lhung*/ kha lud/ gzhungs rengs/ mchin grum nag po/ mchin nad hal skem/ mchin khri dkar po/ mchin khri nag po/ mchin nad rtsa byer/ mchin rlung*/ mchin rgud/ rlan grangs/ glang dgur/ grang sbos dang bco brgyad drug pa la/ mchin khrag rked par lhung ba dang rkang par lhung ba gnyis/ bdun pa la/ glo bar lud pa dang*/ pho bar lud pa gnyis te nyi shu/ bzhi pa la/ 'or lhung gnyis bcos kha gcig tu byas pas bcos thabs bcu dgu/ bzhi pa mtsher nad la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ mtsher nad/ tsha ba/ khrag sbos/ mtsher rlung*/ mtsher pa'i bad kan/ blugs pa ste lnga/ bzhi pa la/ mtsher rlung*/ mtsher blugs gnyis bsdoms pas gso ba'i lag len bzhi/ lnga pa mkhal nad la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ mkhal rlung*/ mkhal gcong*/

'or lhung*/ mkhal tshad/ chu shor/ mkhal 'grims/ mkhal grum/ da rgan dang brgyad kyi drug pa la/ byer ba/ rgyas pa/ lhung ba gsum ste bcu/ bzhi pa la/ de dag bcos thabs kyi lag len bcu/ drug pa pho nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ tsha grang gnyis/ dang po la/ pho bar 'grams pa/ 'khrugs babs pa/ dug thabs/ gnyan rlang*/ pho ba sur+ya/ mkhris pa lud pa/ mchin khrag lud pa ste bdun gyi phyi ma la/ 'dril ba dang ma 'dril ba gnyis/ gnyis pa grang ba la/ pho rlung*/ ma zhu ba/ lcags dreg lhen/ me nyams/ rdo skran/ dmu rdzing*/ srin/ 'bras dang dgu ste bcu bdun yod kyang*/ 'dir mdor bsdus pa/ pho rlung*/ pho ba'i bad kan/ pho bar mkhris lhung*/ pho bar khrag lhung*/ pho ba dug thabs/ pho log pho ba rgud pa/ snyong bu brgyad/ bzhi pa la/ de dang bcos thabs kyi lag len brgyad/ bdun pa rgyu ma'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ rgyu khrol/ rgyu 'khril/ rgyu 'gyings/ rgyu 'gags/ rgyu gzer/ lnga/ bzhi pa la/ de dag gi bcos thabs lag len bzhi/ brgyad pa long nad bcos pa'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab gsum/ long nad grang sbos/ grang 'gyings/ tsha rnyongs/ 'ju skems/ rlangs pa can te lnga/ gsum pa la/ de dag bcos pa'i lag len lnga/ drug pa gsang nad gso ba'i sdong po la/ pho mtshan gyi nad bcos pa dang*/ mo mtshan gyi nad bcos pa ste yal ga gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ sos zin/ 'brum pa can/ mdud 'dra/ sbubs 'byar/ grang ma can dang lnga'i dang po la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan/ 'dus pa las gyur pa lnga ste dgu/ bzhi pa la sos 'dzin/ gsar dus bcos pa de dag dgu bcos pa ste lag len bcu/ gnyis pa mo mtshan gyi nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/

rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan/ 'dus gyur lnga/ bzhi pa la/ de dag bcos pa'i lag len lnga/ bdun pa thor bu'i nad bcos pa'i sdong po la/ skad 'gags/ yi ga 'chus pa/ skom pa'i nad/ skyigs bu'i nad/ dbugs mi bde ba/ glang thabs/ srin nad/ skyugs ba'i nad/ 'khru ba'i nad/ dri ma 'gags pa'i nad/ chu 'gags pa/ gcin snyi ba/ tshad pas 'khru ba/ dregs nad/ grum bu'i nad/ chu ser gyi nad/ rtsa dkar/ pags nad/ phran bu'i nad bcos pa ste yal ga bcu dgu'i dang po la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag /bad kan las gyur pa zad byed/ tshil gyur/ dras dpyad bdun/ bzhi pa la/ de dag bcos pa'i lag len bdun/ gnyis pa yi ga 'chus pa'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus gyur bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ de dag rkyang pa gsum bsdoms pa la bcos thabs gcig 'dus pa la gcig te lag len gnyis/ gsum pa skom pa'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus gyur bcud zad bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ spyi bcos gcig /khyad par de dag gi bcos thabs lnga ste lag len drug /bzhi pa skyigs bu'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ zas las byung ba/ phran tshegs/ zungs 'byung*/ chen po/ zab mo dang lnga/ bzhi pa la/ de dag bcos thabs lag len gcig /lnga pa dbugs mi bde ba'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ phran tshegs/ mun can/ dbugs chad/ chen po gyen 'byung dang lnga/ bzhi pa la/ spyi dang bye brag phran tshegs bzhag pa'i lhag ma bzhi'i bcos thabs bzhi/ drug pa glang thabs gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ gnas kyi dbye ba dang rigs kyi dbye ba gnyis/

dang po la/ don glang*/ snod glang*/ rtsa glang gsum gyi snga ma la/ mchin glang*/ mtsher glang gnyis/ bar ma la/ pho ba'i glang thabs/ rgyu ma'i glang thabs/ long gi glang thabs dang gsum/ phyi ma la/ phyi rtsa'i glang thabs dang*/ nang rtsa'i glang thabs gnyis/ gnyis pa rigs kyi dbye ba la/ tsha glang*/ grang glang*/ srin glang*/ gnyan glang dang bzhi'i dang po la/ mchin pa'i khrag 'khyags pa/ mtsher ba'i khrag 'khyags pa/ khrag pho long du lhung ba/ mkhris pa pho long du lhung ba bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ pho bar ma zhu ba lhung ba dang*/ rgyu long du thur sel 'khyil ba gnyis/ bzhi pa la/ pho bar gnyan babs pa dang*/ rgyu mar gnyan babs pa gnyis te glang thabs kyi nad bcu drug bzhi pa la/ mchin glang*/ mtsher glang*/ snod glang*/ pho glang*/ long glang*/ tsha glang*/ khrag lhung*/ mkhris lhung*/ grang glang*/ ma zhu lhung ba/ rgyu ma rlung 'khyil/ srin/ gnyan glang*/ rtsa glang bcos pa ste lag len bcu bzhi/ bdun pa srin nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ phyir gnas dang*/ nang gnas gnyis/ dang po la/ shig dang*/ sro ma gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ bad kan gyi srin pho bar gnas pa/ rlung srin long na gnas pa/ mkhris srin so dang*/ mig dang*/ pags pa dang*/ gzhang dang*/ mtshan mar gnas pa/ khrag srin khrag la gnas nas rtsa nang kun tu rgyu ba dang*/ klad pa la gnas nas yam dkar po dang*/ nag por gyur pas srin nad bcu/ bzhi pa la/ bad srin/ rlung srin/ lpags srin/ gzhang srin/ mtshan ma'i srin/ ya ma dkar po/ nag po bcos pa ste lag len bdun/ brgyad pa skyugs pa'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus pa'i skyugs pa bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ spyi bcos/ bye brag de dag gi bcos thabs kyi lag len bzhi/ dgu pa 'khru ba'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi'i gnyis pa la/

rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus pa 'khru ba bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ spyi bcos dang bye brag gi bcos gnyis/ bcu pa dri ma 'gags pa gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ srin nad/ thur sel log pa dang lnga/ bzhi pa la/ de dag gi bcos thabs kyi lag len lnga/ bcu gcig pa chu 'gags bcos pa'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ gcin sri ba dang*/ 'gags pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus pa las gyur pa bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ kha 'chus/ rlung 'khyil/ khrag sha spu 'gags/ skrangs ba/ khu bas 'gags pa/ bshang bas 'gags pa/ rde'us 'gags pa dang brgyad/ bzhi pa la/ de'i bcos thabs bcu gnyis/ bcu gnyis pa gcin snyi'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ bad mkhris rlung gsum gyi snga ma la/ zas khu chang dang 'dra ba/ chu 'dra ba/ bur shing 'dra ba/ gar po 'dra ba/ 'bras phye 'dra ba/ khu chu 'dra ba/ bye ma 'dra ba/ gsil ba/ 'gas 'byung*/ kha chu 'dra ba dang bcu/ bar ma la/ za khu nas tshig 'dra ba/ snag tsha 'dra ba/ sngon po/ skyer pa'i khu ba dang 'dra ba/ bcad khu 'dra ba/ khrag 'dra ba dang drug phyi ma la/ rkang*/ zhag klad chen/ sbrang 'dra bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ bcos tshul/ bad kan/ mkhris rlung*/ bla gnyan bcos pa ste lag len lnga/ bcu gsum pa tshad pas 'khru ba gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ ma smin pa dang*/ de dag bzhi'i bcos thabs te lag len lnga/ bcu bzhi pa dregs nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/ bcos thabs te lo 'dab bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ rlung*/ mkhris/ khrag bad kan bzhi/ bzhi pa la/ de dag khrag mkhris bsdoms pa'i bcos thabs gsum/ spyi bcos gcig ste bzhi/ bco lnga pa grum bu'i nad gso ba'i yal ga la/ rgyu/ dbye ba/ rtags/
